| `ability:ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH` | "current" | {"english_description":"Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any\nunoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.","english_source_name":"Caustic Breath"} | {"chinese_description":"喷出一股浓缩酸液，在其经过的任何未占据格子上留下腐蚀性云雾，\n并腐蚀击中的一切。","current_chinese_name":"腐蚀吐息"} | {"category":"ability","chinese_description":"喷出一股浓缩酸液，在其经过的任何未占据格子上留下腐蚀性云雾，\n并腐蚀击中的一切。","current_chinese_name":"腐蚀吐息","description_key":"Caustic Breath ability","english_description":"Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any\nunoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.","english_source_name":"Caustic Breath","identity":"ability:ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH, \"Caustic Breath\", 0, 0, 0, 3, {fail_basis::xl, 30, 1}, abflag::drac_charges }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。名称在该能力的正文效果与当前dispatch语境可成立；独立检查对象/动作及术语，不凭旧keep行通过。 正文独立复审：浓酸、经过且未占据格留酸云、命中腐蚀齐全；未删空格条件。 证据：crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:375；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:3265" |

| `ability:ABIL_DIG` | "current" | {"english_description":"Allows making tunnels through soft rock and rusted grates. | `ability:ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION` | "current" | {"english_description":"Reverts you to your normal form.","english_source_name":"End Transformation"} | {"chinese_description":"恢复到正常形态。","current_chinese_name":"结束变形"} | {"category":"ability","chinese_description":"恢复到正常形态。","current_chinese_name":"结束变形","description_key":"End Transformation ability","english_description":"Reverts you to your normal form.","english_source_name":"End Transformation","identity":"ability:ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION, \"End Transformation\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::none }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。名称在该能力的正文效果与当前dispatch语境可成立；独立检查对象/动作及术语，不凭旧keep行通过。 正文独立复审：恢复正常形态齐全；当前return_to_default_form，未承诺强制回某种族外形。 证据：crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:403；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:3329" |
| `ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE` | "current" | {"english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle"} | {"chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃"} | {"category":"ability","chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃","description_key":"Enkindle ability","english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle","identity":"ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_ENKINDLE, \"Enkindle\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::instant }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。名称在该能力的正文效果与当前dispatch语境可成立；独立检查对象/动作及术语，不凭旧keep行通过。 正文独立复审：幽灵火焰/记忆代价；伤害法术免MP/负重、成功率与威力加成且后者随XL；爪伤随法术等级并百分比吸血；每咒一记忆、用尽或超时结束；Lua最大3+floor(3*XL/20)齐全；状态标签燃魂与现行点燃不一致。 采用的逐键修复：Enkindle ability：幽灵火焰/记忆代价；伤害法术免MP/负重、成功率与威力加成且后者随XL；爪伤随法术等级并百分比吸血；每咒一记忆、用尽或超时结束；Lua最大3+floor(3*XL/20)齐全；状态标签燃魂与现行点燃不一致。 证据：crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:414；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:3352" |

| `ability_description:aphotic marionette ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Grabs hold of another creature's shadow and rapidly unleashes their spells and\nabilities as if they were your own, aimed at random enemies. You are also fully protected\nfrom any damage they would cause.\n\nCan only be used on creatures with eligible spells that they could productively\ncast at the moment. The process also leaves the victim's shadow too dim to grasp\na second time - once used successfully on a target, it may never be used on them\nagain.\n\n(Not all spells can be cast via this method; those which cannot will be marked\nwith an exclamation mark when examined.)","english_source_name":"aphotic marionette ability"} | {"chinese_description":"抓住另一个生物的影子，并快速释放它们的法术和能力，如同你自己的一般，\n瞄准随机的敌人。它们以这种方式召唤的生物将属于你，许多它们本应施加于\n自身的增益效果将转而施加于你。你也不会受到它们造成的任何伤害。\n\n只能对拥有在当前时刻可以有效施放的合适法术的生物使用。\n这个过程还会使受害者的影子变得太暗而无法再次抓取——\n一旦对目标成功使用，就再也不能对其使用。\n\n（并非所有法术都能通过这种方法施放；无法施放的法术在检视时\n将以感叹号标记。）","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"抓住另一个生物的影子，并快速释放它们的法术和能力，如同你自己的一般，\n瞄准随机的敌人。它们以这种方式召唤的生物将属于你，许多它们本应施加于\n自身的增益效果将转而施加于你。你也不会受到它们造成的任何伤害。\n\n只能对拥有在当前时刻可以有效施放的合适法术的生物使用。\n这个过程还会使受害者的影子变得太暗而无法再次抓取——\n一旦对目标成功使用，就再也不能对其使用。\n\n（并非所有法术都能通过这种方法施放；无法施放的法术在检视时\n将以感叹号标记。）","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"aphotic marionette ability","english_description":"Grabs hold of another creature's shadow and rapidly unleashes their spells and\nabilities as if they were your own, aimed at random enemies. | `ability_description:bestial takedown ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Unleashes the full power of your predatory instincts to leap towards a terrified\nenemy and perform a vicious melee attack against them. | `ability_description:bind soul ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Attempts to bind the soul of a living, holy, or demonic being into your eternal\nservice. If the targeted monster is slain before it leaves your sight, it will\nreturn as a bound soul, retaining the equipment, spells and abilities it had in\nlife.\n\nOnly beings who are relatively uninjured may be targeted, and the focus required\nto keep their soul from escaping will consume 1/3 of the user's current health -\nreturning it only upon slaying them. The attempt will fail entirely if the\ntargeted monster leaves your sight before the process is complete.\n\nThe bound soul's health is influenced by the user's Invocations skill. It will\nfollow its captor through stairs, and can be recalled from other levels.\n\nOnly one soul can be bound at a time.","english_source_name":"bind soul ability"} | {"chinese_description":"试图将一个活物、神圣或恶魔生物的灵魂束缚为你的永恒奴仆。如果目标怪物在离开你\n视线之前被杀死，它将作为缚魂返回，保留生前拥有的装备、法术和能力。\n\n只能选择相对未受重伤的生物作为目标，维持其灵魂不逃脱所需的专注会消耗使用者\n当前生命值的1/3——杀死目标后才会归还。若目标怪物在过程完成前离开你的视线，\n尝试将彻底失败。\n\n缚魂的生命值受使用者的祈神技能影响。它将跟随其捕获者穿过楼梯，并能从其他楼层\n召回。一次只能束缚住一个灵魂。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"试图将一个活物、神圣或恶魔生物的灵魂束缚为你的永恒奴仆。如果目标怪物在离开你\n视线之前被杀死，它将作为缚魂返回，保留生前拥有的装备、法术和能力。\n\n只能选择相对未受重伤的生物作为目标，维持其灵魂不逃脱所需的专注会消耗使用者\n当前生命值的1/3——杀死目标后才会归还。若目标怪物在过程完成前离开你的视线，\n尝试将彻底失败。\n\n缚魂的生命值受使用者的祈神技能影响。它将跟随其捕获者穿过楼梯，并能从其他楼层\n召回。一次只能束缚住一个灵魂。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"bind soul ability","english_description":"Attempts to bind the soul of a living, holy, or demonic being into your eternal\nservice. The attempt will fail entirely if the\ntargeted monster leaves your sight before the process is complete.\n\nThe bound soul's health is influenced by the user's Invocations skill. It will\nfollow its captor through stairs, and can be recalled from other levels.\n\nOnly one soul can be bound at a time.","english_source_name":"bind soul ability","identity":"ability_description:bind soul ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。活物/神圣/恶魔三类、视线内击杀才缚魂、继承装备法术能力、相对健康目标、当前HP三分之一与击杀归还、离视野失败、祈神影响HP、随楼梯/跨层召回、仅一魂齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:322；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:148" |
| `ability_description:blinkbolt ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Turns the user into living lightning and zaps them at the chosen monster,\ndealing electric damage to everything in their path and depositing the user\nat the bolt's end. After using this ability, you will be unable to use it\nagain for a short time.","english_source_name":"blinkbolt ability"} | {"chinese_description":"将使用者化成一道活体闪电并击向选定的怪物，\n对路径上的一切造成电击伤害，并将使用者送到闪电箭的终点。\n使用此能力后，短时间内无法再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"将使用者化成一道活体闪电并击向选定的怪物，\n对路径上的一切造成电击伤害，并将使用者送到闪电箭的终点。\n使用此能力后，短时间内无法再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"blinkbolt ability","english_description":"Turns the user into living lightning and zaps them at the chosen monster,\ndealing electric damage to everything in their path and depositing the user\nat the bolt's end. | `ability_description:blood for blood ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Beseeches Beogh to grant you an army with which to wreak bloody retribution.\nThe user will be immediately surrounded by orcish allies, with more of them\narriving over time from all directions. | `ability_description:brand self ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Permanently carves an Infernal Mark into yourself, forever tainting body and\nsoul in service of the Destroyer.\n\nSo long as you continue to worship Makhleb, this mark will grant you the\nfollowing power:","english_source_name":"brand self ability"} | {"chinese_description":"在你的身上永久刻下一个地狱印记，永远玷污身体与灵魂，以侍奉毁灭者。\n\n只要你继续崇拜马科列布，此印记将赋予你以下力量：","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"在你的身上永久刻下一个地狱印记，永远玷污身体与灵魂，以侍奉毁灭者。\n\n只要你继续崇拜马科列布，此印记将赋予你以下力量：","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"brand self ability","english_description":"Permanently carves an Infernal Mark into yourself, forever tainting body and\nsoul in service of the Destroyer.\n\nSo long as you continue to worship Makhleb, this mark will grant you the\nfollowing power:","english_source_name":"brand self ability","identity":"ability_description:brand self ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。永久印记、身体灵魂玷污、毁灭者意象、继续信仰马科列布才有后续力量齐全；后接变异正文须跨组复用。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:410；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:683" |

| `ability_description:bribe branch ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Gives 3000 gold to Gozag to spread throughout the inhabitants of the current\nbranch, only possible if the branch has intelligent inhabitants. Those monsters\nmay then become uninterested in fighting you (with tougher inhabitants having\nan increasing chance of being bribed), and more rarely will join your ranks,\nthough they will not leave their home branch. | `ability_description:brothers in arms ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Summons huge angry allies to wreak havoc.\n\nThe strength of the summoned allies increases with the user's experience level.","english_source_name":"brothers in arms ability"} | {"chinese_description":"召唤庞大而愤怒的友军进行破坏。\n\n召唤出的友军实力随使用者的经验等级提升而增强。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"召唤庞大而愤怒的友军进行破坏。\n\n召唤出的友军实力随使用者的经验等级提升而增强。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"brothers in arms ability","english_description":"Summons huge angry allies to wreak havoc.\n\nThe strength of the summoned allies increases with the user's experience level.","english_source_name":"brothers in arms ability","identity":"ability_description:brothers in arms ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。庞大愤怒友军与随玩家等级增强齐全；实现以XL选兄弟，并非祈神缩放。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:512；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:219" |
| `ability_description:cacophony ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. Their attacks may inflict a variety of minor maladies on your\nfoes - sometimes dazing, draining, or even confusing them.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.","english_source_name":"cacophony ability"} | {"chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"cacophony ability","english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. Their attacks may inflict a variety of minor maladies on your\nfoes - sometimes dazing, draining, or even confusing them.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.","english_source_name":"cacophony ability","identity":"ability_description:cacophony ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。附身护甲独立攻击且暂时持续、服饰四方攻击/欢快喧嚣、距离牵引、不同享伤害、可穿透射击、可能眩晕/衰竭/混乱、经验充能全部齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:145；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:694" |

| `ability_description:caustic breath ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any\nunoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.","english_source_name":"caustic breath ability"} | {"chinese_description":"喷出一股浓缩酸液，在其经过的任何未占据格子上留下腐蚀性云雾，\n并腐蚀击中的一切。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"喷出一股浓缩酸液，在其经过的任何未占据格子上留下腐蚀性云雾，\n并腐蚀击中的一切。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"caustic breath ability","english_description":"Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any\nunoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.","english_source_name":"caustic breath ability","identity":"ability_description:caustic breath ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。浓酸、经过且未占据格留酸云、命中腐蚀齐全；未删空格条件。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:42；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:707" |

| `ability_description:convert to beogh ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Swears fealty to Beogh, the god of cave orcs. | `ability_description:divine alms ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Comforts a friendly creature who is suffering, healing some of its wounds\n(based on your Invocations skill) and also curing poison, confusion, slowing,\nsickness, weakness, draining, and petrification.\n\nAny summoned creature who is healed by this ability may also be granted a\nsmall amount of additional time in this world.","english_source_name":"divine alms ability"} | {"chinese_description":"抚慰一个受苦的友好生物，根据你的祈神技能治疗其部分创伤，\n并治愈中毒、混乱、减速、疾病、虚弱、衰竭和石化。\n\n受到此能力治疗的召唤生物，还可能获得少量额外的存留时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"抚慰一个受苦的友好生物，根据你的祈神技能治疗其部分创伤，\n并治愈中毒、混乱、减速、疾病、虚弱、衰竭和石化。\n\n受到此能力治疗的召唤生物，还可能获得少量额外的存留时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"divine alms ability","english_description":"Comforts a friendly creature who is suffering, healing some of its wounds\n(based on your Invocations skill) and also curing poison, confusion, slowing,\nsickness, weakness, draining, and petrification.\n\nAny summoned creature who is healed by this ability may also be granted a\nsmall amount of additional time in this world.","english_source_name":"divine alms ability","identity":"ability_description:divine alms ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。受苦友军、祈神治疗、毒/混乱/减速/病/虚弱/衰竭/石化七项、受治疗召唤物可能少量延时齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:539；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:955" |
| `ability_description:divine exegesis ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Casts any spell from your spell library with guaranteed success. | `ability_description:divine shield ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Manifests a blindingly bright shield in front of the user. | `ability_description:duel ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Enters you into single combat with a worthy foe. On success, you and the\nchallenged foe will be transported to Okawaru's Arena to fight to the death,\nwith no escape until you either emerge victorious or are slain.\n\nHalf of your missing health will be restored as the duel begins, and upon\nvictory, Okawaru will return your health and magical power to whatever they\nwere before you issued the challenge - letting you shake off any damage taken\nduring it in the blink of an eye.","english_source_name":"duel ability"} | {"chinese_description":"让你和一个值得重视的敌人进行一对一搏斗。\n成功使用这个能力，你和被挑战的敌人将被运送到奥卡瓦鲁的竞技场战斗至死，\n除非你取得胜利或被杀，否则无法逃脱。\n\n决斗开始时将恢复你一半的已损失生命值，获胜后，\n奥卡瓦鲁会将你的生命值和法力恢复至发出挑战前的状态——\n让你转瞬之间摆脱决斗中所受的一切伤害。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"让你和一个值得重视的敌人进行一对一搏斗。\n成功使用这个能力，你和被挑战的敌人将被运送到奥卡瓦鲁的竞技场战斗至死，\n除非你取得胜利或被杀，否则无法逃脱。\n\n决斗开始时将恢复你一半的已损失生命值，获胜后，\n奥卡瓦鲁会将你的生命值和法力恢复至发出挑战前的状态——\n让你转瞬之间摆脱决斗中所受的一切伤害。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"duel ability","english_description":"Enters you into single combat with a worthy foe. | `ability_description:enkindle ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"enkindle ability"} | {"chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"enkindle ability","english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"enkindle ability","identity":"ability_description:enkindle ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。幽灵火焰/记忆代价；伤害法术免MP/负重、成功率与威力加成且后者随XL；爪伤随法术等级并百分比吸血；每咒一记忆、用尽或超时结束；Lua最大3+floor(3*XL/20)齐全；状态标签燃魂与现行点燃不一致。 采用的逐键修复：Enkindle ability：幽灵火焰/记忆代价；伤害法术免MP/负重、成功率与威力加成且后者随XL；爪伤随法术等级并百分比吸血；每咒一记忆、用尽或超时结束；Lua最大3+floor(3*XL/20)齐全；状态标签燃魂与现行点燃不一致。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:171；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:720；crawl-ref/source/dat/i18n/zh/source.txt:33365；crawl-ref/source/dat/i18n/zh/source.txt:status&#124;Enkindled" |

| `ability_description:golden breath ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Exhales a powerful blast of elemental devastation, which inflicts both fire and\ncold damage, and leaves clouds of poisonous vapour in its wake.","english_source_name":"golden breath ability"} | {"chinese_description":"呼出一股强大的元素毁灭之息，同时造成火焰和寒冷伤害，\n并在其路径上留下毒气云。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"呼出一股强大的元素毁灭之息，同时造成火焰和寒冷伤害，\n并在其路径上留下毒气云。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"golden breath ability","english_description":"Exhales a powerful blast of elemental devastation, which inflicts both fire and\ncold damage, and leaves clouds of poisonous vapour in its wake.","english_source_name":"golden breath ability","identity":"ability_description:golden breath ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。强大元素伤害、火冷同时、毒云轨迹齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:194；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:785" |
| `ability_description:grand finale ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Merges with a target emotionally and physically, and then bursts forth from\nthem, violently splitting them apart and killing them instantly. | `ability_description:grow ballistomycete ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Grows a short-lived ballistomycete at the location you choose. | `ability_description:grow oklob ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Grows a short-lived oklob plant at the location you choose. | `ability_description:heal wounds ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Heals the user significantly, with a chance of permanently reducing the user's\nmaximum magic capacity by one.","english_source_name":"heal wounds ability"} | {"chinese_description":"显著恢复使用者的生命值，但有可能永久降低 1 点法力上限。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"显著恢复使用者的生命值，但有可能永久降低 1 点法力上限。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"heal wounds ability","english_description":"Heals the user significantly, with a chance of permanently reducing the user's\nmaximum magic capacity by one.","english_source_name":"heal wounds ability","identity":"ability_description:heal wounds ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。显著治疗、概率永久减1MP上限齐全；TAG34定义有处理但种族来源已移除。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:82；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:30" |
| `ability_description:heavenly storm ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Invokes a storm of heavenly clouds. | `ability_description:hurl damnation ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Blasts a targeted enemy with damnation. | `ability_description:hurl torchlight ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Hurls a gout of umbral fire from the Black Torch, which deals irresistible\ndamage to living, demonic, and holy beings. The torchlight will also briefly\nempower any of your undead servants caught in its blast, and is harmless to\nthose who worship Yredelemnul. The damage is increased by Invocations skill.\n\nThis ability can be used only while the torch is lit, and only a limited number\nof times on each floor. The number of uses available per floor increases with\npiety, and stoking the Black Torch's flames with a particularly remarkable soul\nby killing a unique named enemy will also provide an additional use.","english_source_name":"hurl torchlight ability"} | {"chinese_description":"从黑火炬中掷出一股暗影之火，对活物、恶魔和神圣生物造成不可抵抗的伤害。\n火炬之光还会短暂增强任何被其爆发击中的亡灵仆从，对崇拜伊莱德莱姆努尔的人\n无害。伤害随祈神技能提升。\n\n此能力只能在火炬点燃时使用，且每层使用次数有限。\n每层可用次数随虔诚值增加，通过击杀一个独特命名敌人来用特别卓越的\n灵魂煽旺黑火炬的火焰也会提供额外使用次数。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"从黑火炬中掷出一股暗影之火，对活物、恶魔和神圣生物造成不可抵抗的伤害。\n火炬之光还会短暂增强任何被其爆发击中的亡灵仆从，对崇拜伊莱德莱姆努尔的人\n无害。伤害随祈神技能提升。\n\n此能力只能在火炬点燃时使用，且每层使用次数有限。\n每层可用次数随虔诚值增加，通过击杀一个独特命名敌人来用特别卓越的\n灵魂煽旺黑火炬的火焰也会提供额外使用次数。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"hurl torchlight ability","english_description":"Hurls a gout of umbral fire from the Black Torch, which deals irresistible\ndamage to living, demonic, and holy beings. The torchlight will also briefly\nempower any of your undead servants caught in its blast, and is harmless to\nthose who worship Yredelemnul. The damage is increased by Invocations skill.\n\nThis ability can be used only while the torch is lit, and only a limited number\nof times on each floor. The number of uses available per floor increases with\npiety, and stoking the Black Torch's flames with a particularly remarkable soul\nby killing a unique named enemy will also provide an additional use.","english_source_name":"hurl torchlight ability","identity":"ability_description:hurl torchlight ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。活物恶魔神圣不可抗伤、亡灵暂增益/同教无害、祈神增伤、点炬才可、每层有限随虔诚增加、击杀独特灵魂添一次齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:310；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:790" |

| `ability_description:imbue servitor ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Chooses one of the caster's destructive spells to grant to Spellspark Servitors\nthey create in the future, replacing any spell granted to them previously. The\ncaster must be capable of casting this spell themselves with a failure rate of\nno more than 20%.\n\nNote: imbuing a spell in this manner will take several turns and also dismiss\nyour servitor if it is active.","english_source_name":"imbue servitor ability"} | {"chinese_description":"选择施法者的一个破坏性法术赋予其未来创造的法术火花仆从，\n替换之前赋予它们的任何法术。施法者必须能够以不超过20%的失败率\n自己施放此法术。\n\n注意：以这种方式赋予法术将花费数回合，并且如果仆从处于活动状态，\n也会将其解散。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"选择施法者的一个破坏性法术赋予其未来创造的法术火花仆从，\n替换之前赋予它们的任何法术。施法者必须能够以不超过20%的失败率\n自己施放此法术。\n\n注意：以这种方式赋予法术将花费数回合，并且如果仆从处于活动状态，\n也会将其解散。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"imbue servitor ability","english_description":"Chooses one of the caster's destructive spells to grant to Spellspark Servitors\nthey create in the future, replacing any spell granted to them previously. | `ability_description:imprint weapon ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Analyzes the structural composition of an artefact melee weapon in your\ninventory and imprints it upon your Platinum Paragon spell, allowing it to wield\na functional replica of it whenever you create one.","english_source_name":"imprint weapon ability"} | {"chinese_description":"分析你物品栏中一件神器近战武器的结构组成，并将其烙印到你的\n白金典范法术中，使你今后创造的白金典范都能使用该武器的功能性复制品。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"分析你物品栏中一件神器近战武器的结构组成，并将其烙印到你的\n白金典范法术中，使你今后创造的白金典范都能使用该武器的功能性复制品。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"imprint weapon ability","english_description":"Analyzes the structural composition of an artefact melee weapon in your\ninventory and imprints it upon your Platinum Paragon spell, allowing it to wield\na functional replica of it whenever you create one.","english_source_name":"imprint weapon ability","identity":"ability_description:imprint weapon ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。库存神器近战武器、分析结构、烙印白金典范法术、以后每次召来可持功能复制品齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:139；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:809" |
| `ability_description:imprison ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Temporarily imprisons a monster in walls of silver. | `ability_description:infernal legion ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Uses one's own body as a conduit to unleash an army of chaos upon the world.\nFor a short while, lesser demons will continuously manifest near the user -\nprovided there is something around for them to fight. | `ability_description:infernal servant ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Beckons a demon from the far reaches of Hell and binds it into service with your\nblood. | `ability_description:jump ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Leaps through the air in the blink of an eye. While it is impossible to control\nyour destination, the movement is so abrupt and agile that no monster will be\nable to land a blow on you until you can act again, and many may lose track of\nyour position entirely.\n\nYou must spend a short while recovering between each use of this ability.","english_source_name":"jump ability","identity":"ability_description:jump ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。空中瞬跃、目的地不可控、下次行动前不被击中、许多可失踪、每用间短恢复齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:1101；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:834" |
| `ability_description:light the black torch ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Raises the Black Torch aloft and calls upon Yredelemnul to light it aflame,\nmarking the beginning of your attempt to conquer the current level of the\ndungeon. Yredelemnul only grants piety for kills made while the torch is lit.\n\nThose who have earned some of Yredelemnul's favour will be gifted temporary\nundead servants to help begin their conquest, with stronger servants being\nprovided to the experienced and especially pious.\n\nYredelemnul does not offer second chances - the torch will be extinguished when\nyou leave the current floor, and it may only be lit once per floor, ever.","english_source_name":"light the black torch ability"} | {"chinese_description":"高举黑火炬并呼唤伊莱德莱姆努尔将其点燃，标志着你开始征服当前地牢楼层。\n伊莱德莱姆努尔只会为火炬点燃时进行的击杀提供虔诚值。\n\n那些已经赢得伊莱德莱姆努尔一些好感的人将被赐予临时的亡灵仆从来帮助\n开始他们的征服，经验丰富且特别虔诚的人将获得更强大的仆从。\n\n伊莱德莱姆努尔不提供第二次机会——当你离开当前楼层时火炬将熄灭，\n且每层只能点燃一次，永不再来。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"高举黑火炬并呼唤伊莱德莱姆努尔将其点燃，标志着你开始征服当前地牢楼层。\n伊莱德莱姆努尔只会为火炬点燃时进行的击杀提供虔诚值。\n\n那些已经赢得伊莱德莱姆努尔一些好感的人将被赐予临时的亡灵仆从来帮助\n开始他们的征服，经验丰富且特别虔诚的人将获得更强大的仆从。\n\n伊莱德莱姆努尔不提供第二次机会——当你离开当前楼层时火炬将熄灭，\n且每层只能点燃一次，永不再来。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"light the black torch ability","english_description":"Raises the Black Torch aloft and calls upon Yredelemnul to light it aflame,\nmarking the beginning of your attempt to conquer the current level of the\ndungeon. Yredelemnul only grants piety for kills made while the torch is lit.\n\nThose who have earned some of Yredelemnul's favour will be gifted temporary\nundead servants to help begin their conquest, with stronger servants being\nprovided to the experienced and especially pious.\n\nYredelemnul does not offer second chances - the torch will be extinguished when\nyou leave the current floor, and it may only be lit once per floor, ever.","english_source_name":"light the black torch ability","identity":"ability_description:light the black torch ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。点炬开征服、只点燃时杀敌获虔诚、已获好感才有临时亡灵、经验虔诚影响强度、离层熄灭/每层永仅一次齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:297；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:842" |
| `ability_description:line pass ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Passes through a contiguous line of creatures at superhuman speed, ending up\nin a new location. | `ability_description:mud breath ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Spits an enormous ball of mud that knocks back whatever it hits and drenches the\nsurrounding area in a mud slick which impedes enemy movement and causes them to\nsometimes fumble their attacks.","english_source_name":"mud breath ability"} | {"chinese_description":"喷出一大团泥球，击退被击中的一切，并用泥泞覆盖周围区域，\n阻碍敌人移动并导致它们有时攻击失手。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"喷出一大团泥球，击退被击中的一切，并用泥泞覆盖周围区域，\n阻碍敌人移动并导致它们有时攻击失手。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"mud breath ability","english_description":"Spits an enormous ball of mud that knocks back whatever it hits and drenches the\nsurrounding area in a mud slick which impedes enemy movement and causes them to\nsometimes fumble their attacks.","english_source_name":"mud breath ability","identity":"ability_description:mud breath ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。大泥球、命中击退、周边泥地阻敌移动并偶尔攻击失手齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:36；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:853" |

| `ability_description:oozemancy ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Calls forth acidic ooze from the walls of the dungeon around you, damaging foes\ndepending on the number of slimy walls they remain adjacent to.","english_source_name":"oozemancy ability"} | {"chinese_description":"从你周围的地牢墙壁中召唤出酸性软泥，对敌人造成伤害，\n伤害取决于与其相邻的黏性墙壁的数量。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"从你周围的地牢墙壁中召唤出酸性软泥，对敌人造成伤害，\n伤害取决于与其相邻的黏性墙壁的数量。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"oozemancy ability","english_description":"Calls forth acidic ooze from the walls of the dungeon around you, damaging foes\ndepending on the number of slimy walls they remain adjacent to.","english_source_name":"oozemancy ability","identity":"ability_description:oozemancy ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。周围墙体酸泥、敌人依相邻黏墙数持续受伤齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:717；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:357" |
| `ability_description:overgrow ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Permanently destroys a wall-like structure, growing a short-lived plant ally in\nits place. | `ability_description:pacify ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Attempts to soothe a hostile creature and convince them to give up their violent\nways. If successful, the creature will turn neutral and attempt to leave the\nfloor as quickly as possible. You will be granted its full experience value.\n\nThis works best on holy and living creatures, with the undead and demons being\nprogressively harder to pacify - particularly if they are intelligent.\n\nNeither mindless nor nonliving creatures can be pacified and no monster can be\npacified while it is asleep.\n\nInvocations skill increases your chance of success and allows you to pacify more\npowerful creatures.","english_source_name":"pacify ability"} | {"chinese_description":"尝试安抚一个敌对生物，说服其放弃暴力。如果成功，该生物会变为中立，\n并尝试尽快离开当前楼层。你会获得它的全部经验值。\n\n对神圣生物和活物最容易成功，亡灵和恶魔则依次更难安抚，尤其是有智慧的个体。\n\n没有心智的生物和非生物都无法被安抚，任何怪物在睡眠中也无法被安抚。\n\n祈神技能可提高成功率，并使你能够安抚更强大的生物。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"尝试安抚一个敌对生物，说服其放弃暴力。如果成功，该生物会变为中立，\n并尝试尽快离开当前楼层。你会获得它的全部经验值。\n\n对神圣生物和活物最容易成功，亡灵和恶魔则依次更难安抚，尤其是有智慧的个体。\n\n没有心智的生物和非生物都无法被安抚，任何怪物在睡眠中也无法被安抚。\n\n祈神技能可提高成功率，并使你能够安抚更强大的生物。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"pacify ability","english_description":"Attempts to soothe a hostile creature and convince them to give up their violent\nways. If successful, the creature will turn neutral and attempt to leave the\nfloor as quickly as possible. You will be granted its full experience value.\n\nThis works best on holy and living creatures, with the undead and demons being\nprogressively harder to pacify - particularly if they are intelligent.\n\nNeither mindless nor nonliving creatures can be pacified and no monster can be\npacified while it is asleep.\n\nInvocations skill increases your chance of success and allows you to pacify more\npowerful creatures.","english_source_name":"pacify ability","identity":"ability_description:pacify ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。尝试安抚敌对、中立尽快离层、全经验、神圣活物最易/亡灵恶魔依次难且智慧更难、无心智非生物/睡眠不可、祈神成功率及强目标齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:524；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:231" |

| `ability_description:primordial nightfall ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Invokes a night from before the stars first burned in the sky, engulfing your\nsurroundings in impenetrable darkness. The user's sight radius will be reduced\nto nothing, preventing enemies from tracking or aiming abilities at you, and\nslowly expand back to normal over the duration of the effect. Your stealth will\nalso be increased.\n\nIt cannot be invoked again until its effect has fully ended, as even the very\nfirst night of creation must eventually give way to day.\n\nInvocations skill increases the duration of the effect.","english_source_name":"primordial nightfall ability","identity":"ability_description:primordial nightfall ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。星前之夜意象、零视野阻追踪/瞄能力、逐渐恢复视野/潜行提高、必须结束才重用、祈神延时齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:762；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:868" |
| `ability_description:purification ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Purges your body of poison, confusion, slowness, petrification, weakness, and\nsickness. | `ability_description:recall apostles ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Recalls your apostles from anywhere in the dungeon to your immediate\nsurroundings.","english_source_name":"recall apostles ability"} | {"chinese_description":"从地牢各处将你的使徒召唤到你的紧邻周围。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"从地牢各处将你的使徒召唤到你的紧邻周围。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"recall apostles ability","english_description":"Recalls your apostles from anywhere in the dungeon to your immediate\nsurroundings.","english_source_name":"recall apostles ability","identity":"ability_description:recall apostles ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。地牢任何地方使徒召至近旁齐全；“召唤”在召回语境不承诺创造新使徒。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:622；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:879" |

| `ability_description:recite ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Preaches to nearby monsters about Zin's laws for a short duration. After\nfinishing a recitation, it cannot be repeated for a short time.\n\nThe recitation will have different effects depending on the target: the chaotic\nand unclean will be affected by powerful and damaging effects, undead and\ndemons will be affected by weaker rebukes, and any other intelligent creatures\nwill have confusion sown amongst them, with heretics and priests of gods other\nthan Zin being punished much more strongly. The effectiveness of the recitation\nis increased by Invocations skill and piety.","english_source_name":"recite ability"} | {"chinese_description":"在短暂的期间内，向附近的怪物传道辛的律令。\n吟诵结束后，不能在短期内再次使用它。\n\n根据目标的不同，吟诵会产生不同的影响：\n混沌和不洁的怪物会受到强大、破坏性效果，亡灵和恶魔会受到较弱的斥责；\n其他有智慧的生物会陷入混乱，而异教徒以及信奉辛以外神祇的祭司会受到更重的惩罚。\n吟诵的效果能通过祈神技能和虔诚值的提升而提高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"在短暂的期间内，向附近的怪物传道辛的律令。\n吟诵结束后，不能在短期内再次使用它。\n\n根据目标的不同，吟诵会产生不同的影响：\n混沌和不洁的怪物会受到强大、破坏性效果，亡灵和恶魔会受到较弱的斥责；\n其他有智慧的生物会陷入混乱，而异教徒以及信奉辛以外神祇的祭司会受到更重的惩罚。\n吟诵的效果能通过祈神技能和虔诚值的提升而提高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"recite ability","english_description":"Preaches to nearby monsters about Zin's laws for a short duration. After\nfinishing a recitation, it cannot be repeated for a short time.\n\nThe recitation will have different effects depending on the target: the chaotic\nand unclean will be affected by powerful and damaging effects, undead and\ndemons will be affected by weaker rebukes, and any other intelligent creatures\nwill have confusion sown amongst them, with heretics and priests of gods other\nthan Zin being punished much more strongly. The effectiveness of the recitation\nis increased by Invocations skill and piety.","english_source_name":"recite ability","identity":"ability_description:recite ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。短暂传律/结束短冷、混沌不洁强效/亡灵恶魔弱斥/其他智慧混乱、异教及他神祭司更重、祈神虔诚增效；中文把其他智慧目标改为其中。 采用的逐键修复：Recite ability：短暂传律/结束短冷、混沌不洁强效/亡灵恶魔弱斥/其他智慧混乱、异教及他神祭司更重、祈神虔诚增效；中文把其他智慧目标改为其中。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:200；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:72；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:zin_check_recite_to_single_monster" |
| `ability_description:recruit apostle ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Anoints a defeated apostle, and welcomes them as a permanent follower. They will\nfollow you between floors and into any peril, willingly giving their life for\nthe cause and their kin.\n\nIf they die, Beogh will eventually revive them once you gain sufficient piety -\nthis process can be greatly accelerated by satisfying Beogh with the slaying of\nall foes who may have contributed to their apostle's death.\n\nYou can have at most 3 followers accompanying you at a time, though you may\nfreely dismiss old ones to invite new ones.","english_source_name":"recruit apostle ability"} | {"chinese_description":"为一个被击败的使徒施洗，欢迎他们成为永久的追随者。他们将跟随你\n穿梭于各楼层，进入任何险境，甘愿为事业和同胞献出生命。\n\n如果他们牺牲了，比欧弗最终会在你获得足够虔诚值后复活他们——\n这个过程可以通过满足比欧弗，杀死所有可能参与使徒死亡的敌人\n来大大加速。\n\n你最多可以同时有3位追随者陪伴，不过你可以自由解散旧者以邀请新者。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"为一个被击败的使徒施洗，欢迎他们成为永久的追随者。他们将跟随你\n穿梭于各楼层，进入任何险境，甘愿为事业和同胞献出生命。\n\n如果他们牺牲了，比欧弗最终会在你获得足够虔诚值后复活他们——\n这个过程可以通过满足比欧弗，杀死所有可能参与使徒死亡的敌人\n来大大加速。\n\n你最多可以同时有3位追随者陪伴，不过你可以自由解散旧者以邀请新者。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"recruit apostle ability","english_description":"Anoints a defeated apostle, and welcomes them as a permanent follower. | `ability_description:sacrifice a hand ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Sacrifices a hand, causing you to lose the ability to use shields{{\n    if you.race() ~= \"Formicid\" then\n        return \" and two-handed weapons\"\n    end\n}}, and to be able to wear one fewer ring.","english_source_name":"sacrifice a hand ability"} | {"chinese_description":"舍弃一只手，使你不能使用盾牌{{\n    if you.race() ~= \"Formicid\" then\n        return \"和双手武器\"\n    end\n}}且可佩戴戒指数减一。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃一只手，使你不能使用盾牌{{\n    if you.race() ~= \"Formicid\" then\n        return \"和双手武器\"\n    end\n}}且可佩戴戒指数减一。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice a hand ability","english_description":"Sacrifices a hand, causing you to lose the ability to use shields{{\n    if you.race() ~= \"Formicid\" then\n        return \" and two-handed weapons\"\n    end\n}}, and to be able to wear one fewer ring.","english_source_name":"sacrifice a hand ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice a hand ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。少一手/无盾、非Formicid才额外无双手武器、少一戒指齐全；Lua条件与返回分支逐一同义。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:903；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:484" |
| `ability_description:sacrifice an eye ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Sacrifices an eye, causing you to have a much harder time hitting targets.","english_source_name":"sacrifice an eye ability"} | {"chinese_description":"舍弃一只眼，使你更难命中目标。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃一只眼，使你更难命中目标。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice an eye ability","english_description":"Sacrifices an eye, causing you to have a much harder time hitting targets.","english_source_name":"sacrifice an eye ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice an eye ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。失一眼/更难命中相符；可选强调“难得多”以贴much。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:921；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:500" |
| `ability_description:sacrifice arcana ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Sacrifices arcana, causing you to lose the ability to use certain schools of\nmagic and preventing you from having any ranks in those skills.","english_source_name":"sacrifice arcana ability"} | {"chinese_description":"舍弃奥术，使你失去使用某些类型魔法的能力，并让你的这些技能无法达到任何等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃奥术，使你失去使用某些类型魔法的能力，并让你的这些技能无法达到任何等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice arcana ability","english_description":"Sacrifices arcana, causing you to lose the ability to use certain schools of\nmagic and preventing you from having any ranks in those skills.","english_source_name":"sacrifice arcana ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice arcana ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。失某些魔法学派及相关技能不能有等级齐全；“类型”在技能语境可接受。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:888；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:470" |
| `ability_description:sacrifice artifice ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Sacrifices the ability to evoke any magical items, and prevents you from having\nany ranks in the Evocations skill.\n\nThis includes wands and other items which use Evocations skill - that is, it does\n*not* affect reaching weapons, talismans, and ziggurat figurines. This also renders\nmagical staves much less effective in melee.","english_source_name":"sacrifice artifice ability"} | {"chinese_description":"舍弃激活魔法物品的能力，并让你的魔力释放技能无法达到任何等级。\n\n这包括魔杖和其他需要用到魔力释放技能的物品——\n但这*不会*影响可延伸攻击的武器、护符和通天塔雕像。\n这也使得法杖在近战时的效果大大降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃激活魔法物品的能力，并让你的魔力释放技能无法达到任何等级。\n\n这包括魔杖和其他需要用到魔力释放技能的物品——\n但这*不会*影响可延伸攻击的武器、护符和通天塔雕像。\n这也使得法杖在近战时的效果大大降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice artifice ability","english_description":"Sacrifices the ability to evoke any magical items, and prevents you from having\nany ranks in the Evocations skill.\n\nThis includes wands and other items which use Evocations skill - that is, it does\n*not* affect reaching weapons, talismans, and ziggurat figurines. | `ability_description:sacrifice experience ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Sacrifices some of your past experiences, causing you to lose one level\nimmediately and also to have the maximum level you can attain lowered by one.","english_source_name":"sacrifice experience ability"} | {"chinese_description":"舍弃一些你的过去的经验，使你立刻降低一个等级，你可达到的等级上限也会降一级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃一些你的过去的经验，使你立刻降低一个等级，你可达到的等级上限也会降一级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice experience ability","english_description":"Sacrifices some of your past experiences, causing you to lose one level\nimmediately and also to have the maximum level you can attain lowered by one.","english_source_name":"sacrifice experience ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice experience ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。丢过去经验、立即一级/上限也降一级；中文即时两级是明确数值错误。 采用的逐键修复：Sacrifice Experience ability：丢过去经验、立即一级/上限也降一级；中文即时两级是明确数值错误。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:911；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:492；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.h:31；crawl-ref/source/player-act.cc:152；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:4049；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:5206" |
| `ability_description:sacrifice forms ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Sacrifices forms, preventing you from voluntarily changing your form and from\nhaving any ranks in the Shapeshifting skill.","english_source_name":"sacrifice forms ability"} | {"chinese_description":"舍弃形态，你无法自行改变形态，也无法在变形术技能上达到任何等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃形态，你无法自行改变形态，也无法在变形术技能上达到任何等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice forms ability","english_description":"Sacrifices forms, preventing you from voluntarily changing your form and from\nhaving any ranks in the Shapeshifting skill.","english_source_name":"sacrifice forms ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice forms ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。不能主动改形态与变形术不能有等级齐全；技能称为变身不合现行术语。 采用的逐键修复：Sacrifice Forms ability：不能主动改形态与变形术不能有等级齐全；技能称为变身不合现行术语。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:861；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:448；docs/glossary.md:784；crawl-ref/source/sacrifice-data.h" |

| `ability_description:sacrifice love ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Sacrifices love, causing all creatures to become hostile, even those created\nby you. | `ability_description:sacrifice stealth ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Sacrifices stealth, causing you to always be noticed by foes and preventing\nyou from having any ranks in the Stealth skill.","english_source_name":"sacrifice stealth ability"} | {"chinese_description":"舍弃潜行，使你总能被敌人注意到，并让你的潜行技能无法达到任何等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃潜行，使你总能被敌人注意到，并让你的潜行技能无法达到任何等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice stealth ability","english_description":"Sacrifices stealth, causing you to always be noticed by foes and preventing\nyou from having any ranks in the Stealth skill.","english_source_name":"sacrifice stealth ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice stealth ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。总被敌人发现/潜行不能有等级齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:856；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:444" |
| `ability_description:sacrifice words ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Sacrifices the ability to use magical scrolls in combat unless badly injured.","english_source_name":"sacrifice words ability"} | {"chinese_description":"舍弃在战斗中使用魔法卷轴的能力，除非身受重伤。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃在战斗中使用魔法卷轴的能力，除非身受重伤。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice words ability","english_description":"Sacrifices the ability to use magical scrolls in combat unless badly injured.","english_source_name":"sacrifice words ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice words ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。战斗中禁卷轴/重伤例外齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:840；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:428" |
| `ability_description:sanctuary ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Transforms the area around the user into a domain of unbreakable law for a short\nduration. | `ability_description:shadowslip ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Instantly swaps places with your shadow (so long as it is active) and misleads\nall enemies in sight about which of the two is which. Enemies which were\npreviously focused on you will instead focus their attention exclusively upon\nyour shadow for several turns before they realise their mistake - though if they\nsucceed in destroying your shadow, the illusion will end prematurely.\n\nThe duration of this effect increases with Invocations skill, as will the\ndurability of your shadow immediately after using it.","english_source_name":"shadowslip ability"} | {"chinese_description":"立即与你的影子互换位置（只要它处于活动状态），\n并误导视野中的所有敌人关于两者中的哪一个是哪个。\n之前专注于你的敌人将在数回合内完全将注意力转移到你的影子上，\n直到它们意识到错误——但如果它们成功摧毁了你的影子，幻觉将提前结束。\n\n效果的持续时间随祈神技能提升，使用后影子的耐久度也会提升。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"立即与你的影子互换位置（只要它处于活动状态），\n并误导视野中的所有敌人关于两者中的哪一个是哪个。\n之前专注于你的敌人将在数回合内完全将注意力转移到你的影子上，\n直到它们意识到错误——但如果它们成功摧毁了你的影子，幻觉将提前结束。\n\n效果的持续时间随祈神技能提升，使用后影子的耐久度也会提升。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"shadowslip ability","english_description":"Instantly swaps places with your shadow (so long as it is active) and misleads\nall enemies in sight about which of the two is which. Enemies which were\npreviously focused on you will instead focus their attention exclusively upon\nyour shadow for several turns before they realise their mistake - though if they\nsucceed in destroying your shadow, the illusion will end prematurely.\n\nThe duration of this effect increases with Invocations skill, as will the\ndurability of your shadow immediately after using it.","english_source_name":"shadowslip ability","identity":"ability_description:shadowslip ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。活动影子互换即生效、可见敌人误认、原盯己转盯影子数回合、影子被杀提前解、祈神延时/耐久增强齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:735；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:894" |
| `ability_description:shaft self ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Sends you to a random position one to three floors down, as if you jumped into\na shaft trap. | `ability_description:shatter the chains ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Destroys a chosen bound item, relieving the wearer of its weight, but lessening\ntheir favour in Ashenzari's eyes.","english_source_name":"shatter the chains ability"} | {"chinese_description":"摧毁一件选定的已束缚物品，使穿戴者摆脱其重负，\n但也会减少艾申扎利对穿戴者的青睐。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"摧毁一件选定的已束缚物品，使穿戴者摆脱其重负，\n但也会减少艾申扎利对穿戴者的青睐。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"shatter the chains ability","english_description":"Destroys a chosen bound item, relieving the wearer of its weight, but lessening\ntheir favour in Ashenzari's eyes.","english_source_name":"shatter the chains ability","identity":"ability_description:shatter the chains ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。选束缚物品摧毁/卸重/少神眷齐全，保留束缚意象。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:729；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:368" |

| `ability_description:slimify ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Coats a wielded weapon or your fists with slime, turning the next living or\ncorporeal undead monster hit into a neutral slime.","english_source_name":"slimify ability"} | {"chinese_description":"在你的武器或拳头上裹上黏液，\n下一个击中的活物或有形的亡灵生物会变成一个中立的黏液。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"在你的武器或拳头上裹上黏液，\n下一个击中的活物或有形的亡灵生物会变成一个中立的黏液。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"slimify ability","english_description":"Coats a wielded weapon or your fists with slime, turning the next living or\ncorporeal undead monster hit into a neutral slime.","english_source_name":"slimify ability","identity":"ability_description:slimify ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。持武器或拳、下一击活物或有形亡灵、中立软泥齐全；无扩成无形亡灵。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:712；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:352" |
| `ability_description:slouch ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Causes damage to everyone in sight who is moving faster than you, dealing more\ndamage with greater differences in speed.","english_source_name":"slouch ability"} | {"chinese_description":"对视线中每个移动速度比你快的造成伤害，速度差异越大，造成的伤害越大。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"对视线中每个移动速度比你快的造成伤害，速度差异越大，造成的伤害越大。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"slouch ability","english_description":"Causes damage to everyone in sight who is moving faster than you, dealing more\ndamage with greater differences in speed.","english_source_name":"slouch ability","identity":"ability_description:slouch ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。视线内移动快于己者/速度差越大越伤齐全；句尾名词省略可非阻断润色。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:696；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:340" |
| `ability_description:smiting ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"[[Smiting spell]] The strength of the smiting is increased by Invocations skill.\n\nBeogh will not allow you to use this directly against another apostle during a\ndivine trial.","english_source_name":"smiting ability"} | {"chinese_description":"[[Smiting spell]] 惩击的威力随祈神技能的提升而增强。\n\n比欧弗不会允许你在神圣审判中直接对另一位使徒使用此能力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"[[Smiting spell]] 惩击的威力随祈神技能的提升而增强。\n\n比欧弗不会允许你在神圣审判中直接对另一位使徒使用此能力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"smiting ability","english_description":"[[Smiting spell]] The strength of the smiting is increased by Invocations skill.\n\nBeogh will not allow you to use this directly against another apostle during a\ndivine trial.","english_source_name":"smiting ability","identity":"ability_description:smiting ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。完整Smiting引用、祈神增强、神圣审判禁止直接打其他使徒齐全；本行把惩击误称惩戒。 采用的逐键修复：Smiting ability：完整Smiting引用、祈神增强、神圣审判禁止直接打其他使徒齐全；本行把惩击误称惩戒。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:615；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:299；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/spells.txt:1162；docs/glossary.md:2013" |
| `ability_description:spit poison ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Spits poison at a targeted creature.","english_source_name":"spit poison ability"} | {"chinese_description":"向一个目标生物喷吐毒液。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"向一个目标生物喷吐毒液。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"spit poison ability","english_description":"Spits poison at a targeted creature.","english_source_name":"spit poison ability","identity":"ability_description:spit poison ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。目标生物喷毒相符。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:6；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:6" |

| `ability_description:step from time ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Removes you completely from the flow of time. | `ability_description:temporal distortion ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Warps the flow of time, causing monsters to skip forwards in time relative to\nyou.","english_source_name":"temporal distortion ability"} | {"chinese_description":"扭曲时间流，导致周围的怪物相对于你跳跃到未来的时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"扭曲时间流，导致周围的怪物相对于你跳跃到未来的时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"temporal distortion ability","english_description":"Warps the flow of time, causing monsters to skip forwards in time relative to\nyou.","english_source_name":"temporal distortion ability","identity":"ability_description:temporal distortion ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。相对自己使怪物向未来跳时齐全；实现让周遭怪物经历数回合。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:691；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:336" |
| `ability_description:transference ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Forces a targeted creature to pass through the realms of memory and exchange\nplaces with your ancestor.\n\nWith great piety, those near the target will be drained to a degree depending\non Invocations skill.","english_source_name":"transference ability"} | {"chinese_description":"迫使一个目标生物穿过记忆领域，与你的先祖交换位置。\n\n虔诚值较高时，目标附近的生物还会受到衰竭，程度取决于祈神技能。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"迫使一个目标生物穿过记忆领域，与你的先祖交换位置。\n\n虔诚值较高时，目标附近的生物还会受到衰竭，程度取决于祈神技能。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"transference ability","english_description":"Forces a targeted creature to pass through the realms of memory and exchange\nplaces with your ancestor.\n\nWith great piety, those near the target will be drained to a degree depending\non Invocations skill.","english_source_name":"transference ability","identity":"ability_description:transference ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。目标穿记忆界交换先祖、高虔诚邻目标者受衰竭且祈神定程度齐全；“有着大量虔诚值”句法及先祖标签宜修。 采用的逐键修复：Transference ability：目标穿记忆界交换先祖、高虔诚邻目标者受衰竭且祈神定程度齐全；“有着大量虔诚值”句法及先祖标签宜修。 最终独立复核修正：明确为ENCH_DRAINED衰竭，不是吸血或直接生命损伤。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:993；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:562；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:6275" |
| `ability_description:triple draw ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Draws three cards from any deck, and allows you to choose one to play,\ndiscarding the other two.","english_source_name":"triple draw ability"} | {"chinese_description":"从任意一副牌组中抽三张牌，选择一张进行游戏，然后弃掉另外两张。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"从任意一副牌组中抽三张牌，选择一张进行游戏，然后弃掉另外两张。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"triple draw ability","english_description":"Draws three cards from any deck, and allows you to choose one to play,\ndiscarding the other two.","english_source_name":"triple draw ability","identity":"ability_description:triple draw ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。任意牌组三选一打出/弃另二齐全；“进行游戏”语义可懂但建议“打出”。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:598；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:284" |

| `ability_description:upheaval ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Calls on the forces of nature to blast a small area with magma, ice, wind,\nor rubble. | `ability_description:vessel of slaughter ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Invokes a blood pact with the Destroyer, temporarily granting you enormous power\nat a dangerous price.\n\nAt the moment the pact is sealed, a massive explosion of damnation will surround\nyou, and you will transform into a demonic avatar, granting you demonic\nresistances, invulnerable will, doubled healing from kills, and reducing all\ndamage you take by 1/3. You will additionally gain a bonus to all outgoing\ndamage proportional to how injured you were when you used this ability.\n\nWhen your transformation expires, you will be dragged down into the Crucible of\nFlesh, and made to fight through waves of demons until Makhleb considers your\ndebt paid.","english_source_name":"vessel of slaughter ability"} | {"chinese_description":"与毁灭者签订血之契约，暂时赋予你巨大的力量，但代价危险。\n\n在契约封存的那一刻，一场巨大的天谴爆炸将包围你，你将变身为恶魔化身，\n获得恶魔抗性、不可动摇的意志、击杀时双倍治疗效果，并将所有受到的\n伤害减少1/3。你还会根据使用此能力时的受伤程度获得额外的输出伤害加成。\n\n当你的变身结束时，你将被拖入血肉熔炉，被迫与一波波恶魔战斗，\n直到马科列布认为你的债务已偿清。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"与毁灭者签订血之契约，暂时赋予你巨大的力量，但代价危险。\n\n在契约封存的那一刻，一场巨大的天谴爆炸将包围你，你将变身为恶魔化身，\n获得恶魔抗性、不可动摇的意志、击杀时双倍治疗效果，并将所有受到的\n伤害减少1/3。你还会根据使用此能力时的受伤程度获得额外的输出伤害加成。\n\n当你的变身结束时，你将被拖入血肉熔炉，被迫与一波波恶魔战斗，\n直到马科列布认为你的债务已偿清。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"vessel of slaughter ability","english_description":"Invokes a blood pact with the Destroyer, temporarily granting you enormous power\nat a dangerous price.\n\nAt the moment the pact is sealed, a massive explosion of damnation will surround\nyou, and you will transform into a demonic avatar, granting you demonic\nresistances, invulnerable will, doubled healing from kills, and reducing all\ndamage you take by 1/3. You will additionally gain a bonus to all outgoing\ndamage proportional to how injured you were when you used this ability.\n\nWhen your transformation expires, you will be dragged down into the Crucible of\nFlesh, and made to fight through waves of demons until Makhleb considers your\ndebt paid.","english_source_name":"vessel of slaughter ability","identity":"ability_description:vessel of slaughter ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。血契危险短时力量、起始天谴爆炸、魔化抗性/意志/击杀双疗/减伤三分之一、按起始伤势增输出、到血肉熔炉抗波还债齐全；damnation误作诅咒。 采用的逐键修复：Vessel of Slaughter ability：血契危险短时力量、起始天谴爆炸、魔化抗性/意志/击杀双疗/减伤三分之一、按起始伤势增输出、到血肉熔炉抗波还债齐全；damnation误作诅咒。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:462；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:927；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:7251" |

Invocations increases the damage of these arrows, and Makhleb will\nalways bestow healing upon you for enemies killed by them.\n\nAfter performing a blood rite, you cannot perform another until your HP has\nfully recovered.","english_source_name":"Mark of the Celebrant","flags":"mutflag::makhleb","identity":"mutation:MUT_MAKHLEB_MARK_CELEBRANT","levels":1,"lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/mutation-data.h","weight":0} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。名称及所有非空have/gain/lose/will_gain分别审读，保持等级、数值、方向、获得/消失事件与语气；正文单独按body_identity留卡，避免用短句结论覆盖长说明。 采用的逐键修复：Mark of the Celebrant mutation：颂礼者只在hp*2>hp_max时拒绝，所以100上限50HP可以触发，EN below50%与ZH50%以下排除此点。时间之血只在hp>hp_max*2/3时拒绝，即HP≤floor(2*maxHP/3)可触发；100上限66HP也触发，而EN/ZH below66%排除该点。这是实际边界差异，不是要求统一百分比写法。 证据：crawl-ref/source/mutation-data.h:2594；crawl-ref/source/mutation-type.h:321" |
| `mutation:MUT_MAKHLEB_MARK_EXECUTION` | "current" | {"display_strings[0].english":"Mark of Execution","display_strings[1].english":"You bear the Mark of Execution.","display_strings[2].english":"Murder takes root in your soul.","english_description":"A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. | `mutation:MUT_NO_REGENERATION` | "current" | {"display_strings[0].english":"no regeneration","display_strings[1].english":"You do not regenerate.","display_strings[2].english":"You stop regenerating.","display_strings[3].english":"You start regenerating.","english_description":"You do not regenerate health while resting, and are unable to receive the\neffects of magic that hastens the speed of regeneration. "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。mutation_def依次声明short_desc/have/gain/lose；两条initializer的gain是失去能力，lose是获得能力。mutate()先增加等级并取gain；delete_single_mutation_level()先减等级并取lose。两身份没有绕过通用消息的switch分支。中文逐字跟随源错，因此即使一般种族先天获得不常显示，消息与实际事件仍反向。 采用的逐键修复：four strong arms mutation：EN明确as well as wear a second pair of gloves，ZH遗漏此能力，增加“副臂形状奇怪，无法戴额外手套或魔法戒指”。SLOT_GLOVES对MUT_QUADRUMANOUS额外增加一个槽位。 本批源端闭环：mutation_def声明顺序为have/gain/lose；mutate增加等级后打印gain，delete_single_mutation_level减等级后打印lose。原数组反向已交换，中文既有对应句不用反译。 "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。EN no longer less encumbered表示不再减轻阻碍，ZH“不再受到护甲的阻碍”反成完全免除惩罚。player_armour_shield_spell_penalty仅在有该变异时减少身体护甲惩罚。 采用的逐键修复：runic magic mutation：hurl damnation的have仍为诅咒之火、正文天遣为错字；禁止Translocations短句使用位移魔法而当前学派名为传送系；暴君正文Might是ENCH_MIGHT状态，却沿用了法术标题强壮。ER正文出现负重评级/妨碍等级，健壮体格短句又说移动阻碍，易误为移动速度。 EN all armour、ZH所有护甲；player_armour_shield_spell_penalty只将body_armour_penalty除4以实现身体护甲ER减半，盾牌惩罚在其后另加，不减半。；Your spellcasting is no longer less encumbered by armour.：M07：失去减轻护甲施法阻碍的效果，不是变成护甲完全不阻碍；护甲对你施法的阻碍不再减轻。；Your spellcasting no longer less encumbered by armour.：M07：源码已替换为补is后的完整英文键；旧键无当前源代码caller，退役。 证据：crawl-ref/source/mutation-data.h:2400；crawl-ref/source/mutation-type.h:305；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:2501 原发现：M07" |

| `mutation:MUT_TENTACLE_ARMS` | "current" | {"display_strings[0].english":"tentacles","display_strings[1].english":"You have tentacles for arms and can constrict enemies.","display_strings[2].english":"Your arms feel tentacular.","display_strings[3].english":"Your arms no longer feel tentacular.","english_description":"Your gelatinous body has eight tentacles that help you move around in shallow\nor deep water and can be used to constrict enemies while attacking them in\nmelee. | `mutation_description:autotomy mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"When gravely wounded, you automatically shed your tail as a defensive response\nand step away to an adjacent tile. The third level of this mutation also makes you less likely to\nmiscast spells.","english_source_name":"big brain mutation","identity":"mutation_description:big brain mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。MEEK和COWARDICE名称同为懦弱，但前者固定Slay惩罚，后者依威胁产生恐惧；big brain正文的大脑袋可更准确说大脑；thin skeletal structure末句将+2敏捷和Stealth+写在一起可能误读潜行也+2；acrobatic正文翻滚空心骨头生硬。 采用的逐键修复：big brain mutation：MEEK和COWARDICE名称同为懦弱，但前者固定Slay惩罚，后者依威胁产生恐惧；big brain正文的大脑袋可更准确说大脑；thin skeletal structure末句将+2敏捷和Stealth+写在一起可能误读潜行也+2；acrobatic正文翻滚空心骨头生硬。 最终独立复核修正：用“硕大的大脑”保留big尺寸命题，不将大脑这一器官名误作大小形容。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:620；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:428；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:4099；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:300；crawl-ref/source/player-stats.cc:262；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:3699；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:71；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:61；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:687；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:489；crawl-ref/source/mutation-data.h:304 原发现：S01" |

| `mutation_description:blade parry mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You briefly gain SH equal to your slaying whenever you perform a melee attack\n(with an additional flat bonus based on your Shapeshifting skill).","english_source_name":"blade parry mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你发动近战攻击时，你会短暂获得等同于杀戮加成的盾牌强度，\n并获得一项基于变形术技能的固定额外加成。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你发动近战攻击时，你会短暂获得等同于杀戮加成的盾牌强度，\n并获得一项基于变形术技能的固定额外加成。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"blade parry mutation","english_description":"You briefly gain SH equal to your slaying whenever you perform a melee attack\n(with an additional flat bonus based on your Shapeshifting skill).","english_source_name":"blade parry mutation","identity":"mutation_description:blade parry mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。每次近战短暂获得基于杀戮值的SH并加技能固定值，和player_parrying一致；盾牌强度虽非此处首选短标签，未改变数值含义。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1240；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:913" |
| `mutation_description:bloodcurse mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"When you kill a natural, plant, or demonic monster with a stab attack, they may\nrise again to serve you as a vampiric thrall.
