| `mutation_description:contamination susceptible mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You absorb twice as much mutagenic energy from being contaminated.","english_source_name":"contamination susceptible mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你从魔法污染中吸收的诱变能量为正常的两倍。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你从魔法污染中吸收的诱变能量为正常的两倍。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"contamination susceptible mutation","english_description":"You absorb twice as much mutagenic energy from being contaminated.","english_source_name":"contamination susceptible mutation","identity":"mutation_description:contamination susceptible mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。contamination susceptible正文漏twice并笼统写更快；distributed training末句把“阻止训练的效果”误指为此变异自身限制训练。 采用的逐键修复：contamination susceptible mutation：contamination susceptible正文漏twice并笼统写更快；distributed training末句把“阻止训练的效果”误指为此变异自身限制训练。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:495；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:940；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:4697；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:4710；crawl-ref/source/skills.cc:1191；crawl-ref/source/skills.cc:1199；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:774；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:558 原发现：M06" |

| `mutation_description:east wind's embodiment mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you Rampage, you regain a small percentage of your maxmimum MP and\nunleash a bitter wind that makes all enemies within 2 spaces of you Exposed,\nincreasing the damage they take from non-attack sources by 35% and also their\nchance to be hit or affected by them.\n\nAdditionally, casting spells will not cause you to stop Stampeding.","english_source_name":"east wind's embodiment mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你冲锋时，都会恢复法力上限的一小部分，并释放刺骨的寒风，\n使你周围两格内的所有敌人陷入暴露状态：来自非攻击来源的伤害提高 35%，\n这些敌人被此类效果命中或影响的概率也会提高。\n\n此外，施放法术不会使你的奔踏停止。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你冲锋时，都会恢复法力上限的一小部分，并释放刺骨的寒风，\n使你周围两格内的所有敌人陷入暴露状态：来自非攻击来源的伤害提高 35%，\n这些敌人被此类效果命中或影响的概率也会提高。\n\n此外，施放法术不会使你的奔踏停止。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"east wind's embodiment mutation","english_description":"Whenever you Rampage, you regain a small percentage of your maxmimum MP and\nunleash a bitter wind that makes all enemies within 2 spaces of you Exposed,\nincreasing the damage they take from non-attack sources by 35% and also their\nchance to be hit or affected by them.\n\nAdditionally, casting spells will not cause you to stop Stampeding.","english_source_name":"east wind's embodiment mutation","identity":"mutation_description:east wind's embodiment mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1049；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1354" |
| `mutation_description:eel punch mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your melee hits have a 50% chance of discharging an arc of electricity that\ntravels between several connected enemies.","english_source_name":"eel punch mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你的近战命中有 50% 概率释放一道电弧，在数个彼此相连的敌人之间传导。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的近战命中有 50% 概率释放一道电弧，在数个彼此相连的敌人之间传导。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"eel punch mutation","english_description":"Your melee hits have a 50% chance of discharging an arc of electricity that\ntravels between several connected enemies.","english_source_name":"eel punch mutation","identity":"mutation_description:eel punch mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。50%近战命中概率、电弧经过多个相连敌人均准确；melee-attack.cc以coinflip触发。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1227；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:955" |
| `mutation_description:eeljolt mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"When your health drops to 40% of your max HP, your eels violently discharge\nelectricity, striking all connected targets within 2 tiles of yourself - be they\nfriend or foe - for twice the damage their electricity normally does.\n\nThis effect cannot activate again until you fully heal.","english_source_name":"eeljolt mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"当你的生命值降至上限的 40% 时，电鳗会猛烈放电，以其正常电击伤害的两倍\n打击你周围 2 格内所有相连的目标——无论敌友。\n\n此效果在你完全恢复前无法再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你的生命值降至上限的 40% 时，电鳗会猛烈放电，以其正常电击伤害的两倍\n打击你周围 2 格内所有相连的目标——无论敌友。\n\n此效果在你完全恢复前无法再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"eeljolt mutation","english_description":"When your health drops to 40% of your max HP, your eels violently discharge\nelectricity, striking all connected targets within 2 tiles of yourself - be they\nfriend or foe - for twice the damage their electricity normally does.\n\nThis effect cannot activate again until you fully heal.","english_source_name":"eeljolt mutation","identity":"mutation_description:eeljolt mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。低血40%触发、两格内相连敌友皆受双倍伤害、满血前不能重复均保留；ouch.cc与player-reacts重置对应。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1232；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:959" |
| `mutation_description:efficient magic mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You have both an innate understanding and a greater control over the exact flow\nof your magic, letting you cast spells with greater efficiency. Each level of\nthis mutation reduces the cost of your spells by 1 MP, to a minimum of 1 MP.","english_source_name":"efficient magic mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你天生理解并能更精确地掌控法力流动，因此施法效率更高。\n这个变异每升一级会使法术消耗减少 1 点法力，最低仍为 1 点法力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你天生理解并能更精确地掌控法力流动，因此施法效率更高。\n这个变异每升一级会使法术消耗减少 1 点法力，最低仍为 1 点法力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"efficient magic mutation","english_description":"You have both an innate understanding and a greater control over the exact flow\nof your magic, letting you cast spells with greater efficiency. | `mutation_description:efficient metabolism mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your altered digestive system extracts additional value out of select potion\ntypes, doubling the duration of all status effects gained via potions.","english_source_name":"efficient metabolism mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你改变后的消化系统能从特定种类的药水中汲取额外效力，\n使通过药水获得的所有状态效果持续时间翻倍。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你改变后的消化系统能从特定种类的药水中汲取额外效力，\n使通过药水获得的所有状态效果持续时间翻倍。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"efficient metabolism mutation","english_description":"Your altered digestive system extracts additional value out of select potion\ntypes, doubling the duration of all status effects gained via potions.","english_source_name":"efficient metabolism mutation","identity":"mutation_description:efficient metabolism mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:149；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:971" |

| `mutation_description:elemental crystals mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Four elemental crystals float alongside you - one corresponding to each of\nEarth, Fire, Air, and Ice magic. Casting a spell of one of those schools will\ncause a matching crystal with enemies in range of it to surge with power,\ndamaging up to 3 enemies within 3 tiles and charging it.\n\nWhen all crystals become fully charged, you will temporarily gain resistance to\nelemental damage and regenerate a small amount of health over time.","english_source_name":"elemental crystals mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"四枚元素晶体漂浮在你身旁，分别对应土、火、气、冰魔法。\n施放其中一个学派的法术时，只要对应晶体的作用范围内有敌人，它就会迸发力量，\n伤害三格内的至多三个敌人，并为自身充能。\n\n所有晶体充能完毕后，你会暂时获得元素伤害抗性，并随时间恢复少量生命值。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"四枚元素晶体漂浮在你身旁，分别对应土、火、气、冰魔法。\n施放其中一个学派的法术时，只要对应晶体的作用范围内有敌人，它就会迸发力量，\n伤害三格内的至多三个敌人，并为自身充能。\n\n所有晶体充能完毕后，你会暂时获得元素伤害抗性，并随时间恢复少量生命值。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"elemental crystals mutation","english_description":"Four elemental crystals float alongside you - one corresponding to each of\nEarth, Fire, Air, and Ice magic. Casting a spell of one of those schools will\ncause a matching crystal with enemies in range of it to surge with power,\ndamaging up to 3 enemies within 3 tiles and charging it.\n\nWhen all crystals become fully charged, you will temporarily gain resistance to\nelemental damage and regenerate a small amount of health over time.","english_source_name":"elemental crystals mutation","identity":"mutation_description:elemental crystals mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。四种元素各一晶体、相应法术充能、晶体周围3格至多3敌、全充能元素抗性和随时间少量回血均保留；transform.cc:3080-3140及Indom再生支撑。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1275；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1393" |
| `mutation_description:ephemeral shield mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you use spells or divine abilities with any costs, a shield forms from\nthe excess loose magical or spiritual energy to guard you. The magical energy\nfrom spells only sustains the shield for but a moment, while the spiritual\nenergy from using divine abilities lasts a brief bit longer.","english_source_name":"ephemeral shield mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你使用有消耗的法术或神圣能力时，逸散的魔法或精神能量都会形成盾牌保护你。\n法术产生的魔法能量只能维持盾牌片刻，而使用神圣能力产生的精神能量会多维持一小段时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你使用有消耗的法术或神圣能力时，逸散的魔法或精神能量都会形成盾牌保护你。\n法术产生的魔法能量只能维持盾牌片刻，而使用神圣能力产生的精神能量会多维持一小段时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"ephemeral shield mutation","english_description":"Whenever you use spells or divine abilities with any costs, a shield forms from\nthe excess loose magical or spiritual energy to guard you. | `mutation_description:formless mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You have no physical body and instead interact with the world through haunting\nobjects. | `mutation_description:four strong arms mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You have two pairs of two arms, allowing you to wield two-handed weapons with\none pair and a shield with the other, as well as wear a second pair of gloves.\nYou can even wield extremely large weapons like giant clubs, though this takes\nboth arm-pairs.","english_source_name":"four strong arms mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你有两对手臂，可以一对持握双手武器、另一对持盾，还能额外穿戴一双手套。\n你甚至可以挥舞巨棒等极其巨大的武器，不过这需要两对手臂共同持握。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你有两对手臂，可以一对持握双手武器、另一对持盾，还能额外穿戴一双手套。\n你甚至可以挥舞巨棒等极其巨大的武器，不过这需要两对手臂共同持握。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"four strong arms mutation","english_description":"You have two pairs of two arms, allowing you to wield two-handed weapons with\none pair and a shield with the other, as well as wear a second pair of gloves.\nYou can even wield extremely large weapons like giant clubs, though this takes\nboth arm-pairs.","english_source_name":"four strong arms mutation","identity":"mutation_description:four strong arms mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。EN明确as well as wear a second pair of gloves，ZH遗漏此能力，增加“副臂形状奇怪，无法戴额外手套或魔法戒指”。SLOT_GLOVES对MUT_QUADRUMANOUS额外增加一个槽位。 采用的逐键修复：four strong arms mutation：EN明确as well as wear a second pair of gloves，ZH遗漏此能力，增加“副臂形状奇怪，无法戴额外手套或魔法戒指”。SLOT_GLOVES对MUT_QUADRUMANOUS额外增加一个槽位。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:754；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:540；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:151；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:858 原发现：M02" |

| `mutation_description:freeze response mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you are exposed to cold damage, you have a chance to become Frozen,\nlowering your movement speed for a short while.","english_source_name":"freeze response mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你受到寒冷伤害时，都有一定概率陷入冰封，短时间内降低移动速度。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你受到寒冷伤害时，都有一定概率陷入冰封，短时间内降低移动速度。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"freeze response mutation","english_description":"Whenever you are exposed to cold damage, you have a chance to become Frozen,\nlowering your movement speed for a short while.","english_source_name":"freeze response mutation","identity":"mutation_description:freeze response mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。上批文本已改变，独立复核当前EN/ZH全部段落；原问题的触发、阈值、概率或目标范围已经保留，仍与本卡机制证据对照。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1146；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1005" |

| `mutation_description:frigid aura mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your breath radiates an intense chill which freezes nearby walls solid as you\nfight.\n\nWhenever you attack, you turn a random wall adjacent to your target or yourself\nfrigid. This damage\nincreases with your shapeshifting skill.\n\nThe walls will rapidly melt again if you stop attacking.","english_source_name":"frigid aura mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你的呼吸散发出刺骨寒意，在战斗时将附近墙壁冻实。\n\n每当你攻击时，目标或你自己相邻的一面随机墙壁会变得严寒。\n严寒墙壁每回合会伤害与其相邻的敌人；敌人周围的严寒墙壁达到最大数量时，\n伤害最高可翻倍。此伤害随变形术技能提高。\n\n如果你停止攻击，墙壁会迅速融化。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的呼吸散发出刺骨寒意，在战斗时将附近墙壁冻实。\n\n每当你攻击时，目标或你自己相邻的一面随机墙壁会变得严寒。\n严寒墙壁每回合会伤害与其相邻的敌人；敌人周围的严寒墙壁达到最大数量时，\n伤害最高可翻倍。此伤害随变形术技能提高。\n\n如果你停止攻击，墙壁会迅速融化。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"frigid aura mutation","english_description":"Your breath radiates an intense chill which freezes nearby walls solid as you\nfight.\n\nWhenever you attack, you turn a random wall adjacent to your target or yourself\nfrigid. Frigid walls deal damage to any enemies adjacent to them each turn - up\nto twice as much when an enemy is adjacent to as many as possible. This damage\nincreases with your shapeshifting skill.\n\nThe walls will rapidly melt again if you stop attacking.","english_source_name":"frigid aura mutation","identity":"mutation_description:frigid aura mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。每次攻击随机冻结自身或目标相邻墙、邻墙敌人逐回合伤害、最多翻倍、随技能增伤和停攻迅速融化均保留。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1112；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1009" |
| `mutation_description:frog-like legs mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your uniquely muscular legs allow you to hop short distances in the blink of an\neye with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>, though your walking speed is\nbelow average.\n\nThe second level of this mutation allows you to hop farther.","english_source_name":"frog-like legs mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你异常强健的双腿让你可以用 <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 在眨眼间跳过短距离，\n但步行速度低于平均水平。\n\n此变异的第二级能让你跳得更远。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你异常强健的双腿让你可以用 <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 在眨眼间跳过短距离，\n但步行速度低于平均水平。\n\n此变异的第二级能让你跳得更远。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"frog-like legs mutation","english_description":"Your uniquely muscular legs allow you to hop short distances in the blink of an\neye with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>, though your walking speed is\nbelow average.\n\nThe second level of this mutation allows you to hop farther.","english_source_name":"frog-like legs mutation","identity":"mutation_description:frog-like legs mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:722；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1019" |
| `mutation_description:gather mist mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"As you explore, you will gradually condense the dungeon air into potions of mist,\nwhich allow you to become intangible.\n\nYou can carry no more than five of these at a time and they will be destroyed if\nyou ever permanently leave this form.","english_source_name":"gather mist mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"探索时，你会逐渐将地牢中的空气凝结成雾药水，喝下后能使你变得无形。\n\n你同时最多只能携带五瓶雾药水；如果你永久离开此形态，它们就会被销毁。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"探索时，你会逐渐将地牢中的空气凝结成雾药水，喝下后能使你变得无形。\n\n你同时最多只能携带五瓶雾药水；如果你永久离开此形态，它们就会被销毁。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"gather mist mutation","english_description":"As you explore, you will gradually condense the dungeon air into potions of mist,\nwhich allow you to become intangible.\n\nYou can carry no more than five of these at a time and they will be destroyed if\nyou ever permanently leave this form.","english_source_name":"gather mist mutation","identity":"mutation_description:gather mist mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。探索凝制雾药水、无实体效果、最多五瓶和永久离开才销毁完整；无形此处指intangible，未改成隐形机制。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1294；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1408" |

| `mutation_description:glimmercast mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you cast spells while in sight of enemies (or witness monsters cast\nspells themselves), the leftover magical energy will condense into a short-lived\ncloud of glimmer. | `mutation_description:mark of execution mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. Whenever you kill\nan enemy in melee, there is a small chance for it to awaken and manifest as a\nmaelstrom of scythe-like blades enveloping you. These blades will attack\nwhenever you do and also retaliate whenever you successfully dodge an enemy\nattack.\n\nYou have the ability to rampage swiftly towards enemies while possessed, but if\nyou spend more than a short while doing anything other than attacking, the\ndemonic presence will go dormant inside you once again.","english_source_name":"mark of execution mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"一个谋杀之恶魔化身潜伏在你的灵魂中。每当你用近战击杀一个敌人时，\n有很小概率它会醒来并显现为包围你的镰刀刀锋漩涡。这些刀锋会在你\n攻击时一起攻击，并在你成功闪避敌人攻击时反击。\n\n附身期间，你可以快速冲锋接近敌人；但若有超过短暂片刻未进行攻击，\n恶魔存在就会再次在你体内沉睡。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"一个谋杀之恶魔化身潜伏在你的灵魂中。每当你用近战击杀一个敌人时，\n有很小概率它会醒来并显现为包围你的镰刀刀锋漩涡。这些刀锋会在你\n攻击时一起攻击，并在你成功闪避敌人攻击时反击。\n\n附身期间，你可以快速冲锋接近敌人；但若有超过短暂片刻未进行攻击，\n恶魔存在就会再次在你体内沉睡。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of execution mutation","english_description":"A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. | `mutation_description:mark of haemoclasm mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"When you kill enemies, they have a small chance to explode in a violent rain of\ngore, which damages adjacent foes proportional to the victim's maximum health.\n\nEnemies who die to this explosion will always explode themselves.","english_source_name":"mark of haemoclasm mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"当你击杀敌人时，它们有很小概率爆炸为一阵猛烈的血雨，对相邻的敌人造成\n与受害者最大生命值成比例的伤害。\n\n死于这种爆炸的敌人自身也总是会爆炸。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你击杀敌人时，它们有很小概率爆炸为一阵猛烈的血雨，对相邻的敌人造成\n与受害者最大生命值成比例的伤害。\n\n死于这种爆炸的敌人自身也总是会爆炸。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of haemoclasm mutation","english_description":"When you kill enemies, they have a small chance to explode in a violent rain of\ngore, which damages adjacent foes proportional to the victim's maximum health.\n\nEnemies who die to this explosion will always explode themselves.","english_source_name":"mark of haemoclasm mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of haemoclasm mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1396；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:852" |
| `mutation_description:mark of the celebrant mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you fall to 50% of your maximum HP or less, you perform an infernal rite,\nunleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. You will fire at\nleast one arrow for every valid target, but may fire additional ones if few are\npresent. Invocations increases the damage of these arrows, and Makhleb will\nalways bestow healing upon you for enemies killed by them.\n\nAfter performing a blood rite, you cannot perform another until your HP has\nfully recovered.","english_source_name":"mark of the celebrant mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你的生命值降至上限的50%或以下时，你进行一次地狱仪式，\n向附近的敌人释放一阵血箭齐射。你将为每个有效目标至少射出一支箭，\n但如果目标较少可能射出额外的箭。祈神技能提高这些箭的伤害，\n马科列布总会为被此效果击杀的敌人赐予你治疗。\n\n完成一次鲜血仪式后，必须等生命值完全恢复才能再次发动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你的生命值降至上限的50%或以下时，你进行一次地狱仪式，\n向附近的敌人释放一阵血箭齐射。你将为每个有效目标至少射出一支箭，\n但如果目标较少可能射出额外的箭。祈神技能提高这些箭的伤害，\n马科列布总会为被此效果击杀的敌人赐予你治疗。\n\n完成一次鲜血仪式后，必须等生命值完全恢复才能再次发动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of the celebrant mutation","english_description":"Whenever you fall to 50% of your maximum HP or less, you perform an infernal rite,\nunleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. You will fire at\nleast one arrow for every valid target, but may fire additional ones if few are\npresent. Invocations increases the damage of these arrows, and Makhleb will\nalways bestow healing upon you for enemies killed by them.\n\nAfter performing a blood rite, you cannot perform another until your HP has\nfully recovered.","english_source_name":"mark of the celebrant mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of the celebrant mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。颂礼者只在hp*2>hp_max时拒绝，所以100上限50HP可以触发，EN below50%与ZH50%以下排除此点。时间之血只在hp>hp_max*2/3时拒绝，即HP≤floor(2*maxHP/3)可触发；100上限66HP也触发，而EN/ZH below66%排除该点。这是实际边界差异，不是要求统一百分比写法。 采用的逐键修复：Mark of the Celebrant mutation：颂礼者只在hp*2>hp_max时拒绝，所以100上限50HP可以触发，EN below50%与ZH50%以下排除此点。时间之血只在hp>hp_max*2/3时拒绝，即HP≤floor(2*maxHP/3)可触发；100上限66HP也触发，而EN/ZH below66%排除该点。这是实际边界差异，不是要求统一百分比写法。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1403；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:859；crawl-ref/source/god-passive.cc:2302；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:720；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:141；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1264 原发现：M17" |
| `mutation_description:mark of the fanatic mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Grants you the Vessel of Slaughter ability, allowing you to transform into a\npowerful demonic avatar with greatly boosted offence and defence for a short\nperiod of time, in exchange for being dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh\nafterward and made to fight for your freedom.","english_source_name":"mark of the fanatic mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"赋予你杀戮化身能力，允许你在短时间内变身为一个强大的恶魔化身，\n大幅提升攻击和防御，代价是之后被拖入血肉熔炉并被迫为自由而战。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"赋予你杀戮化身能力，允许你在短时间内变身为一个强大的恶魔化身，\n大幅提升攻击和防御，代价是之后被拖入血肉熔炉并被迫为自由而战。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of the fanatic mutation","english_description":"Grants you the Vessel of Slaughter ability, allowing you to transform into a\npowerful demonic avatar with greatly boosted offence and defence for a short\nperiod of time, in exchange for being dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh\nafterward and made to fight for your freedom.","english_source_name":"mark of the fanatic mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of the fanatic mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1433；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:868" |

The second level of this mutation completely blocks\npotion-based healing. (Aid from the god Gozag is unaffected.)","english_source_name":"no potion heal mutation","identity":"mutation_description:no potion heal mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。weakness stinger的orange误写红色；no potion heal二级仅阻断恢复生命值的效果，却写完全阻断药水疗效；MUT_NO_DRINK消失后的drink写饮酒，恢复的是饮用药水能力。 采用的逐键修复：no potion heal mutation：weakness stinger的orange误写红色；no potion heal二级仅阻断恢复生命值的效果，却写完全阻断药水疗效；MUT_NO_DRINK消失后的drink写饮酒，恢复的是饮用药水能力。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:484；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:345；crawl-ref/source/mutation-data.h:2169；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:9136；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:9190；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:2265；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:285；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:176 原发现：M13" |
| `mutation_description:no potions mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You are unable to quaff potions.","english_source_name":"no potions mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你无法饮用药水。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你无法饮用药水。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"no potions mutation","english_description":"You are unable to quaff potions.","english_source_name":"no potions mutation","identity":"mutation_description:no potions mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。无法饮用药水完整；形态通用cannot drink的具体对象由此说明。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1516；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:720" |
| `mutation_description:no regeneration mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You do not regenerate health while resting, and are unable to receive the\neffects of magic that hastens the speed of regeneration. Sources of HP gain\nsuch as potions and religious invocations will still heal you, and certain\ndivine invocations can temporarily grant you the ability to regenerate.\nTo compensate, you are able to heal yourself via the\n<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> key, at the cost of permanent MP.","english_source_name":"no regeneration mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你在休息时无法恢复健康，也无法获得提升恢复速度的魔法效果。\n至于提升生命力的手段，像药水和虔诚的祈祷仍能治疗你，\n某些神圣祈祷能力可以短暂赋予你自愈的能力。\n作为补偿，你可以通过<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 键治疗自己，\n但代价是要永久地失去一些法力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你在休息时无法恢复健康，也无法获得提升恢复速度的魔法效果。\n至于提升生命力的手段，像药水和虔诚的祈祷仍能治疗你，\n某些神圣祈祷能力可以短暂赋予你自愈的能力。\n作为补偿，你可以通过<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 键治疗自己，\n但代价是要永久地失去一些法力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"no regeneration mutation","english_description":"You do not regenerate health while resting, and are unable to receive the\neffects of magic that hastens the speed of regeneration. If\nyou perform a melee attack shortly thereafter, you will spray hazardous clouds\nin a wide line in the direction of your attack, whose quantity and duration are\nincreased by your Shapeshifting skill.\n\nThe type of cloud created depends on the potion drank:\n\n Mist and Curing: Blinding Haze\n\nBerserk Rage: Flame\n\nMutation: Mutagenic Fog\n\nAll Others: Noxious Fumes\n","english_source_name":"potion clouds mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你喝下药水，其蒸气都会在你的鬃毛内发生转化。\n如果你随后不久发动近战攻击，就会向攻击方向喷出一条宽阔的有害云带，\n其数量和持续时间随变形术技能提升而增加。\n\n生成的云类型取决于喝下的药水：\n\n 雾和治疗：致盲浓雾\n\n狂暴：火焰\n\n变异：诱变雾气\n\n其他所有药水：毒烟\n","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你喝下药水，其蒸气都会在你的鬃毛内发生转化。\n如果你随后不久发动近战攻击，就会向攻击方向喷出一条宽阔的有害云带，\n其数量和持续时间随变形术技能提升而增加。\n\n生成的云类型取决于喝下的药水：\n\n 雾和治疗：致盲浓雾\n\n狂暴：火焰\n\n变异：诱变雾气\n\n其他所有药水：毒烟\n","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"potion clouds mutation","english_description":"Whenever you drink a potion, vapours from it are transmuted within your mane. | `mutation_description:spark swarm mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"A subtle flock of eager sparks and bright cinders chases after your movements.\nWhenever you deal fire damage to a foe without rFire∞ or electric damage to a\nfoe without rElec∞, you have a chance to outline it with a soft glow of light,\nwhich makes it easier to hit and reveals it if invisible. | `mutation_description:spatial entanglement mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you translocate, there is a chance that another monster is pulled\nalong to your new location. | `mutation_description:trickster mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your connection to the realm of the living grows stronger as you spread\nmisfortune.\n\nWhenever you or your allies inflict new negative status effects upon nearby\nenemies (other than poison), your AC temporarily increases. This bonus improves\nwith the number of different enemies affected, but will decay over time if you\ndo not continue to inflict new misfortune.\n\nAt your current XL, you can gain a maximum bonus of\n{{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} AC this way.","english_source_name":"trickster mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你散播不幸时，与生者领域的联系会变强。\n\n每当你或盟友对附近敌人施加新的负面状态（中毒除外）时，你的护甲等级会暂时提高。\n受影响的不同敌人越多，加成越高；若不继续施加新的不幸，加成会随时间衰减。\n\n以你当前的经验等级，此方式最多可获得\n{{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} 点护甲等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你散播不幸时，与生者领域的联系会变强。\n\n每当你或盟友对附近敌人施加新的负面状态（中毒除外）时，你的护甲等级会暂时提高。\n受影响的不同敌人越多，加成越高；若不继续施加新的不幸，加成会随时间衰减。\n\n以你当前的经验等级，此方式最多可获得\n{{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} 点护甲等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"trickster mutation","english_description":"Your connection to the realm of the living grows stronger as you spread\nmisfortune.\n\nWhenever you or your allies inflict new negative status effects upon nearby\nenemies (other than poison), your AC temporarily increases. This bonus improves\nwith the number of different enemies affected, but will decay over time if you\ndo not continue to inflict new misfortune.\n\nAt your current XL, you can gain a maximum bonus of\n{{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} AC this way.","english_source_name":"trickster mutation","identity":"mutation_description:trickster mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:981；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1275" |
| `mutation_description:undead mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You are fully undead, granting you immunity to poison, miasma, fear, sleep,\nnegative energy, torment, drowning, and the effects of spore attacks.\n\nYour form cannot be further changed by magical means, protecting you from\npolymorph, but also preventing you from wearing talismans. | `mutation_description:water reaching mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your body is formed of elemental water that changes shape flexibly, allowing you\nto reach and perform melee attacks from several tiles away - including auxiliary\nattacks of all sorts.\n\nThe precision required to preform stab attacks is still impossible unless you're\nadjacent to your target, and axes can only cleave to enemies adjacent to you,\nregardless of where you strike.","english_source_name":"water reaching mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你的身体由能灵活变形的元素水构成，可以从数格外发动近战攻击，\n包括各种辅助攻击。\n\n偷袭所需的精确动作仍只能在与目标相邻时完成；无论从哪里攻击，\n斧头也只能顺劈到与你相邻的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的身体由能灵活变形的元素水构成，可以从数格外发动近战攻击，\n包括各种辅助攻击。\n\n偷袭所需的精确动作仍只能在与目标相邻时完成；无论从哪里攻击，\n斧头也只能顺劈到与你相邻的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"water reaching mutation","english_description":"Your body is formed of elemental water that changes shape flexibly, allowing you\nto reach and perform melee attacks from several tiles away - including auxiliary\nattacks of all sorts.\n\nThe precision required to preform stab attacks is still impossible unless you're\nadjacent to your target, and axes can only cleave to enemies adjacent to you,\nregardless of where you strike.","english_source_name":"water reaching mutation","identity":"mutation_description:water reaching mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。数格近战及全部辅助攻击、仅相邻偷袭、斧头只顺劈自身邻敌三个界限完整。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1131；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1301" |

| `mutation_description:weakness stinger mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You have a thin, orange tail, allowing you to attack foes when launching melee\nattacks. | `mutation_description:werefury mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you kill an enemy with a melee attack, you gain a temporary slaying\nbonus that increases with your Shapeshifting skill.\n\nThis bonus stacks up to +12 and will not expire so long as you continue to\nperform melee attacks.","english_source_name":"werefury mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你用近战攻击杀死敌人时，会获得随变形术技能提高的临时杀戮加成。\n\n此加成最多叠加至 +12；只要你继续发动近战攻击，就不会消失。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你用近战攻击杀死敌人时，会获得随变形术技能提高的临时杀戮加成。\n\n此加成最多叠加至 +12；只要你继续发动近战攻击，就不会消失。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"werefury mutation","english_description":"Whenever you kill an enemy with a melee attack, you gain a temporary slaying\nbonus that increases with your Shapeshifting skill.\n\nThis bonus stacks up to +12 and will not expire so long as you continue to\nperform melee attacks.","english_source_name":"werefury mutation","identity":"mutation_description:werefury mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。近战击杀、临时随技能增长的杀戮、最多+12、持续近战维持全部保留。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1172；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1314" |
| `mutation_description:werehowl mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"When you kill an enemy in melee, if your werefury bonus is at least 5, you may\nunleash a terrifying howl that attempts to freeze all nearby enemies in place\nwith fear if it overcomes their willpower.","english_source_name":"werehowl mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"当你在近战中杀死敌人时，若狼人狂怒加成至少为 5，你可能会发出恐怖嚎叫；\n若能克服附近敌人的意志力，就会尝试以恐惧将它们全部定在原地。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你在近战中杀死敌人时，若狼人狂怒加成至少为 5，你可能会发出恐怖嚎叫；\n若能克服附近敌人的意志力，就会尝试以恐惧将它们全部定在原地。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"werehowl mutation","english_description":"When you kill an enemy in melee, if your werefury bonus is at least 5, you may\nunleash a terrifying howl that attempts to freeze all nearby enemies in place\nwith fear if it overcomes their willpower.","english_source_name":"werehowl mutation","identity":"mutation_description:werehowl mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。近战击杀且狼人狂怒≥5、概率嚎叫、克服意志使附近敌人因恐惧定身完整。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1180；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1320" |
| `mutation_description:west wind's embodiment mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you rampage towards foes while wielding a ranged weapon, you also fire\na penetrating shot that does increased damage and your next normal attack\nbecomes empowered to fire at multiple foes at once.","english_source_name":"west wind's embodiment mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你持握远程武器向敌人冲锋时，还会射出一发伤害更高的穿透射击，\n并强化你的下一次普通攻击，使其能够同时射击多个敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你持握远程武器向敌人冲锋时，还会射出一发伤害更高的穿透射击，\n并强化你的下一次普通攻击，使其能够同时射击多个敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"west wind's embodiment mutation","english_description":"Whenever you rampage towards foes while wielding a ranged weapon, you also fire\na penetrating shot that does increased damage and your next normal attack\nbecomes empowered to fire at multiple foes at once.","english_source_name":"west wind's embodiment mutation","identity":"mutation_description:west wind's embodiment mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1043；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1349" |
| `mutation_description:wild magic mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your spells are slightly harder to cast (increased miscast chance and severity),\nbut more powerful. Each level of this mutation increases both effects further.","english_source_name":"wild magic mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你的法术将略难施放（施法失误的概率及后果严重程度提高），但威力会变强。\n这个变异每升一级，两方面的效果都会增强。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的法术将略难施放（施法失误的概率及后果严重程度提高），但威力会变强。\n这个变异每升一级，两方面的效果都会增强。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"wild magic mutation","english_description":"Your spells are slightly harder to cast (increased miscast chance and severity),\nbut more powerful. | `status_description:-gavotte status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Gravity around you is still unstable, and you cannot cast Gell's Gavotte again\nuntil it settles back down.","english_source_name":"-gavotte status"} | {"chinese_description":"你周围的重力仍然不稳定，在它重新稳定之前无法再次施放盖尔之加沃特。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你周围的重力仍然不稳定，在它重新稳定之前无法再次施放盖尔之加沃特。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-gavotte status","english_description":"Gravity around you is still unstable, and you cannot cast Gell's Gavotte again\nuntil it settles back down.","english_source_name":"-gavotte status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-gavotte status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_GAVOTTE_COOLDOWN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。重力尚未稳定、稳定后方可重施的条件完整；盖尔专名及加沃特舞名存在音译选择，不据词表决定唯一正译。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:944；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:790；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:688" |
| `status_description:-gclaw status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have not yet harvested enough death to cast Grave Claw again.","english_source_name":"-gclaw status"} | {"chinese_description":"你尚未收集足够的死亡来再次施放墓爪。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你尚未收集足够的死亡来再次施放墓爪。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-gclaw status","english_description":"You have not yet harvested enough death to cast Grave Claw again.","english_source_name":"-gclaw status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-gclaw status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["status:STATUS_GRAVE_CLAW_UNAVAILABLE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。死亡收获不足导致不能重施，保留资源未够而非普通固定时间冷却的差别。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:969；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:786；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:934；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:935" |
| `status_description:-hellfire status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are unable to cast Hellfire Mortar again until the effect of your last cast\nends.","english_source_name":"-hellfire status"} | {"chinese_description":"在你上次施放的效果结束之前，无法再次施放地狱火迫击炮。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"在你上次施放的效果结束之前，无法再次施放地狱火迫击炮。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-hellfire status","english_description":"You are unable to cast Hellfire Mortar again until the effect of your last cast\nends.","english_source_name":"-hellfire status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-hellfire status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_HELLFIRE_MORTAR_COOLDOWN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。中文完整保留上次施法效果结束前不可重施。追查 cooldown_length 的注释明确该段覆盖最长残留熔岩，而 temp_change_terrain 确实生成持续熔岩；不能仅见两个时长相加就断言有与效果无关的尾段，撤回初稿的 Validation Gap。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1271；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:794；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:693；crawl-ref/source/spl-summoning.cc:3394；crawl-ref/source/spl-summoning.cc:3275；crawl-ref/source/spl-summoning.cc:3346" |
| `status_description:-hop status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Your legs are tired, and you are unable to hop. This status will only recover\nafter you spend several turns not moving. (Other actions, such as attacking or\ncasting spells, are fine.)","english_source_name":"-hop status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-hop status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_NO_HOP"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。腿疲惫、不能跳跃、必须累计不移动的回合、攻击与施法可继续均完整；“停下来休整”受括注限定，未独立宣称只能等待。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:650；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:551；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:637；crawl-ref/source/movement.cc:1270" |
| `status_description:-jolt status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have recently discharged a full-power jolt of electricity and cannot do this\nagain until you fully heal.","english_source_name":"-jolt status"} | {"chinese_description":"你最近释放了一次全强度的电流，必须完全恢复生命值后才能再次这样放电。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你最近释放了一次全强度的电流，必须完全恢复生命值后才能再次这样放电。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-jolt status","english_description":"You have recently discharged a full-power jolt of electricity and cannot do this\nagain until you fully heal.","english_source_name":"-jolt status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-jolt status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_EELJOLT_COOLDOWN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。全强度放电与生命回满后才能再次放电的关系明确；不把一般时间冷却误当充分条件。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1324；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1199；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:730；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1111" |
| `status_description:-lithotox status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Your lithotoxin has recently activated and will not do so again until you fully\nheal.","english_source_name":"-lithotox status"} | {"chinese_description":"你的石化毒素最近已触发，在生命值完全恢复前不会再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的石化毒素最近已触发，在生命值完全恢复前不会再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-lithotox status","english_description":"Your lithotoxin has recently activated and will not do so again until you fully\nheal.","english_source_name":"-lithotox status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-lithotox status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_MEDUSA_COOLDOWN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对了 lithotoxin 已经触发、必须恢复满生命值才能再次触发两个命题；激活和恢复条件均译对。机制证据确认该毒素能令中毒敌人石化，但术语不必逐字解释全部机制。“石毒素”可作为 lithotoxin 的简缩造词；本次未发现它造成确定错误含义或与其他机制混淆的证据，不能仅因词表使用“石化毒素”或后者更直观就判为错误。建议改为“石化毒素”并把“完全治愈”明确为生命值恢复，以改善可读性；这是非必改措辞建议。 本批采用：采纳清晰度建议，用当前石化毒素词根及生命值完全恢复的再次触发条件。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1193；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:798；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:725；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:191；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:966；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1102" |

| `status_description:-move status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You cannot walk, fly around, slither, etc. You can still take other actions,\nand can still be moved via translocations or by being pushed, pulled, and so on.","english_source_name":"-move status"} | {"chinese_description":"你无法行走、飞行、爬行等。\n但你仍能采取其他行动，也仍可通过位移效果或被推、被拉等方式移动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你无法行走、飞行、爬行等。\n但你仍能采取其他行动，也仍可通过位移效果或被推、被拉等方式移动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-move status","english_description":"You cannot walk, fly around, slither, etc. You can still take other actions,\nand can still be moved via translocations or by being pushed, pulled, and so on.","english_source_name":"-move status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-move status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_NO_MOMENTUM"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。slither 是蛇行/爬行，译为“滑翔”改变了移动方式；同时应把 translocations 保持为位移效果总称，而非只让读者想到瞬间移动这一术语。 本批采用：slither 译为爬行，translocations 保留为位移效果总称，并保留可采取其他行动。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:191；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:147；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:492；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:8874" |
| `status_description:-potion status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are unable to quaff potions.","english_source_name":"-potion status"} | {"chinese_description":"你无法饮用药水。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你无法饮用药水。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-potion status","english_description":"You are unable to quaff potions.","english_source_name":"-potion status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-potion status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["status:STATUS_NO_POTIONS"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。只禁止饮用药水，未扩张为禁用全部物品；可由多种机制激活同一通用状态。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:430；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:343；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:368；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:369" |
| `status_description:-recite status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have recently finished reciting Zin's laws, and cannot recite again for a\nshort duration.","english_source_name":"-recite status"} | {"chinese_description":"你刚吟诵完辛的律令，短时间内无法再吟诵了。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你刚吟诵完辛的律令，短时间内无法再吟诵了。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-recite status","english_description":"You have recently finished reciting Zin's laws, and cannot recite again for a\nshort duration.","english_source_name":"-recite status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-recite status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_RECITE_COOLDOWN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。辛的律令、吟诵刚结束、短时不能重用三点对应；专名“辛”不以字面善恶作为译名真伪依据。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:396；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:314；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:517" |
| `status_description:-regen status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Your normal health regeneration has stopped because you are aware of nearby\nthreatening enemies.","english_source_name":"-regen status"} | {"chinese_description":"你察觉到附近有构成威胁的敌人，因此常规生命值再生已停止。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你察觉到附近有构成威胁的敌人，因此常规生命值再生已停止。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-regen status","english_description":"Your normal health regeneration has stopped because you are aware of nearby\nthreatening enemies.","english_source_name":"-regen status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-regen status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["status:STATUS_REGENERATION"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。health regeneration 被泛化成“恢复健康”，未保留生命再生这一特定机制范围，容易被理解为包括药水治疗在内的一切恢复。player_regen 抑制自然再生，药水的直接加血路径独立；特洛格/吉瓦还存在再生例外，应另列源文限定债，不自行加写。 本批采用：按 coder 后续 EN 限定为常规生命值再生受阻，并明确察觉到附近有威胁敌人的原因，不扩大为禁止治疗。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:50；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:40；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1344；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1496；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1526；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc:123" |

| `status_description:-siphon status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have recently siphoned the essence of the living, and cannot do so again for\na short time.","english_source_name":"-siphon status"} | {"chinese_description":"你刚吸取过生者的精华，短时间内无法再次吸取它。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你刚吸取过生者的精华，短时间内无法再次吸取它。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-siphon status","english_description":"You have recently siphoned the essence of the living, and cannot do so again for\na short time.","english_source_name":"-siphon status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-siphon status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_SIPHON_COOLDOWN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。最近吸取生者精华与短时不能重用对应；末尾“它”虽可精炼，不造成对象或条件错认。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:873；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:757；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:704" |
| `status_description:-sirocco status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have recently cast Sirocco and cannot cast it again until you spend several\nturns without moving.","english_source_name":"-sirocco status"} | {"chinese_description":"你最近施放了灼热风，必须原地停留数回合才能再次施放。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你最近施放了灼热风，必须原地停留数回合才能再次施放。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-sirocco status","english_description":"You have recently cast Sirocco and cannot cast it again until you spend several\nturns without moving.","english_source_name":"-sirocco status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-sirocco status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_SIROCCO_COOLDOWN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。原地累计数回合后方可重施，与移动暂停冷却的实现相符；不是一般经过任意几回合即可重施。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1329；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1203；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:818；crawl-ref/source/movement.cc:1274" |

| `status_description:-vortex status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are surrounded by unstable winds, and cannot recast Polar Vortex for a short\nduration.","english_source_name":"-vortex status"} | {"chinese_description":"你周围的风仍不稳定，短时间内无法再次施放极地旋涡。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你周围的风仍不稳定，短时间内无法再次施放极地旋涡。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-vortex status","english_description":"You are surrounded by unstable winds, and cannot recast Polar Vortex for a short\nduration.","english_source_name":"-vortex status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-vortex status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_VORTEX_COOLDOWN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。winds 被译成“云”，把风的紊乱改成了云的紊乱；冷却说明的实体错误可直接据英语及到期“winds calm down”确认。 本批采用：将云改回风，并保留短时无法重施。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:346；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:272；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:454" |

| `status_description:bat status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have been transformed into a swift-moving bat, increasing your evasion but\nsubstantially weakening your melee attacks.\n\nAny equipped weapons, armour and rings are melded, and you are unable to cast\nspells. | `status_description:bearserk status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are filled with barbearic rage! You'll bid furwell to this status very quickly unless you\nare attacking, and when it expires you will be slowed and unable to bearserk\nagain for a short duration.","english_source_name":"bearserk status"} | {"chinese_description":"你充满了熊熊怒火！\n你的速度变快，能造成灰熊般的重击，生命值得到大幅提升，\n但除了移动和重击敌人外无法做其他事情。\n除非你在攻击怪物，否则此状态很快会消失。\n当熊暴结束后，使用者将被减速，并且短时间内无法再次熊暴。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你充满了熊熊怒火！\n你的速度变快，能造成灰熊般的重击，生命值得到大幅提升，\n但除了移动和重击敌人外无法做其他事情。\n除非你在攻击怪物，否则此状态很快会消失。\n当熊暴结束后，使用者将被减速，并且短时间内无法再次熊暴。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"bearserk status","english_description":"You are filled with barbearic rage! The ferocious\nenergy pulsing through your limbs keeps you ready to kill.","english_source_name":"beast status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:beast status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `defer terminology` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对 EN 的毛茸茸兽化形体、凶猛能量流经四肢及随时准备杀戮。首段中文基本传达画面。已确认的 Needs Fix 是中文另有整段“任何手套、披风、帽子和靴子都会被融合”，当前 EN 没有这项机制声明；这是直接可证的 EN/ZH 内容不对等，不能被历史资料缺失掩盖。应删除这项无当前英文依据的额外声明。另有独立的 Validation Gap：当前 forms YAML、formdata 和 Form 注册表均无 beast，未取得该文本对应历史版本的实现，故不能断言新增装备段在历史上为假，也不能借狼人、刺毛或词表替代历史证据。帮助目录仍会列出此文本。历史 were-beast 身份与机制的进一步术语裁决保持暂缓；已确认的额外段落修正不必等待历史真伪查明。 本批采用：仅删当前 EN 没有的整段装备融合断言；首段保留。历史 were-beast 身份及对应版本机制仍待证，不作真假推断。 保留值以本卡current_chinese正文为准；负责：translation owner with historical Beast source maintainer；重入：取得该 Beast 文本对应版本的实现/设计来源，或恢复 Beast 时同步重审 EN/ZH。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:483；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:395；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:483；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:395；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h:7；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1559；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527" |
| `status_description:beogh status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You can swear fealty to Beogh, the god of all orcs, through a nearby priest.\nTo do so, use the Convert to Beogh ability in the ability menu.","english_source_name":"beogh status"} | {"chinese_description":"你可以通过附近的祭司，向所有兽人之神比欧弗宣誓效忠。\n要这样做，请在<white>能力</white>菜单中使用<white>皈依比欧弗</white>能力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你可以通过附近的祭司，向所有兽人之神比欧弗宣誓效忠。\n要这样做，请在<white>能力</white>菜单中使用<white>皈依比欧弗</white>能力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"beogh status","english_description":"You can swear fealty to Beogh, the god of all orcs, through a nearby priest.\nTo do so, use the Convert to Beogh ability in the ability menu.","english_source_name":"beogh status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:beogh status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["status:STATUS_BEOGH"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `retranslate` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。英语是所有兽人之神且指明使用 Convert to Beogh 能力；中文限为洞穴兽人并硬编码 Y，未保留操作对象，动态能力热键并非这段正文可固定的常量。 本批采用：所有兽人之神；使用当前菜单“皈依比欧弗”能力，删除硬编码 Y，并保留两组 white 标记。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:697；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:596；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:669；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:670；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:760；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:4330；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:4532；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:4564；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:4631；crawl-ref/source/adjust.cc:217；crawl-ref/source/dat/i18n/zh/source.txt:33473" |
| `status_description:berserk status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are hasted, deal increased damage in combat, and have increased health, but\nare unable to perform most actions other than moving and attacking in melee.\nThe status will wear off very quickly unless you are attacking monsters, and\nwhen it expires you will be slowed and unable to berserk again for a short\nduration.","english_source_name":"berserk status"} | {"chinese_description":"你的速度、近战伤害和生命值都有所提升，\n但除了移动和近战攻击，无法进行其他大多数动作。\n除非你在攻击怪物，否则此状态很快会消失。\n当狂暴结束后，使用者将被减速，短时间内无法再次狂暴。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的速度、近战伤害和生命值都有所提升，\n但除了移动和近战攻击，无法进行其他大多数动作。\n除非你在攻击怪物，否则此状态很快会消失。\n当狂暴结束后，使用者将被减速，短时间内无法再次狂暴。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"berserk status","english_description":"You are hasted, deal increased damage in combat, and have increased health, but\nare unable to perform most actions other than moving and attacking in melee.\nThe status will wear off very quickly unless you are attacking monsters, and\nwhen it expires you will be slowed and unable to berserk again for a short\nduration.","english_source_name":"berserk status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:berserk status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_BERSERK"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。完整保留加速、近战增伤、生命提升、除移动/近战外大多数动作受限、不攻击时迅速消退及事后减速/冷却。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:74；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:56；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186" |

| `status_description:brill status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are unnaturally smart, and gain a bonus to the power of your spells as well\nas halving their magic cost (rounding up).","english_source_name":"brill status"} | {"chinese_description":"你聪明异常，法术的威力增强，同时其消耗的法力减半（四舍五入）。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你聪明异常，法术的威力增强，同时其消耗的法力减半（四舍五入）。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"brill status","english_description":"You are unnaturally smart, and gain a bonus to the power of your spells as well\nas halving their magic cost (rounding up).","english_source_name":"brill status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:brill status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_BRILLIANCE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。原文 rounding up 更宜译“向上取整”；但当前法力消耗为整数再减半，只出现整数或半整数，四舍五入与向上取整在这个输入域给出相同结果。因此记为表达精确性建议，不声称实际消耗计算被译错。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:36；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:28；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/spl-util.cc:1048" |
| `status_description:bullseye status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have targeted an enemy with a dimensional bullseye, causing missiles fired\nor thrown at a different enemy to also be teleported at the target.","english_source_name":"bullseye status"} | {"chinese_description":"你已用次元靶心标记了一名敌人。向其他敌人发射或投掷的弹药\n也会被传送过去，攻击这名被标记的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你已用次元靶心标记了一名敌人。向其他敌人发射或投掷的弹药\n也会被传送过去，攻击这名被标记的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"bullseye status","english_description":"You have targeted an enemy with a dimensional bullseye, causing missiles fired\nor thrown at a different enemy to also be teleported at the target.","english_source_name":"bullseye status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:bullseye status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_DIMENSIONAL_BULLSEYE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。missiles fired or thrown at a different enemy “also” 传向标记者，中文没有“也”且重复“会”，易把追加投射写成单纯改道。 本批采用：明确向其他敌人发射或投掷的弹药也会攻击标记目标，保留追加关系。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:409；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:326；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:541；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:542；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2547；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2639" |
| `status_description:cacophony status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are noisily attacking with all of your armour. | `status_description:death status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have been transformed into an undying offence against life itself.\n\nFoes struck by your hands or melee weapons are weakened, slowed, and drained,\nand you can heal yourself by tormenting living foes nearby. You also resist\ncold, have enhanced willpower, and are immune to poison, miasma, negative\nenergy, and torment. Unfortunately, you are vulnerable to holy damage and\nDispel Undead, and cannot consume potions.","english_source_name":"death status"} | {"chinese_description":"你变成了不死之物，其存在本身就是对生命的亵渎。\n\n被你的双手或近战武器击中的敌人会变得虚弱、迟缓，并被汲取生命力，\n你还可以通过折磨附近的活物敌人来治疗自己。\n此外，你能抵抗寒冷，意志力得到增强，并免疫毒、瘴气、负能量和折磨。\n不幸的是，你易受神圣伤害和驱散亡灵的伤害，且无法饮用药水。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你变成了不死之物，其存在本身就是对生命的亵渎。\n\n被你的双手或近战武器击中的敌人会变得虚弱、迟缓，并被汲取生命力，\n你还可以通过折磨附近的活物敌人来治疗自己。\n此外，你能抵抗寒冷，意志力得到增强，并免疫毒、瘴气、负能量和折磨。\n不幸的是，你易受神圣伤害和驱散亡灵的伤害，且无法饮用药水。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"death status","english_description":"You have been transformed into an undying offence against life itself.\n\nFoes struck by your hands or melee weapons are weakened, slowed, and drained,\nand you can heal yourself by tormenting living foes nearby. Unfortunately, you are vulnerable to holy damage and\nDispel Undead, and cannot consume potions.","english_source_name":"death status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:death status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对了 undying offence against life itself 的不死/生命亵渎比喻，近战虚弱/减速/衰竭、折磨附近活敌回血、寒抗/意志提升/四项免疫、神圣与驱散亡灵弱点及禁药水。所有机制命题在中文中均保留，draining 也没有误作吸血。英文自己把变形结果比作 undying offence，中文以“你”为主语的“永恒冒犯”仍能传达这一比喻，不能据此断定把实体误译成了其他东西。“被虚弱”较生硬，但在被施加状态的游戏语境中，与并列的被减速/被衰竭一样可理解，未造成确定的效果误述。建议显化不死之物并改成自然状态谓语，属于表达优化，不是事实纠错。 本批采用：采纳表达建议，显化不死实体；自然表达虚弱、迟缓和生命力汲取，保留所有抗性、弱点、治疗与禁药条件。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:559；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:480；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/death.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:833；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:1173；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:2961；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1851；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:7423" |

| `status_description:destr+++ status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"[[Destr status]]\nIf you use it again, it will unleash a salvo of additional bolts aimed at random\ntargets and this bonus will reset.","english_source_name":"destr+++ status"} | {"chinese_description":"[[Destr status]]\n如果你再次使用此能力，还会向随机目标追加一轮毁灭魔法齐射，随后这项加成重置。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"[[Destr status]]\n如果你再次使用此能力，还会向随机目标追加一轮毁灭魔法齐射，随后这项加成重置。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"destr+++ status","english_description":"[[Destr status]]\nIf you use it again, it will unleash a salvo of additional bolts aimed at random\ntargets and this bonus will reset.","english_source_name":"destr+++ status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:destr+++ status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。附加 bolts 是毁灭魔法投射，不是弩射弹药；中文“弩箭”误指物理武器。额外齐射、随机目标、随后重置均应保留。 本批采用：保留 [[Destr status]]；额外 bolts 为毁灭魔法齐射，保留随机目标和加成重置。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1001；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:889；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:6920；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:6993；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:6821" |

"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。逐个核对 Draconian、Grey、Red、White、Green、其他种族 Lua 分支，及公共近战/生命/闪避尾句。明确 ZH 错误：Red/White 把“高火/寒抗而普通毒抗”合成“对火/寒和毒有很强的抗性”，非龙人分支也混淆两档抗性；末尾另有 EN 无的装备段。然而当前 FormDragon 非龙人对应 golden dragon、只按 golden 返回火/寒各1，species::dragon_form 还列灰龙人的 iron dragon 和泥吐息，与 EN 所描述的旧火龙/寒弱点等不一致。故不可仅照旧 EN 修成可落地中文。公共伤害高、健壮、闪避降低和 physical 融合仍有支持。 本批采用：按 coder 最终 EN 同步 Lua：全部毒抗；非龙人/基础 Draconian 另获火寒抗；非龙人金龙吐息；有色（含 Grey）龙人先天吐息增强；删除旧色彩抗性/弱点/装备段，保留公共伤害/健壮/闪避尾句。 原实现延期已由源码追踪及中英成对修正闭环；参见 transform.cc、status.cc、player.cc、melee-attack.cc 和本批实际正文/查库测试。 | `status_description:elixir status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Your health and/or magic are being rapidly restored, as well as the health of\nyour allies.","english_source_name":"elixir status"} | {"chinese_description":"你的生命值和/或法力正在快速恢复，盟友的生命值也在快速恢复。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的生命值和/或法力正在快速恢复，盟友的生命值也在快速恢复。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"elixir status","english_description":"Your health and/or magic are being rapidly restored, as well as the health of\nyour allies.","english_source_name":"elixir status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:elixir status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_ELIXIR"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。恢复玩家生命／法力及盟友生命的三项范围保留，但“健康／魔法”用词不像数值资源，建议改成生命值／法力；不将可理解的旧表达强判完全误义。 本批采用：采纳资源名建议：玩家生命值和/或法力，以及盟友生命值快速恢复。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:725；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:622；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:655；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:656" |

| `status_description:fire status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are covered with sticky fire, which causes damage over a moderate duration.\nMoving will quell the fire much more rapidly, and entering water will extinguish\nit immediately.","english_source_name":"fire status"} | {"chinese_description":"你身上附着黏性火焰，会在一段适中的时间内持续受到伤害。\n移动能大幅加快火焰熄灭，进入水中则会立即将其扑灭。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你身上附着黏性火焰，会在一段适中的时间内持续受到伤害。\n移动能大幅加快火焰熄灭，进入水中则会立即将其扑灭。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"fire status","english_description":"You are covered with sticky fire, which causes damage over a moderate duration.\nMoving will quell the fire much more rapidly, and entering water will extinguish\nit immediately.","english_source_name":"fire status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:fire status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_STICKY_FLAME"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。“over a moderate duration”和“much more rapidly”的时长与程度均被弱化为一段时间/更快，按完整性要求应保留；进入水中立即熄灭已正确。 本批采用：保留适中持续时间、移动大幅加快灭火、水中立即灭火三项。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:202；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:157；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:5194；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:5229" |
