| `status_description:flux status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are unstable at a fundamental level. You inflict dangerous levels of\nmagical contamination on foes with each touch. Sufficient contamination\ncauses a highly localised meltdown, dealing enormous damage.\n\nHowever, this instability makes you unable to use weapons, shields, or\nbody armour. You also glow, reducing stealth and preventing invisibility,\nand you do less damage in melee, as your limbs sometimes destabilise mid-swing.","english_source_name":"flux status"} | {"chinese_description":"你的身体从根本上就不稳定。每次触碰敌人，都会给它们带来危险程度的魔法污染。\n污染积累到足够程度时，便会在极小范围内引发熔毁，造成巨额伤害。\n\n然而，这种不稳定也使你无法使用武器、盾牌或躯干护甲。你还会发光，\n降低潜行能力并使你无法隐形。由于肢体有时会在挥击途中失稳，\n你的近战伤害也会降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的身体从根本上就不稳定。每次触碰敌人，都会给它们带来危险程度的魔法污染。\n污染积累到足够程度时，便会在极小范围内引发熔毁，造成巨额伤害。\n\n然而，这种不稳定也使你无法使用武器、盾牌或躯干护甲。你还会发光，\n降低潜行能力并使你无法隐形。由于肢体有时会在挥击途中失稳，\n你的近战伤害也会降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"flux status","english_description":"You are unstable at a fundamental level. You inflict dangerous levels of\nmagical contamination on foes with each touch. Sufficient contamination\ncauses a highly localised meltdown, dealing enormous damage.\n\nHowever, this instability makes you unable to use weapons, shields, or\nbody armour. You also glow, reducing stealth and preventing invisibility,\nand you do less damage in melee, as your limbs sometimes destabilise mid-swing.","english_source_name":"flux status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:flux status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `retranslate` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对根本层面的不稳定、每次触碰污染、累计污染引起局部 meltdown 巨额伤害、不能用武器/盾/躯干甲、发光降低潜行且禁隐形、挥击途中肢体失稳导致近战减伤。ZH 的“基面上”误读 fundamental level 为几何基面；“局部高度熔融”把 highly localised 误作熔融程度高；“摇摆不定”只表达摇晃而丢失形体失稳。污染触发伤害/恶性变异及半伤代码支持魔法失稳，不支持几何/温度说明。应重译两段，保留全部限制，不把固有装备 gloves 融合差异冒充中文遗漏。 本批采用：修复 fundamental level、highly localised 和肢体失稳误读；完整保留污染、伤害及三类装备、潜行、隐形、近战限制。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:488；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:401；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/flux.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:611；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:716；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:1014；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:2949" |
| `status_description:fly status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are flying above the ground, and are able to cross water and lava or fight\nabove shallow water without penalties. Most types of flight will time out – be\ncareful what you are above when that happens!","english_source_name":"fly status"} | {"chinese_description":"你俯瞰地面，飞翔在空中，可以飞过水域和熔岩，或在浅水上不受影响地战斗。\n大多数飞行能力有时间限制，快到时间的时候，可得当心飞在什么上面！","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你俯瞰地面，飞翔在空中，可以飞过水域和熔岩，或在浅水上不受影响地战斗。\n大多数飞行能力有时间限制，快到时间的时候，可得当心飞在什么上面！","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"fly status","english_description":"You are flying above the ground, and are able to cross water and lava or fight\nabove shallow water without penalties. Most types of flight will time out – be\ncareful what you are above when that happens!","english_source_name":"fly status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:fly status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["status:STATUS_AIRBORNE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。保留跨水/熔岩、浅水作战不受相关惩罚、大多数飞行有时限及到期地形风险；“大多数”未丢失。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:26；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:19；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186" |
| `status_description:forest status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are calling a forested plane into temporary existence, and awakening nearby\ntrees to damage your foes.","english_source_name":"forest status"} | {"chinese_description":"你在召唤暂时存在的森林位面，并会唤醒周围的树攻击你的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你在召唤暂时存在的森林位面，并会唤醒周围的树攻击你的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"forest status","english_description":"You are calling a forested plane into temporary existence, and awakening nearby\ntrees to damage your foes.","english_source_name":"forest status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:forest status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_FORESTED"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。暂时召来森林位面并唤醒邻树伤敌，召来对象和攻击者清楚；没有让玩家自己变树。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:414；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:330；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:546" |
| `status_description:fragile status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Your body is as fragile and brittle as glass, increasing the damage you take from\nall sources.","english_source_name":"fragile status"} | {"chinese_description":"你的身体像玻璃一样易碎而脆弱，你受到的任何来源的伤害都会增加。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的身体像玻璃一样易碎而脆弱，你受到的任何来源的伤害都会增加。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"fragile status","english_description":"Your body is as fragile and brittle as glass, increasing the damage you take from\nall sources.","english_source_name":"fragile status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:fragile status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_VITRIFIED"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。英语是任何来源的伤害，中文改成任何来源的“攻击”，遗漏非攻击伤害；伤害结算处统一的易碎增伤支持保留 damage 范围。 本批采用：范围明确为所有来源的伤害，不局限为攻击。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:854；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:740；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:337；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1366" |

At the maximum bonus,\nfoes adjacent to your attacks' targets suffer pain damage.","english_source_name":"fugue status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:fugue status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_FUGUE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。亡魂暂时强化武器、击杀叠加杀戮、满层伤相邻敌人的痛楚效果完整；“被诅咒的灵魂”是叙述处境，未声称武器获得装备诅咒机制。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:374；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:296；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:608；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:473；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:474" |
| `status_description:fungus status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have been transformed into a sentient fungus. You are highly evasive and\ncan release spores to confuse breathing creatures when attacking in melee,\nbut can become too terrified to move when threatening enemies are nearby.\n\nAny equipped weapons and armour are melded, and you are unable to cast spells.\nThe effectiveness of your melee attacks while in this form is based on\nexperience level instead of on Unarmed Combat skill.","english_source_name":"fungus status"} | {"chinese_description":"你变成了有意识的真菌。你的闪避能力很高，近战攻击时能释放孢子，\n使需要呼吸的生物陷入混乱，但附近有构成威胁的敌人时，你可能会吓得无法移动。\n\n装备的武器和护甲都会被融合，且无法施展法术。\n在这种形态下，你的近战攻击效果取决于经验等级，而非徒手格斗技能。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你变成了有意识的真菌。你的闪避能力很高，近战攻击时能释放孢子，\n使需要呼吸的生物陷入混乱，但附近有构成威胁的敌人时，你可能会吓得无法移动。\n\n装备的武器和护甲都会被融合，且无法施展法术。\n在这种形态下，你的近战攻击效果取决于经验等级，而非徒手格斗技能。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"fungus status","english_description":"You have been transformed into a sentient fungus. You are highly evasive and\ncan release spores to confuse breathing creatures when attacking in melee,\nbut can become too terrified to move when threatening enemies are nearby.\n\nAny equipped weapons and armour are melded, and you are unable to cast spells.\nThe effectiveness of your melee attacks while in this form is based on\nexperience level instead of on Unarmed Combat skill.","english_source_name":"fungus status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:fungus status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `retranslate` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。逐段核对有意识真菌、高闪避、近战孢子混乱、敌在场时不能动、毒抗/负能免疫、武器护甲融合、禁施法、经验等级而非徒手技能。中文准确传达当前 EN；但 current YAML/生成 formdata 均为 MR_NO_FLAGS 且 MH_PLANT。Form::res_pois/res_neg 直接读该标记，player_res_poison 不把植物视作抗毒，player_prot_life 也不因植物直接给负能免疫；因此 EN/ZH 两者的抗性承诺无现行支持。行动条件实际还排除睡眠、混乱、无助等不构成威胁的敌人，不能把泛化描述当作精确条件。其他融合、施法、XL 和孢子效果已核对。 本批采用：按 coder 最终 EN 同步：混乱目标限需呼吸生物；有威胁敌人附近时可能因恐惧无法移动；删除无现行实现的毒抗/负能免疫，保留装备融合、禁法与 XL/徒手技能区别。 原实现延期已由源码追踪及中英成对修正闭环；参见 transform.cc、status.cc、player.cc、melee-attack.cc 和本批实际正文/查库测试。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:618；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:530；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/fungus.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h:358；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:447；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:463；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1851；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:2056；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:8880；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:1355" |
| `status_description:fusillade status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are hurling conjured alchemical reagents at nearby monsters.","english_source_name":"fusillade status"} | {"chinese_description":"你正在向附近的怪物投掷魔法炼金试剂。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你正在向附近的怪物投掷魔法炼金试剂。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"fusillade status","english_description":"You are hurling conjured alchemical reagents at nearby monsters.","english_source_name":"fusillade status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:fusillade status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_FUSILLADE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。向附近怪物投掷魔法炼金试剂的动作与对象完整；“魔法”可指试剂的生成来源，并未确认遗漏 conjured 的独立机制。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:949；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:944；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:423；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:424" |
| `status_description:gecko status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are a hypnogecko, a stealthy lizard who can shed their own tail as a decoy\nwhen badly injured.","english_source_name":"gecko status"} | {"chinese_description":"你是一只迷魂壁虎，善于潜行，严重受伤时能够脱落尾巴作为诱饵。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你是一只迷魂壁虎，善于潜行，严重受伤时能够脱落尾巴作为诱饵。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"gecko status","english_description":"You are a hypnogecko, a stealthy lizard who can shed their own tail as a decoy\nwhen badly injured.","english_source_name":"gecko status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:gecko status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对 hypnogecko 身份、壁虎/蜥蜴类形体、善潜行、严重受伤断尾诱敌。中文“迷魂壁虎”保留催眠意象和具体壁虎身份，断尾用途与条件齐全；“脱落尾巴”虽不如“断尾”顺畅，但不会把动作或作用读反，不作必改。配置和低血触发、尾巴精效支持命题。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1348；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1219；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/hypnogecko.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1010；crawl-ref/source/fineff.cc:2080；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1483" |
| `status_description:gem (*) status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"The power of Zot no longer hunts you, but this branch's gem still remains\nintact.","english_source_name":"gem (*) status"} | {"chinese_description":"佐特的力量不再追猎你，但这个分支的宝石仍然完好无损。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"佐特的力量不再追猎你，但这个分支的宝石仍然完好无损。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"gem (*) status","english_description":"The power of Zot no longer hunts you, but this branch's gem still remains\nintact.","english_source_name":"gem (*) status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:gem (*) status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。orb取得后佐特不再追猎而宝石尚完整的命题对应；当前HUD的Gem(*)显示仍以Gem为db_key，独立星号正文可从帮助查询，勿将正确正文误当已在该HUD分支使用。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:776；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:948；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1232" |
| `status_description:gem status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"If you spend the indicated number of turns in this branch, its gem will be found\nand shattered by the power of Zot.","english_source_name":"gem status"} | {"chinese_description":"如果你在这个分支上耗尽了指定的回合数，其中的宝石就会被佐特的力量发现并被粉碎。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"如果你在这个分支上耗尽了指定的回合数，其中的宝石就会被佐特的力量发现并被粉碎。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"gem status","english_description":"If you spend the indicated number of turns in this branch, its gem will be found\nand shattered by the power of Zot.","english_source_name":"gem status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:gem status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["status:STATUS_GEM"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。在该分支耗尽指定回合预算导致宝石被发现粉碎，条件完整；不是立刻摧毁所有分支宝石。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:771；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:667；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1237；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1243" |
| `status_description:heavenly status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are surrounded by a storm of heavenly clouds. While the storm rages, your\nevasion and combat accuracy and damage are substantially increased, and\nstriking enemies with martial attacks increases this bonus. The storm weakens\nover time and fades away once the bonus reaches zero. The heavenly clouds\nprevent invisibility, and obscure the vision of those outside the storm.","english_source_name":"heavenly status"} | {"chinese_description":"你被天云风暴环绕。风暴持续时，你的闪避、攻击命中率和伤害都会大幅提高，\n用武术攻击敌人还会继续增加这些加成。\n风暴会随时间减弱，加成降至零时便会消散。\n天云会使隐形失效，并遮蔽风暴外观察者的视线。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你被天云风暴环绕。风暴持续时，你的闪避、攻击命中率和伤害都会大幅提高，\n用武术攻击敌人还会继续增加这些加成。\n风暴会随时间减弱，加成降至零时便会消散。\n天云会使隐形失效，并遮蔽风暴外观察者的视线。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"heavenly status","english_description":"You are surrounded by a storm of heavenly clouds. While the storm rages, your\nevasion and combat accuracy and damage are substantially increased, and\nstriking enemies with martial attacks increases this bonus. The storm weakens\nover time and fades away once the bonus reaches zero. The heavenly clouds\nprevent invisibility, and obscure the vision of those outside the storm.","english_source_name":"heavenly status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:heavenly status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。风暴增强闪避命中伤害、随时间减退、云阻隐形及外部视野均保留；“武术攻击还会有加成”可更明确为继续增加现有加成，只作为清晰度建议。 本批采用：明确武术命中继续增加已有加成，保留时间衰减、归零消散、禁隐与遮蔽外部视野。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:677；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:576；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/god-passive.cc:1832；crawl-ref/source/god-passive.cc:1926；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:2373" |

| `status_description:hero status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Your combat skills are temporarily increased.","english_source_name":"hero status"} | {"chinese_description":"你的战斗技能暂时得到提升。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的战斗技能暂时得到提升。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"hero status","english_description":"Your combat skills are temporarily increased.","english_source_name":"hero status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:hero status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_HEROISM"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。Heroism 暂时提升战斗技能，中文匹配；特意与 Finesse 的攻击速度而非技能提升区分。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:356；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:280；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:444" |
| `status_description:hive status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are a living beehive, abuzz with busy insects.","english_source_name":"hive status"} | {"chinese_description":"你是一个活着的蜂巢，充满了忙碌的昆虫嗡鸣。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你是一个活着的蜂巢，充满了忙碌的昆虫嗡鸣。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"hive status","english_description":"You are a living beehive, abuzz with busy insects.","english_source_name":"hive status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:hive status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对活蜂巢形体、忙碌的昆虫和嗡鸣声三项。中文均传达；“充满了忙碌的昆虫嗡鸣”允许理解为昆虫在巢内嗡鸣，不把 hive 错当蜂群变形。“活着的”与 hive 仍保持自身活动和回血能力一致。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1150；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:952；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/hive.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1120；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:933" |
| `status_description:horr status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are terrified of nearby monsters, reducing your damage and accuracy in\ncombat as well as the power of your spells.","english_source_name":"horr status"} | {"chinese_description":"你害怕附近的怪物，你战斗中的攻击力、命中率和法术威力均被削弱。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你害怕附近的怪物，你战斗中的攻击力、命中率和法术威力均被削弱。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"horr status","english_description":"You are terrified of nearby monsters, reducing your damage and accuracy in\ncombat as well as the power of your spells.","english_source_name":"horr status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:horr status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_HORROR"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。附近怪物引起恐惧并降低攻击伤害命中及法术威力，三项削弱均保留；不是普通 Fear 的移动限制说明。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:446；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:359；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:786；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:592" |
| `status_description:howl status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"A terrifying howl is echoing in your mind, calling forth powerful creatures to\nattack you.","english_source_name":"howl status"} | {"chinese_description":"可怕的嚎叫回荡在你的脑海，呼唤着强大的生物攻击你。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"可怕的嚎叫回荡在你的脑海，呼唤着强大的生物攻击你。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"howl status","english_description":"A terrifying howl is echoing in your mind, calling forth powerful creatures to\nattack you.","english_source_name":"howl status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:howl status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_OBLIVION_HOWL"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。嚎叫回响脑海并召来强力生物攻击玩家，因果与敌对方向完整。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:469；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:379；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:617；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:618" |
| `status_description:indom status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are rapidly regenerating health (at a rate dependent on your max HP) until\nyou have healed the specified amount.","english_source_name":"indom status"} | {"chinese_description":"你正在快速恢复生命值，恢复速度取决于生命值上限，直到恢复指定的总量为止。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你正在快速恢复生命值，恢复速度取决于生命值上限，直到恢复指定的总量为止。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"indom status","english_description":"You are rapidly regenerating health (at a rate dependent on your max HP) until\nyou have healed the specified amount.","english_source_name":"indom status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:indom status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_INDOMITABLE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。恢复速率取决于生命上限且恢复到指定总量终止，两个数值对象明确；没有误写为恢复到指定当前生命值。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1305；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1183；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:917" |
| `status_description:insubst status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Your body is insubstantial, granting you immunity to constriction, petrification,\nbarbs, sticky flame, webs, nets, and being caught by bolas.","english_source_name":"insubst status"} | {"chinese_description":"你的身体已变为虚体，免疫束缚、石化、倒刺、黏着火焰、蛛网、网和流星索的缠缚。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的身体已变为虚体，免疫束缚、石化、倒刺、黏着火焰、蛛网、网和流星索的缠缚。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"insubst status","english_description":"Your body is insubstantial, granting you immunity to constriction, petrification,\nbarbs, sticky flame, webs, nets, and being caught by bolas.","english_source_name":"insubst status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:insubst status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_INSUBSTANTIAL"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对虚体，以及 constriction、petrification、barbs、sticky flame、webs、nets、bolas 七项免疫，中文七项齐全且分别保留。“束缚”在此对应 constriction 而非一切束缚的无限泛化，因为后文另列网具。已确认 is_insubstantial 涵盖 wisp/storm/持续效果，石化、缠绕、黏火、网具的相关判定使用它。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1358；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1227；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:821；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:7351；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:7471；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1907；crawl-ref/source/player-act.cc:777；crawl-ref/source/traps.cc:1077" |
| `status_description:invis status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are invisible. Most enemies will be unable to see you and will suffer\npenalties to hit, though they may be able to guess at your general location.\nIf the status is greyed out, it is active but ineffective for some reason (for\nexample if you are glowing with magical contamination or standing in shallow\nwater).","english_source_name":"invis status"} | {"chinese_description":"你隐形了。大多数敌人看不到你，命中率会降低，不过它们可能猜到你的大致位置。\n如果状态显示为灰色，表示它仍在持续，但因某种原因无法发挥效果\n（例如你因魔法污染而发光，或正站在浅水中）。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你隐形了。大多数敌人看不到你，命中率会降低，不过它们可能猜到你的大致位置。\n如果状态显示为灰色，表示它仍在持续，但因某种原因无法发挥效果\n（例如你因魔法污染而发光，或正站在浅水中）。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"invis status","english_description":"You are invisible. Most enemies will be unable to see you and will suffer\npenalties to hit, though they may be able to guess at your general location.\nIf the status is greyed out, it is active but ineffective for some reason (for\nexample if you are glowing with magical contamination or standing in shallow\nwater).","english_source_name":"invis status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:invis status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["status:STATUS_INVISIBLE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。中文额外声称隐形随时间造成魔法污染，且把灰色状态解释为仍在产生污染；英文没有这些命题。当前隐形药水只设置时长，污染周期逻辑亦不由隐形持续产污。保留隐形被发光或浅水等暴露的原文例子。 本批采用：删除现行 EN 没有的持续产污断言；保留看不见、命中惩罚、推测位置及灰色状态的两个例子。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:6；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:6；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc:454；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc:498；crawl-ref/source/timed-effects.cc:70；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1467" |
| `status_description:jade status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"A mass of elemental crystal shrouds your upper body, granting you increased\nskill with elemental magic and the ability to unleash it in a powerful burst.","english_source_name":"jade status"} | {"chinese_description":"大片元素晶体覆盖着你的上身，提高你对元素魔法的掌握，并让你能以强烈的爆发释放它们的力量。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"大片元素晶体覆盖着你的上身，提高你对元素魔法的掌握，并让你能以强烈的爆发释放它们的力量。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"jade status","english_description":"A mass of elemental crystal shrouds your upper body, granting you increased\nskill with elemental magic and the ability to unleash it in a powerful burst.","english_source_name":"jade status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:jade status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对元素晶体覆盖上半身、提升元素魔法技能、能以强劲爆发释放元素力量。中文三项齐全；“提高掌握”与 actual elemental skill bonus 相符，不是泛指施法速度。强劲爆发有晶体 surge 充能时伤害路径；源文没有写主动随时释放，中文也未擅自加此限制或权限。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1339；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1211；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/jademantle.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1430；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1475；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:3055" |
| `status_description:jelly status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have been temporarily transformed into a jelly. You have several unusual\nresistances and extra health, but heavily weakened spells.\n\nAny equipped weapons and armour are melded. The effectiveness of your\nnewly-acidic melee attacks while in this form is based on your experience level\nrather than Unarmed Combat skill.","english_source_name":"jelly status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:jelly status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。酸性软体形态、抗性、额外生命、法术变弱、物理装备融合、按经验等级而非徒手技能缩放均保留；“果冻”在此有拟生物语境，建议可用“软泥怪”增辨识，但不以食物字面义硬判整段错误。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1256；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:956；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/jelly.yaml:1" |
| `status_description:jinx status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Jinxing spirits encircle you. | `status_description:mark status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Your location is marked due to the effects of a trap or a spell, and monsters\nwill hunt you down more precisely and will be able to detect you even if you\nare not in their vision.","english_source_name":"mark status"} | {"chinese_description":"因踏入陷阱或被施法，你的位置被标示。\n怪物能更准确地追杀你，即使你不在其视线中，他们也能找到你。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"因踏入陷阱或被施法，你的位置被标示。\n怪物能更准确地追杀你，即使你不在其视线中，他们也能找到你。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"mark status","english_description":"Your location is marked due to the effects of a trap or a spell, and monsters\nwill hunt you down more precisely and will be able to detect you even if you\nare not in their vision.","english_source_name":"mark status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:mark status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_SENTINEL_MARK"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。保留陷阱或法术导致标记、怪物更准确追猎，以及离开其视野仍会被定位。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:196；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:152；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186" |
| `status_description:maw status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Your midsection has transformed into a giant mouth, gnashing and ready to devour\nfoes. The mouth may devour slain creatures, temporarily increasing your health\nregeneration. Your Shapeshifting skill increases this regeneration bonus and\nthe damage done by the maw. The mouth may devour slain creatures, temporarily increasing your health\nregeneration. Your Shapeshifting skill increases this regeneration bonus and\nthe damage done by the maw. More powerful creatures provide a longer-lasting\nregeneration bonus.","english_source_name":"maw status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:maw status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `retranslate` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对腹部巨口、咬合并准备吞敌、吞噬杀死的生物回血、技能及被吃生物力量影响治疗、技能提高巨口伤害。确定 ZH 错误：“maw”伤害写成“胃部”伤害；额外“装备的护甲都会被融合”与当前 maw.yaml 无 melds、保留躯干甲但 -75% AC 的设计相反。另 EN 的治疗说法已落后：_devour 给与受猎物等级影响的 ENGORGED 持续时间，player_regen 读取它提高再生，FormMaw 按变形技能决定再生加值。不能把它直接当旧版即时治疗量翻译落地。 本批采用：按 coder 最终 EN 同步：吞食可能触发暂时生命再生加成；技能提高再生加成和巨口伤害，猎物强度延长再生时长；删除旧直接治疗及装备融合段。 原实现延期已由源码追踪及中英成对修正闭环；参见 transform.cc、status.cc、player.cc、melee-attack.cc 和本批实际正文/查库测试。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:503；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:420；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/maw.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1021；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:1222；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:1366；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1469" |
| `status_description:medusa status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have a mane of venomous tendrils for hair.","english_source_name":"medusa status"} | {"chinese_description":"你长着一头由带毒的触须构成的鬃发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你长着一头由带毒的触须构成的鬃发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"medusa status","english_description":"You have a mane of venomous tendrils for hair.","english_source_name":"medusa status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:medusa status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对 hair 被一簇 venomous tendrils 替代，中文保留鬃发、触须和毒性。当前“毒液触须”可以理解为带毒触须，不能据此断定其声称全由液体构成；但表达不自然，建议改成“带毒的触须”以直接传达 venomous。Medusa 的 stinger hair 确认是能使近敌中毒的触须，而不是蛇发，故不擅改成传统美杜莎的蛇。 本批采用：采纳自然度建议：带毒的触须构成鬃发，不擅改成蛇发。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1189；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:968；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/medusa.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1270；crawl-ref/source/fight.cc:407" |
| `status_description:memories status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"This indicates how many spells you could cast from accumulated memories if you\nEnkindled now.","english_source_name":"memories status"} | {"chinese_description":"这表示如果你现在使用“点燃”能力，可以用已积累的记忆施放多少个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"这表示如果你现在使用“点燃”能力，可以用已积累的记忆施放多少个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"memories status","english_description":"This indicates how many spells you could cast from accumulated memories if you\nEnkindled now.","english_source_name":"memories status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:memories status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["status:STATUS_MNEMOPHAGE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。计数是已有记忆在使用 Enkindle 后可施放的法术数，原译的记忆资源概念正确。当前能力菜单显示“点燃”，而“现在燃魂”难以直接找到该操作；建议明确操作名。这只是辨识建议，不宣称“燃魂”作为意象本身必错。 本批采用：操作名称对齐现行菜单“点燃”，保留积累记忆可施放法术数量。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1105；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:972；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1040；crawl-ref/source/dat/i18n/zh/source.txt:33386；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1042" |

| `status_description:ruin status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are marked with the sign of ruin, causing any melee attacks which damage you\nto heavily drain and randomly slow, weaken, or blind you.","english_source_name":"ruin status"} | {"chinese_description":"你被刻上了毁灭之印。每次对你造成伤害的近战攻击，都会重度汲取你的生命力，\n并随机使你减速、虚弱或失明。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你被刻上了毁灭之印。每次对你造成伤害的近战攻击，都会重度汲取你的生命力，\n并随机使你减速、虚弱或失明。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"ruin status","english_description":"You are marked with the sign of ruin, causing any melee attacks which damage you\nto heavily drain and randomly slow, weaken, or blind you.","english_source_name":"ruin status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:ruin status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_SIGN_OF_RUIN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。heavy drain 被译成普通“严重削弱”，与后面的 Weak 混在一起；实际每次伤害近战先 drain，再随机 slow/weak/blind，需明确生命力汲取。 本批采用：重度汲取生命力与随机减速/虚弱/失明分开，保留造成伤害的近战攻击条件。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:964；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1049；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:752；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:753；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:519" |

| `status_description:scarab status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are a sun scarab, with solar fire blazing beside you.","english_source_name":"scarab status"} | {"chinese_description":"你是一只太阳圣甲虫，太阳之火在你身旁燃烧。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你是一只太阳圣甲虫，太阳之火在你身旁燃烧。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"scarab status","english_description":"You are a sun scarab, with solar fire blazing beside you.","english_source_name":"scarab status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:scarab status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对 sun scarab 身份、太阳之火燃烧在身旁。中文太阳圣甲虫和身旁太阳之火齐全；不因短名 glossary 用“甲虫”就删除 scarab 的圣甲虫物种意象。太阳余烬的身旁召唤路径支持位置；不增写自燃伤害或火焰免疫。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1185；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1054；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/sun-scarab.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/sun-scarab.yaml:28；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:2865" |
| `status_description:scroll status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are a walking scroll, parchment crisp and full of magic.","english_source_name":"scroll status"} | {"chinese_description":"你是一卷会行走的卷轴，羊皮纸挺括，充满魔力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你是一卷会行走的卷轴，羊皮纸挺括，充满魔力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"scroll status","english_description":"You are a walking scroll, parchment crisp and full of magic.","english_source_name":"scroll status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:scroll status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对会行走的卷轴、羊皮纸 crisp 的质地、充满魔力三项。中文“本”通常量书籍，不适合卷轴；“羊皮纸清脆”把形容纸张脆挺的 crisp 误当声音清脆。当前英文与配置都明确 walking scroll/parchment，不能借 equivalent_mons 的 walking_tome 改回一本书。 本批采用：量词改为卷、纸张质地改为挺括，保留会行走与充满魔力。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1177；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1058；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/walking-scroll.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/walking-scroll.yaml:24；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1217" |
| `status_description:serpent status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have been transformed into a giant, cold-blooded, poison-resistant serpent,\nready to wind your coils around foes and crush them to death.","english_source_name":"serpent status"} | {"chinese_description":"你变成了一条抗毒的、决意将敌人缠绕、挤压至死的冷血巨蛇。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你变成了一条抗毒的、决意将敌人缠绕、挤压至死的冷血巨蛇。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"serpent status","english_description":"You have been transformed into a giant, cold-blooded, poison-resistant serpent,\nready to wind your coils around foes and crush them to death.","english_source_name":"serpent status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:serpent status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对巨大、冷血、抗毒的蛇身，以及缠绕并挤死敌人的能力，中文首段完整。额外“装备的武器和护甲都会被融合”是错误的全称承诺：当前 serpent 只融合列明槽位，保留头盔，且可每个头各戴一顶。该段 EN 已无，直接删除即可恢复语义与现行装备规则；不因 EN 没写双头而擅加双头到翻译。 本批采用：仅删 EN 没有且与现行头盔规则冲突的全装备融合段；首句保留，不擅加双头机制。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:498；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:414；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/serpent.yaml:5；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/serpent.yaml:8；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/serpent.yaml:29；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:737；crawl-ref/source/mutation.cc:701" |
| `status_description:shackles status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"Yredelemnul's grip is engulfing an area in life-stealing chains.","english_source_name":"shackles status"} | {"chinese_description":"伊雷德勒姆纳的掌控正在用生命窃取之链吞没一片区域。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"伊雷德勒姆纳的掌控正在用生命窃取之链吞没一片区域。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"shackles status","english_description":"Yredelemnul's grip is engulfing an area in life-stealing chains.","english_source_name":"shackles status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:shackles status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_FATHOMLESS_SHACKLES"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `keep` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。生命窃取之链吞没区域的意象完整；Yredelemnul 的中文音译与别处不同不自动证明本条错，必须区分身份绑定与译音选择。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:925；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1062；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:432" |
| `status_description:shadow status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You have been transformed into a swirling mass of dark shadows. You are\npermanently invisible and are immune to poison, draining, and torment. All\nincoming damage is halved, you bleed smoke on any incoming attack, and you have\ninfinite willpower. However, your ability to deal damage in melee and with\nranged attacks is halved, your spellcasting power is greatly hampered, and your\nmaximum health is further drained when taking damage.","english_source_name":"shadow status"} | {"chinese_description":"你变成了旋涡状的暗影团。你将持续隐形，且免疫毒、衰竭和折磨的影响。\n所有受到的伤害会减半，受到任何攻击时都会流出烟雾，而且意志力无限。\n但是，你的近战和远程攻击伤害都会减半，法术威力也会大幅降低，\n受到伤害时，最大生命值还会因衰竭而进一步降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"} | {"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你变成了旋涡状的暗影团。你将持续隐形，且免疫毒、衰竭和折磨的影响。\n所有受到的伤害会减半，受到任何攻击时都会流出烟雾，而且意志力无限。\n但是，你的近战和远程攻击伤害都会减半，法术威力也会大幅降低，\n受到伤害时，最大生命值还会因衰竭而进一步降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"shadow status","english_description":"You have been transformed into a swirling mass of dark shadows. You are\npermanently invisible and are immune to poison, draining, and torment. All\nincoming damage is halved, you bleed smoke on any incoming attack, and you have\ninfinite willpower. However, your ability to deal damage in melee and with\nranged attacks is halved, your spellcasting power is greatly hampered, and your\nmaximum health is further drained when taking damage.","english_source_name":"shadow status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:shadow status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"} | `adjust` | "完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对旋转暗影形体、永久隐形、毒/衰竭/折磨免疫、所有来伤半减、每次被攻出烟、无限意志、近战与远程伤害半减、spellcasting power 大降、受伤进一步衰竭最大生命值。中文多数齐全，但“施法会受到极大的阻碍”没有保留 power，可能理解为施法成功率或施法限制。英文明确是法术威力，应写清。TAG34 deprecated 配置仍记 weak spells（两个 de-enhancer），但本审阅不宣称这些旧能力在当前游戏可获得。 本批采用：明确法术威力降低、两类攻击伤害减半及受伤后的最大生命值衰竭。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:629；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:539；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/deprecated-shadow.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/deprecated-shadow.yaml:16；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:962；crawl-ref/source/wiz-you.cc:1246" |

| `status_description:vampire status` | "current-help" | {"english_description":"You are a vampire - a creature that straddles the border between life and\nundeath. | `monster_status:diminished spells monstatus` | "current" | {"english_description":"This creature's spells are less powerful - dealing less damage, being less able to\novercome their target's willpower, and occasionally being weaker in other ways.","english_source_name":"diminished spells monstatus"} | {"chinese_description":"这个生物的法术威力降低——造成的伤害更少，更难以克服目标的意志力，\n并在其他方面偶尔变弱。","current_chinese_name":"diminished spells monstatus"} | {"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物的法术威力降低——造成的伤害更少，更难以克服目标的意志力，\n并在其他方面偶尔变弱。","current_chinese_name":"diminished spells monstatus","description_key":"diminished spells monstatus","english_description":"This creature's spells are less powerful - dealing less damage, being less able to\novercome their target's willpower, and occasionally being weaker in other ways.","english_source_name":"diminished spells monstatus","identity":"monster_status:diminished spells monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。法术伤害、克服意志能力降低与其他效果减弱完整。末句“并在其他方面偶尔变弱”稍生硬，可改“有些其他效果也会减弱”。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:183；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:162；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:162；crawl-ref/source/mon-ench.cc:233；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:5398；crawl-ref/source/monster.cc:6823；crawl-ref/source/monster.cc:6000" |

| `monster_status:interlaced with chaos monstatus` | "current" | {"english_description":"This creature's melee attacks may inflict additional damage of a random element\nor cause various irresistible status effects.","english_source_name":"interlaced with chaos monstatus"} | {"chinese_description":"这个生物的近战攻击可能会造成随机元素的额外伤害，或引发各种不可抵抗的状态效果。","current_chinese_name":"interlaced with chaos monstatus"} | {"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物的近战攻击可能会造成随机元素的额外伤害，或引发各种不可抵抗的状态效果。","current_chinese_name":"interlaced with chaos monstatus","description_key":"interlaced with chaos monstatus","english_description":"This creature's melee attacks may inflict additional damage of a random element\nor cause various irresistible status effects.","english_source_name":"interlaced with chaos monstatus","identity":"monster_status:interlaced with chaos monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。近战可能额外随机元素伤害或不可抵抗状态，概率与二选项完整。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:338；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:286；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:155；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:3970" |

| `monster_status:mesmerising monstatus` | "current" | {"english_description":"This creature has mesmerised you, making you unable to voluntarily move away\nfrom them.\n\nThis effect will break if you ever lose sight of this creature.","english_source_name":"mesmerising monstatus"} | {"chinese_description":"这个生物已经迷住了你，使你无法主动远离它。\n\n如果你失去这个生物的视野，此效果会消失。","current_chinese_name":"mesmerising monstatus"} | {"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物已经迷住了你，使你无法主动远离它。\n\n如果你失去这个生物的视野，此效果会消失。","current_chinese_name":"mesmerising monstatus","description_key":"mesmerising monstatus","english_description":"This creature has mesmerised you, making you unable to voluntarily move away\nfrom them.\n\nThis effect will break if you ever lose sight of this creature.","english_source_name":"mesmerising monstatus","identity":"monster_status:mesmerising monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。使你不可主动远离，失去视野解除；未颠倒靠近/远离。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:379；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:320；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:33；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:60；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:680；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:1688" |

| `monster_status:radiating silence monstatus` | "current" | {"english_description":"This creature is surrounded by a field of unnatural silence which eliminates\nall noise made within it as well as preventing the vocalisations required for\nmany creatures (including you) to read scrolls, cast spells, or invoke divine\naid.\n\nIf this effect was caused by a spell, the radius of the field will shrink over\ntime.","english_source_name":"radiating silence monstatus"} | {"chinese_description":"这个生物被一圈不自然的沉默力场环绕，力场内消除所有噪音，\n阻止许多生物（包括你）阅读卷轴、施法或祈求神助所需的发声。\n\n如果此效果是由法术引起的，力场范围会随时间缩小。","current_chinese_name":"radiating silence monstatus"} | {"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物被一圈不自然的沉默力场环绕，力场内消除所有噪音，\n阻止许多生物（包括你）阅读卷轴、施法或祈求神助所需的发声。\n\n如果此效果是由法术引起的，力场范围会随时间缩小。","current_chinese_name":"radiating silence monstatus","description_key":"radiating silence monstatus","english_description":"This creature is surrounded by a field of unnatural silence which eliminates\nall noise made within it as well as preventing the vocalisations required for\nmany creatures (including you) to read scrolls, cast spells, or invoke divine\naid.\n\nIf this effect was caused by a spell, the radius of the field will shrink over\ntime.","english_source_name":"radiating silence monstatus","identity":"monster_status:radiating silence monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。力场消噪及包括玩家的读卷/施法/神助发声限制，法术来源半径随时缩小完整。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:467；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:394；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:50；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:60；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:680；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:1688" |
| `monster_status:radiating toxic energy monstatus` | "current" | {"english_description":"This creature shines with Olgreb's Toxic Radiance and will continuously inflict\npoison damage on all foes in sight for several turns.","english_source_name":"radiating toxic energy monstatus"} | {"chinese_description":"这个生物闪耀着奥尔格雷布之毒辐射的光芒，将在数回合内持续对视野中的所有\n敌人造成毒素伤害。","current_chinese_name":"radiating toxic energy monstatus"} | {"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物闪耀着奥尔格雷布之毒辐射的光芒，将在数回合内持续对视野中的所有\n敌人造成毒素伤害。","current_chinese_name":"radiating toxic energy monstatus","description_key":"radiating toxic energy monstatus","english_description":"This creature shines with Olgreb's Toxic Radiance and will continuously inflict\npoison damage on all foes in sight for several turns.","english_source_name":"radiating toxic energy monstatus","identity":"monster_status:radiating toxic energy monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。Olgreb专名、可见所有敌人、持续若干回合毒伤完整。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:477；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:401；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:58；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:60；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:680；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:1688" |

| `monster_status:ready to sunder monstatus` | "current" | {"english_description":"This creature's Sundering weapon is fully charged and its next attack will be\nmore accurate, inflict greatly increased damage, and cleave with increased range.\nThis effect will be lost if it moves.","english_source_name":"ready to sunder monstatus"} | {"chinese_description":"这个生物的碎裂武器已完全充能，其下一次攻击将更加精准、造成大幅增加的伤害、\n并且劈砍范围扩大。如果它移动了，此效果将消失。","current_chinese_name":"ready to sunder monstatus"} | {"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物的碎裂武器已完全充能，其下一次攻击将更加精准、造成大幅增加的伤害、\n并且劈砍范围扩大。如果它移动了，此效果将消失。","current_chinese_name":"ready to sunder monstatus","description_key":"ready to sunder monstatus","english_description":"This creature's Sundering weapon is fully charged and its next attack will be\nmore accurate, inflict greatly increased damage, and cleave with increased range.\nThis effect will be lost if it moves.","english_source_name":"ready to sunder monstatus","identity":"monster_status:ready to sunder monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"} | `adjust` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。满充能、下一击更准/增伤/范围更大、移动失效完整；同一铭印名称需统一。 采用的逐键修复：ready to sunder monstatus：满充能、下一击更准/增伤/范围更大、移动失效完整；同一铭印名称需统一。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:491；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:414；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:164；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:60；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:680；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:1688 原发现：MS-L07" |
| `monster_status:reflecting blocked projectiles monstatus` | "current" | {"english_description":"This creature reflects any projectile it blocks back to their original source.","english_source_name":"reflecting blocked projectiles monstatus"} | {"chinese_description":"这个生物将任何被格挡的投射物反射回其原始来源。","current_chinese_name":"reflecting blocked projectiles monstatus"} | {"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物将任何被格挡的投射物反射回其原始来源。","current_chinese_name":"reflecting blocked projectiles monstatus","description_key":"reflecting blocked projectiles monstatus","english_description":"This creature reflects any projectile it blocks back to their original source.","english_source_name":"reflecting blocked projectiles monstatus","identity":"monster_status:reflecting blocked projectiles monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。所有被格挡投射物返回其原始来源，非所有接近投射物。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:497；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:419；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:137；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:60；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:680；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:1688" |

| `monster_status:sick monstatus` | "current" | {"english_description":"This creature is sick and cannot naturally regenerate.","english_source_name":"sick monstatus"} | {"chinese_description":"这个生物生病了，无法自然恢复生命值。","current_chinese_name":"sick monstatus"} | {"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物生病了，无法自然恢复生命值。","current_chinese_name":"sick monstatus","description_key":"sick monstatus","english_description":"This creature is sick and cannot naturally regenerate.","english_source_name":"sick monstatus","identity":"monster_status:sick monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。不能自然恢复生命，没有误写成禁止一切治疗。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:544；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:461；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:123；crawl-ref/source/mon-act.cc:146" |

| `monster_status:soul-gripped monstatus` | "current" | {"english_description":"This creature's soul will be bound in service to you once they die, though\nallowing them to stray from your line of sight for more than a brief moment\nwill cause you to lose your grasp on it.","english_source_name":"soul-gripped monstatus"} | {"chinese_description":"这个生物的灵魂将在死后被迫为你服务，但如果它超出你的视线范围\n超过短暂的一瞬，你将失去对它的掌控。","current_chinese_name":"soul-gripped monstatus"} | {"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物的灵魂将在死后被迫为你服务，但如果它超出你的视线范围\n超过短暂的一瞬，你将失去对它的掌控。","current_chinese_name":"soul-gripped monstatus","description_key":"soul-gripped monstatus","english_description":"This creature's soul will be bound in service to you once they die, though\nallowing them to stray from your line of sight for more than a brief moment\nwill cause you to lose your grasp on it.","english_source_name":"soul-gripped monstatus","identity":"monster_status:soul-gripped monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"} | `keep` | "全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。死后为你服务；离视野超过短暂时间失去控制，时序与距离条件完整。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:578；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:492；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:80；crawl-ref/source/mon-ench.cc:2020 原发现：MS-S03" |

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"杂音"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. Their attacks may inflict a variety of minor maladies on your\nfoes - sometimes dazing, draining, or even confusing them.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.","english_source_name":"Cacophony"},"fact_sha256":"d5ba03ca31cb5c3a84aa1c2cb43e346e9fa1f9c2ebb54796b7bb5dfac9fbb131","identity":"ability:ABIL_CACOPHONY","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"ability","chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"杂音","description_key":"Cacophony ability","english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. Their attacks may inflict a variety of minor maladies on your\nfoes - sometimes dazing, draining, or even confusing them.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.","english_source_name":"Cacophony","identity":"ability:ABIL_CACOPHONY","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_CACOPHONY, \"Cacophony\", 4, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::none }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。名称在该能力的正文效果与当前dispatch语境可成立；独立检查对象/动作及术语，不凭旧keep行通过。 正文独立复审：附身护甲独立攻击且暂时持续、服饰四方攻击/欢快喧嚣、距离牵引、不同享伤害、可穿透射击、可能眩晕/衰竭/混乱、经验充能全部齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:408；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:3340","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"喷出一股浓缩酸液，在其经过的任何未占据格子上留下腐蚀性云雾，\n并腐蚀击中的一切。","current_chinese_name":"腐蚀吐息"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any\nunoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.","english_source_name":"Caustic Breath"},"fact_sha256":"a5ddcf286d3b0e40733e364aadd1806a4a50396a4267a805455d46d3c90ee55d","identity":"ability:ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"ability","chinese_description":"喷出一股浓缩酸液，在其经过的任何未占据格子上留下腐蚀性云雾，\n并腐蚀击中的一切。","current_chinese_name":"腐蚀吐息","description_key":"Caustic Breath ability","english_description":"Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any\nunoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.","english_source_name":"Caustic Breath","identity":"ability:ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH, \"Caustic Breath\", 0, 0, 0, 3, {fail_basis::xl, 30, 1}, abflag::drac_charges }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。名称在该能力的正文效果与当前dispatch语境可成立；独立检查对象/动作及术语，不凭旧keep行通过。 正文独立复审：浓酸、经过且未占据格留酸云、命中腐蚀齐全；未删空格条件。 证据：crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:375；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:3265","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"使你能在松软岩石和生锈栅栏中挖出通道。激活此能力本身没有消耗，\n只会让你做好挖掘准备；激活后，向墙壁移动就会开始打通通道。\n挖掘会制造一些噪音，并降低使用者的生命上限。\n\n激活后，再次激活此能力或进行任何非挖掘的移动动作都会取消挖掘状态。","current_chinese_name":"挖掘"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Allows making tunnels through soft rock and rusted grates. Activating the\nability has no cost and simply prepares you to start digging; once active,\nmoving into a wall will start tunnelling. Doing so makes some noise and drains\nthe user's maximum health.\n\nOnce active, activating the ability again or making any non-digging movement\naction will cancel the Dig status.","english_source_name":"Dig"},"fact_sha256":"d9f454a5c306d6e330bac49c4010b2627a826a884d048b293df27c90feb9c07c","identity":"ability:ABIL_DIG","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"ability","chinese_description":"使你能在松软岩石和生锈栅栏中挖出通道。激活此能力本身没有消耗，\n只会让你做好挖掘准备；激活后，向墙壁移动就会开始打通通道。\n挖掘会制造一些噪音，并降低使用者的生命上限。\n\n激活后，再次激活此能力或进行任何非挖掘的移动动作都会取消挖掘状态。","current_chinese_name":"挖掘","description_key":"Dig ability","english_description":"Allows making tunnels through soft rock and rusted grates. Activating the\nability has no cost and simply prepares you to start digging; once active,\nmoving into a wall will start tunnelling. Doing so makes some noise and drains\nthe user's maximum health.\n\nOnce active, activating the ability again or making any non-digging movement\naction will cancel the Dig status.","english_source_name":"Dig","identity":"ability:ABIL_DIG","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_DIG, \"Dig\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::instant | abflag::max_hp_drain }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。名称在该能力的正文效果与当前dispatch语境可成立；独立检查对象/动作及术语，不凭旧keep行通过。 正文独立复审：松软岩石/锈栅、激活免费仅准备、撞墙开挖、噪音/HP上限衰竭、再激活或非挖掘移动取消齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:385；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:3160","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"恢复到正常形态。","current_chinese_name":"结束变形"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Reverts you to your normal form.","english_source_name":"End Transformation"},"fact_sha256":"03c05b28141d41af1f9a4c61b5c7b7294ad7582bead9c13de37c47f2067ed11a","identity":"ability:ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"ability","chinese_description":"恢复到正常形态。","current_chinese_name":"结束变形","description_key":"End Transformation ability","english_description":"Reverts you to your normal form.","english_source_name":"End Transformation","identity":"ability:ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION, \"End Transformation\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::none }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。名称在该能力的正文效果与当前dispatch语境可成立；独立检查对象/动作及术语，不凭旧keep行通过。 正文独立复审：恢复正常形态齐全；当前return_to_default_form，未承诺强制回某种族外形。 证据：crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:403；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:3329","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle"},"fact_sha256":"b7fcc998a9e58476fe709c043b497386c1af4926bf942a9306177eb26fc56a3f","identity":"ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"ability","chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃","description_key":"Enkindle ability","english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle","identity":"ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_ENKINDLE, \"Enkindle\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::instant }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。名称在该能力的正文效果与当前dispatch语境可成立；独立检查对象/动作及术语，不凭旧keep行通过。 正文独立复审：幽灵火焰/记忆代价；伤害法术免MP/负重、成功率与威力加成且后者随XL；爪伤随法术等级并百分比吸血；每咒一记忆、用尽或超时结束；Lua最大3+floor(3*XL/20)齐全；状态标签燃魂与现行点燃不一致。 采用的逐键修复：Enkindle ability：幽灵火焰/记忆代价；伤害法术免MP/负重、成功率与威力加成且后者随XL；爪伤随法术等级并百分比吸血；每咒一记忆、用尽或超时结束；Lua最大3+floor(3*XL/20)齐全；状态标签燃魂与现行点燃不一致。 证据：crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:414；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:3352","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"喷出一股强大的蒸汽，烫伤目标并在其路径上留下遮蔽视线的蒸汽云。","current_chinese_name":"蒸汽吐息"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Breathes a powerful blast of steam, scalding a target and leaving\nsight-obscuring steam clouds in its wake.","english_source_name":"Steam Breath"},"fact_sha256":"579b76b46565cc4ebbc6d20f3d68acf325ef92f864afb9e0106b2b507b5c0c3c","identity":"ability:ABIL_STEAM_BREATH","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"ability","chinese_description":"喷出一股强大的蒸汽，烫伤目标并在其路径上留下遮蔽视线的蒸汽云。","current_chinese_name":"蒸汽吐息","description_key":"Steam Breath ability","english_description":"Breathes a powerful blast of steam, scalding a target and leaving\nsight-obscuring steam clouds in its wake.","english_source_name":"Steam Breath","identity":"ability:ABIL_STEAM_BREATH","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_STEAM_BREATH, \"Steam Breath\", 0, 0, 0, 6, {fail_basis::xl, 20, 1}, abflag::drac_charges }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。名称在该能力的正文效果与当前dispatch语境可成立；独立检查对象/动作及术语，不凭旧keep行通过。 正文独立复审：强蒸汽伤目标/沿途遮视线蒸汽云齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:372；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:3263","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将你附近的所有水域变为汹涌的潮汐，试图淹死站在其中或上方的每个敌人。\n需要呼吸空气的敌人也会陷入淹没状态，数回合内无法施放受沉默影响的法术，\n并造成少量窒息伤害。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"水葬"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Turns all of the water near you into a surging tide that attempts to drown every\nenemy standing in or above it. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"念出混沌之语，迫使附近的敌人闪烁远离使用者。\n此外，受影响的敌人还可能因此被减速、束缚或恐惧。念出混沌之语绝非易事，\n会略微降低使用者的生命上限，并使此能力在短时间内无法再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"混沌之语"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Speaks a word of chaos, forcing enemies nearby to blink away from the user.\nAdditionally, those affected may be slowed, ensnared, or terrified by the\nexperience. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"抓住另一个生物的影子，并快速释放它们的法术和能力，如同你自己的一般，\n瞄准随机的敌人。它们以这种方式召唤的生物将属于你，许多它们本应施加于\n自身的增益效果将转而施加于你。你也不会受到它们造成的任何伤害。\n\n只能对拥有在当前时刻可以有效施放的合适法术的生物使用。\n这个过程还会使受害者的影子变得太暗而无法再次抓取——\n一旦对目标成功使用，就再也不能对其使用。\n\n（并非所有法术都能通过这种方法施放；无法施放的法术在检视时\n将以感叹号标记。）","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Grabs hold of another creature's shadow and rapidly unleashes their spells and\nabilities as if they were your own, aimed at random enemies. Creatures they\nsummon this way will belong to you, and many beneficial effects that they would\napply to themselves will be applied to you instead. You are also fully protected\nfrom any damage they would cause.\n\nCan only be used on creatures with eligible spells that they could productively\ncast at the moment. The process also leaves the victim's shadow too dim to grasp\na second time - once used successfully on a target, it may never be used on them\nagain.\n\n(Not all spells can be cast via this method; those which cannot will be marked\nwith an exclamation mark when examined.)","english_source_name":"aphotic marionette ability"},"fact_sha256":"f4ce0b0c398332622d07e4ef0239d7aff46985d6e25c614af6b0909155a3bc8b","identity":"ability_description:aphotic marionette ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"抓住另一个生物的影子，并快速释放它们的法术和能力，如同你自己的一般，\n瞄准随机的敌人。它们以这种方式召唤的生物将属于你，许多它们本应施加于\n自身的增益效果将转而施加于你。你也不会受到它们造成的任何伤害。\n\n只能对拥有在当前时刻可以有效施放的合适法术的生物使用。\n这个过程还会使受害者的影子变得太暗而无法再次抓取——\n一旦对目标成功使用，就再也不能对其使用。\n\n（并非所有法术都能通过这种方法施放；无法施放的法术在检视时\n将以感叹号标记。）","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"aphotic marionette ability","english_description":"Grabs hold of another creature's shadow and rapidly unleashes their spells and\nabilities as if they were your own, aimed at random enemies. Creatures they\nsummon this way will belong to you, and many beneficial effects that they would\napply to themselves will be applied to you instead. You are also fully protected\nfrom any damage they would cause.\n\nCan only be used on creatures with eligible spells that they could productively\ncast at the moment. The process also leaves the victim's shadow too dim to grasp\na second time - once used successfully on a target, it may never be used on them\nagain.\n\n(Not all spells can be cast via this method; those which cannot will be marked\nwith an exclamation mark when examined.)","english_source_name":"aphotic marionette ability","identity":"ability_description:aphotic marionette ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。随机敌方目标、受害者法术/能力、召唤物归属、许多自身增益转移、伤害豁免齐全；合格且当下有效施法、每目标仅一次、检查感叹号三限制齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:746；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:654","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"向敌人昭示入的真言，对视线内所有敌人造成严重伤害。\n受影响的生物可能会麻痹、减慢或流失其魔力。\n造成的伤害会随你的虔诚值和经验等级的提高而增加。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Reveals Ru's truth to your enemies, dealing severe damage to all enemies in\nyour line of sight. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"尝试将一只怪物放逐到深渊中。如果尝试成功，\n你会获得一些虔诚值和怪物的全部经验值。即使是能够抵抗的生物，\n也会因与深渊摩擦而招致有害变异并变得虚弱。祈神技能会让此能力更难被怪物抵抗。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Attempts to banish a creature into the Abyss. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将你的物理形态散开成一群吸血蝙蝠，融合你的装备，并让你能快速移动、灵活闪避。\n从你身体中涌出的蝙蝠数量如此巨大，甚至像窒息的云雾一样填满附近的空间，\n攻击敌人并逐渐使其入睡。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。\n（变形术技能将提高此能力充能的速度。）","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Scatters your physical form into a swarm of vampire bats, melding your equipment\nbut allowing you to move quickly and evasively. The number of bats that issue\nfrom your body is so immense that it even fills nearby spaces like a choking\ncloud, assailing enemies and gradually putting them to sleep.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again. (Shapeshifting skill will increase the rate at\nwhich this skill recharges.)","english_source_name":"bat swarm ability"},"fact_sha256":"4cecf9d6ed5e3a5c7b6612a3f3628ce7299d576285d4b38207f359b46ad21748","identity":"ability_description:bat swarm ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"将你的物理形态散开成一群吸血蝙蝠，融合你的装备，并让你能快速移动、灵活闪避。\n从你身体中涌出的蝙蝠数量如此巨大，甚至像窒息的云雾一样填满附近的空间，\n攻击敌人并逐渐使其入睡。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。\n（变形术技能将提高此能力充能的速度。）","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"bat swarm ability","english_description":"Scatters your physical form into a swarm of vampire bats, melding your equipment\nbut allowing you to move quickly and evasively. The number of bats that issue\nfrom your body is so immense that it even fills nearby spaces like a choking\ncloud, assailing enemies and gradually putting them to sleep.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.
