{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"使用者进入狂暴状态。进入狂暴状态后，会暂时提升生命值、速度以及近战攻击力。\n不进行战斗，狂暴很快就会结束，但可以通过多次击杀而延长。\n狂暴时，除了移动和近战外，几乎无法进行其余所有行为。\n狂暴结束后，使用者将被减速，并在短时间内无法再次狂暴。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Sends the user into a berserk rage. Going berserk temporarily increases health,\nspeed, and damage dealt in melee. It will time out quickly outside of combat,\nbut may be extended by multiple kills. While berserk, almost all actions other\nthan movement and melee combat are prevented. When the rage expires, the user\nwill be slowed and unable to berserk again for a short time.","english_source_name":"berserk ability"},"fact_sha256":"5d695eb4c519613a343437674d6db1e033677b7debb04a6d53e8e5114a3c1dd1","identity":"ability_description:berserk ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"使用者进入狂暴状态。进入狂暴状态后，会暂时提升生命值、速度以及近战攻击力。\n不进行战斗，狂暴很快就会结束，但可以通过多次击杀而延长。\n狂暴时，除了移动和近战外，几乎无法进行其余所有行为。\n狂暴结束后，使用者将被减速，并在短时间内无法再次狂暴。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"berserk ability","english_description":"Sends the user into a berserk rage. Going berserk temporarily increases health,\nspeed, and damage dealt in melee. It will time out quickly outside of combat,\nbut may be extended by multiple kills. While berserk, almost all actions other\nthan movement and melee combat are prevented. When the rage expires, the user\nwill be slowed and unable to berserk again for a short time.","english_source_name":"berserk ability","identity":"ability_description:berserk ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。短暂生命/速度/近战伤害增加、脱战快速结束、连续击杀延长、几乎仅移动近战可行、结束减速及禁再狂暴齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:498；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:206","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"释放你全部掠食本能的力量，向一个恐惧的敌人跳跃并对其发动凶猛的近战攻击。\n此攻击根据你的变形术技能获得伤害倍率。如果击杀了目标，你将在之后\n自动发动嚎叫。\n\n只能瞄准处于恐惧状态且至少有一个可占据的相邻格子的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Unleashes the full power of your predatory instincts to leap towards a terrified\nenemy and perform a vicious melee attack against them. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"试图将一个活物、神圣或恶魔生物的灵魂束缚为你的永恒奴仆。如果目标怪物在离开你\n视线之前被杀死，它将作为缚魂返回，保留生前拥有的装备、法术和能力。\n\n只能选择相对未受重伤的生物作为目标，维持其灵魂不逃脱所需的专注会消耗使用者\n当前生命值的1/3——杀死目标后才会归还。若目标怪物在过程完成前离开你的视线，\n尝试将彻底失败。\n\n缚魂的生命值受使用者的祈神技能影响。它将跟随其捕获者穿过楼梯，并能从其他楼层\n召回。一次只能束缚住一个灵魂。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Attempts to bind the soul of a living, holy, or demonic being into your eternal\nservice. If the targeted monster is slain before it leaves your sight, it will\nreturn as a bound soul, retaining the equipment, spells and abilities it had in\nlife.\n\nOnly beings who are relatively uninjured may be targeted, and the focus required\nto keep their soul from escaping will consume 1/3 of the user's current health -\nreturning it only upon slaying them. The attempt will fail entirely if the\ntargeted monster leaves your sight before the process is complete.\n\nThe bound soul's health is influenced by the user's Invocations skill. It will\nfollow its captor through stairs, and can be recalled from other levels.\n\nOnly one soul can be bound at a time.","english_source_name":"bind soul ability"},"fact_sha256":"9ab6403d323d03ff143e704a1c5375859ad92d44c7493d5db9949af32a3b7757","identity":"ability_description:bind soul ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"试图将一个活物、神圣或恶魔生物的灵魂束缚为你的永恒奴仆。如果目标怪物在离开你\n视线之前被杀死，它将作为缚魂返回，保留生前拥有的装备、法术和能力。\n\n只能选择相对未受重伤的生物作为目标，维持其灵魂不逃脱所需的专注会消耗使用者\n当前生命值的1/3——杀死目标后才会归还。若目标怪物在过程完成前离开你的视线，\n尝试将彻底失败。\n\n缚魂的生命值受使用者的祈神技能影响。它将跟随其捕获者穿过楼梯，并能从其他楼层\n召回。一次只能束缚住一个灵魂。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"bind soul ability","english_description":"Attempts to bind the soul of a living, holy, or demonic being into your eternal\nservice. If the targeted monster is slain before it leaves your sight, it will\nreturn as a bound soul, retaining the equipment, spells and abilities it had in\nlife.\n\nOnly beings who are relatively uninjured may be targeted, and the focus required\nto keep their soul from escaping will consume 1/3 of the user's current health -\nreturning it only upon slaying them. The attempt will fail entirely if the\ntargeted monster leaves your sight before the process is complete.\n\nThe bound soul's health is influenced by the user's Invocations skill. It will\nfollow its captor through stairs, and can be recalled from other levels.\n\nOnly one soul can be bound at a time.","english_source_name":"bind soul ability","identity":"ability_description:bind soul ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。活物/神圣/恶魔三类、视线内击杀才缚魂、继承装备法术能力、相对健康目标、当前HP三分之一与击杀归还、离视野失败、祈神影响HP、随楼梯/跨层召回、仅一魂齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:322；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:148","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将使用者化成一道活体闪电并击向选定的怪物，\n对路径上的一切造成电击伤害，并将使用者送到闪电箭的终点。\n使用此能力后，短时间内无法再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Turns the user into living lightning and zaps them at the chosen monster,\ndealing electric damage to everything in their path and depositing the user\nat the bolt's end. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"给哥萨戈3000金币，将其散布给当前分支的所有居住者，前提是该分支有智慧生物。\n这些怪物可能会失去与你战斗的兴趣（越强大的生物被贿赂的几率越大），\n并有很小的几率会加入你的行列，尽管他们还是不会离开自己的分支。\n接受贿赂的敌人会降低剩余的贿赂资金；\n当其耗尽时，如果贿赂的敌人没能成为盟友，他们将变得冷漠。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Gives 3000 gold to Gozag to spread throughout the inhabitants of the current\nbranch, only possible if the branch has intelligent inhabitants. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. Their attacks may inflict a variety of minor maladies on your\nfoes - sometimes dazing, draining, or even confusing them.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.","english_source_name":"cacophony ability"},"fact_sha256":"5dec87bc2085dbb3720fdb06f60b3306fac5cc7dd7c8fa9b3d79ecbb8ebf1425","identity":"ability_description:cacophony ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"cacophony ability","english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"在通常抽一张牌的时间内，从一副牌中打出四张牌。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Plays four cards from a deck in the time it normally takes to draw a\nsingle card.","english_source_name":"deal four ability"},"fact_sha256":"3863af84d44d2b7e83e0fe9e1084560ccc9765bc0c307d8eaf06be862aff0baf","identity":"ability_description:deal four ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"在通常抽一张牌的时间内，从一副牌中打出四张牌。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"deal four ability","english_description":"Plays four cards from a deck in the time it normally takes to draw a\nsingle card.","english_source_name":"deal four ability","identity":"ability_description:deal four ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。同抽一张的时间打四张齐全；未承诺四倍正常回合速度。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:603；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:288","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"使你能在松软岩石和生锈栅栏中挖出通道。激活此能力本身没有消耗，\n只会让你做好挖掘准备；激活后，向墙壁移动就会开始打通通道。\n挖掘会制造一些噪音，并降低使用者的生命上限。\n\n激活后，再次激活此能力或进行任何非挖掘的移动动作都会取消挖掘状态。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Allows making tunnels through soft rock and rusted grates. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将这位使徒从你的服务中解放，派遣他们以比欧弗之名在世间行善。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Frees this apostle from your service, sending them out to do good in the world\nin Beogh's name.","english_source_name":"dismiss apostle ability"},"fact_sha256":"ddc2b9d890b830d42daa9b4fc4fa13456d5d5a50ddb2bb7dcc8abab48aaa680a","identity":"ability_description:dismiss apostle ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"将这位使徒从你的服务中解放，派遣他们以比欧弗之名在世间行善。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"dismiss apostle ability","english_description":"Frees this apostle from your service, sending them out to do good in the world\nin Beogh's name.","english_source_name":"dismiss apostle ability","identity":"ability_description:dismiss apostle ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。解除使徒服役、派往世间以比欧弗名义行善齐全；不写为杀死使徒。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:627；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:716","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"抚慰一个受苦的友好生物，根据你的祈神技能治疗其部分创伤，\n并治愈中毒、混乱、减速、疾病、虚弱、衰竭和石化。\n\n受到此能力治疗的召唤生物，还可能获得少量额外的存留时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Comforts a friendly creature who is suffering, healing some of its wounds\n(based on your Invocations skill) and also curing poison, confusion, slowing,\nsickness, weakness, draining, and petrification.\n\nAny summoned creature who is healed by this ability may also be granted a\nsmall amount of additional time in this world.","english_source_name":"divine alms ability"},"fact_sha256":"4829aeb6eb4a225457efa031b0bc76e189ccebbdc90fca4a947b246830e011af","identity":"ability_description:divine alms ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"抚慰一个受苦的友好生物，根据你的祈神技能治疗其部分创伤，\n并治愈中毒、混乱、减速、疾病、虚弱、衰竭和石化。\n\n受到此能力治疗的召唤生物，还可能获得少量额外的存留时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"divine alms ability","english_description":"Comforts a friendly creature who is suffering, healing some of its wounds\n(based on your Invocations skill) and also curing poison, confusion, slowing,\nsickness, weakness, draining, and petrification.\n\nAny summoned creature who is healed by this ability may also be granted a\nsmall amount of additional time in this world.","english_source_name":"divine alms ability","identity":"ability_description:divine alms ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。受苦友军、祈神治疗、毒/混乱/减速/病/虚弱/衰竭/石化七项、受治疗召唤物可能少量延时齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:539；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:955","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"以必定成功的方式施放法术库中的任何法术。你会获得基于施法能力技能的法术威力加成，\n其效果相当于在该法术自身的相关技能上进行同等级训练。\n\n此后短时间内，你可以使用重复释经能力重复施放同一法术，消耗的虔诚值大幅降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Casts any spell from your spell library with guaranteed success. You receive a\nbonus to spell power based on your Spellcasting skill that is worth the same as\nequivalent levels of training in the relevant skills of the spell itself.\n\nFor a short time afterward, you may recast the same spell (using the Recast\nability), at a greatly reduced piety cost.","english_source_name":"divine exegesis ability","identity":"ability_description:divine exegesis ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。法术库任意法术保证成功、施法能力等效学派训练威力加成、短时重复同一法术/虔诚大幅减少齐全；Repeat Exegesis实际菜单与文字一致。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:488；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:198","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"在使用者面前显现一面耀眼明亮的盾牌。由光辉者的神力托举，\n它必定会格挡接下来的数次原本可被普通盾牌格挡的攻击。\n远程攻击将被反射，近战攻击者有机率被由此产生的光芒短暂致盲。\n\n此盾牌只能格挡有限次数的攻击便会消散，祈神技能可增加其次数。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Manifests a blindingly bright shield in front of the user. Ranged attacks will be reflected and melee\nattackers have a chance of being briefly blinded by the resulting flash of\nlight.\n\nThis shield will block only a limited number of attacks before vanishing, with\nInvocations skill increasing how many.","english_source_name":"divine shield ability","identity":"ability_description:divine shield ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。光辉者托盾、必定挡数次、仅限普通盾能挡攻击、远程反射、近战可能短盲、祈神增次数；中文普通盾限制未准确表达。 采用的逐键修复：Divine Shield ability：光辉者托盾、必定挡数次、仅限普通盾能挡攻击、远程反射、近战可能短盲、祈神增次数；中文普通盾限制未准确表达。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:238；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:104；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:3530；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:1342","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"让你和一个值得重视的敌人进行一对一搏斗。\n成功使用这个能力，你和被挑战的敌人将被运送到奥卡瓦鲁的竞技场战斗至死，\n除非你取得胜利或被杀，否则无法逃脱。\n\n决斗开始时将恢复你一半的已损失生命值，获胜后，\n奥卡瓦鲁会将你的生命值和法力恢复至发出挑战前的状态——\n让你转瞬之间摆脱决斗中所受的一切伤害。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Enters you into single combat with a worthy foe. On success, you and the\nchallenged foe will be transported to Okawaru's Arena to fight to the death,\nwith no escape until you either emerge victorious or are slain.\n\nHalf of your missing health will be restored as the duel begins, and upon\nvictory, Okawaru will return your health and magical power to whatever they\nwere before you issued the challenge - letting you shake off any damage taken\nduring it in the blink of an eye.","english_source_name":"duel ability"},"fact_sha256":"eb406a4e9969e72ea46ab809eaf1406b7cccf77b855f372a5b9c153fb3de6b22","identity":"ability_description:duel ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"让你和一个值得重视的敌人进行一对一搏斗。\n成功使用这个能力，你和被挑战的敌人将被运送到奥卡瓦鲁的竞技场战斗至死，\n除非你取得胜利或被杀，否则无法逃脱。\n\n决斗开始时将恢复你一半的已损失生命值，获胜后，\n奥卡瓦鲁会将你的生命值和法力恢复至发出挑战前的状态——\n让你转瞬之间摆脱决斗中所受的一切伤害。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"duel ability","english_description":"Enters you into single combat with a worthy foe. On success, you and the\nchallenged foe will be transported to Okawaru's Arena to fight to the death,\nwith no escape until you either emerge victorious or are slain.\n\nHalf of your missing health will be restored as the duel begins, and upon\nvictory, Okawaru will return your health and magical power to whatever they\nwere before you issued the challenge - letting you shake off any damage taken\nduring it in the blink of an eye.","english_source_name":"duel ability","identity":"ability_description:duel ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。值得挑战的敌人、一对一、竞技场生死战不可逃、开始回一半已失HP、胜后HP/MP回挑战前齐全；竞技场名与搏斗错字需修。 采用的逐键修复：Duel ability：值得挑战的敌人、一对一、竞技场生死战不可逃、开始回一半已失HP、胜后HP/MP回挑战前齐全；竞技场名与搏斗错字需修。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:361；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:170；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:okawaru_duel；docs/glossary.md:Arena","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"enkindle ability"},"fact_sha256":"5923ea56a098a30faa67cabdbea6c745c1f4f2c0a376720978d97e648940a4e4","identity":"ability_description:enkindle ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"enkindle ability","english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"enkindle ability","identity":"ability_description:enkindle ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。幽灵火焰/记忆代价；伤害法术免MP/负重、成功率与威力加成且后者随XL；爪伤随法术等级并百分比吸血；每咒一记忆、用尽或超时结束；Lua最大3+floor(3*XL/20)齐全；状态标签燃魂与现行点燃不一致。 采用的逐键修复：Enkindle ability：幽灵火焰/记忆代价；伤害法术免MP/负重、成功率与威力加成且后者随XL；爪伤随法术等级并百分比吸血；每咒一记忆、用尽或超时结束；Lua最大3+floor(3*XL/20)齐全；状态标签燃魂与现行点燃不一致。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:171；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:720；crawl-ref/source/dat/i18n/zh/source.txt:33365；crawl-ref/source/dat/i18n/zh/source.txt:status|Enkindled","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"用天谴轰击一个目标敌人。这些邪恶力量会伤害目标及其相邻生物，\n且不受护甲、抗性等任何保护手段削弱。\n但某些生物，通常是那些本身也能释放天谴的生物，完全不受天谴伤害。\n此能力的威力随魔力释放技能提高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Blasts a targeted enemy with damnation. The power of this\nability scales with the Evocations skill.","english_source_name":"evoke damnation ability"},"fact_sha256":"f141a5371cd0fd1094a7c4e09995904e5a002435ac7d5b5dcbf8ee9191eb28ca","identity":"ability_description:evoke damnation ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"用天谴轰击一个目标敌人。这些邪恶力量会伤害目标及其相邻生物，\n且不受护甲、抗性等任何保护手段削弱。\n但某些生物，通常是那些本身也能释放天谴的生物，完全不受天谴伤害。\n此能力的威力随魔力释放技能提高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"evoke damnation ability","english_description":"Blasts a targeted enemy with damnation. These unholy forces harm the victim and\nanyone adjacent, and are not affected by any means of protection, such as armour\nor resistances. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"发射一个翻涌的强烈毁灭力球体，汲取自{{\n    if you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Gehenna destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"无尽的欣嫩谷之火。\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Cocytus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"悲叹河的极寒荒原。\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Tartarus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"塔尔塔罗斯的哀嚎悲痛。\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Dis destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"迪斯的无情恶毒。\"\n    else\n        return \"地狱本身。\"\n    end\n}}\n\n此球体在行进中积聚力量，并会试图追踪指定的目标，\n但移动和转向时具有相当大的惯性。当它与生物或其他障碍物碰撞时，\n将引爆为一场由{{\n    if you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Gehenna destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"火焰或熔岩\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Cocytus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"寒冷或冰霜\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Tartarus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"负能量或毁灭\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Dis destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"酸液或金属碎片\"\n    else\n        return \"地狱能量\"\n    end\n}}构成的猛烈爆炸，其范围取决于行进距离。\n\n你不会受到此爆炸的伤害。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Launches a roiling sphere of intense destructive force drawn from the {{\n    if you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Gehenna destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"endless fires of Gehenna.\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Cocytus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"frigid wastes of Cocytus.\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Tartarus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"wailing grief of Tartarus.\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Dis destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"ruthless spite of Dis.\"\n    else\n        return \"very Hells themselves.\"\n    end\n}}\n\nThis sphere gathers strength as it travels, and will attempt to home in on a\ndesignated target, though it moves and turns with considerable inertia. When it\ncollides with a creature or other obstruction, it will detonate in a violent\nexplosion of {{\n    if you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Gehenna destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"fire or lava\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Cocytus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"cold or ice\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Tartarus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"negative energy or devastation\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Dis destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"acid or metal splinters\"\n    else\n        return \"hellish {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"用天谴轰击一个目标敌人。\n这些邪恶的力量会伤害目标和任何相邻生物，且不受护甲、抗性等任何保护手段削弱。\n但某些生物，通常是那些能够自己释放天谴的生物，完全不受天谴伤害。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Blasts a targeted enemy with damnation. However, certain creatures, usually those able to invoke\ndamnation themselves, are entirely unscathed by damnation.","english_source_name":"hurl damnation ability","identity":"ability_description:hurl damnation ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。目标与相邻天谴、全防护无效、特定通常能天谴生物免疫齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:67；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:18","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"从黑火炬中掷出一股暗影之火，对活物、恶魔和神圣生物造成不可抵抗的伤害。\n火炬之光还会短暂增强任何被其爆发击中的亡灵仆从，对崇拜伊莱德莱姆努尔的人\n无害。伤害随祈神技能提升。\n\n此能力只能在火炬点燃时使用，且每层使用次数有限。\n每层可用次数随虔诚值增加，通过击杀一个独特命名敌人来用特别卓越的\n灵魂煽旺黑火炬的火焰也会提供额外使用次数。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Hurls a gout of umbral fire from the Black Torch, which deals irresistible\ndamage to living, demonic, and holy beings. The torchlight will also briefly\nempower any of your undead servants caught in its blast, and is harmless to\nthose who worship Yredelemnul. The damage is increased by Invocations skill.\n\nThis ability can be used only while the torch is lit, and only a limited number\nof times on each floor. The number of uses available per floor increases with\npiety, and stoking the Black Torch's flames with a particularly remarkable soul\nby killing a unique named enemy will also provide an additional use.","english_source_name":"hurl torchlight ability"},"fact_sha256":"b72580741f1e9e6c76900ace6b241923d7370500f7444b8355fc55376448a027","identity":"ability_description:hurl torchlight ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"从黑火炬中掷出一股暗影之火，对活物、恶魔和神圣生物造成不可抵抗的伤害。\n火炬之光还会短暂增强任何被其爆发击中的亡灵仆从，对崇拜伊莱德莱姆努尔的人\n无害。伤害随祈神技能提升。\n\n此能力只能在火炬点燃时使用，且每层使用次数有限。\n每层可用次数随虔诚值增加，通过击杀一个独特命名敌人来用特别卓越的\n灵魂煽旺黑火炬的火焰也会提供额外使用次数。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"hurl torchlight ability","english_description":"Hurls a gout of umbral fire from the Black Torch, which deals irresistible\ndamage to living, demonic, and holy beings. The torchlight will also briefly\nempower any of your undead servants caught in its blast, and is harmless to\nthose who worship Yredelemnul. The damage is increased by Invocations skill.\n\nThis ability can be used only while the torch is lit, and only a limited number\nof times on each floor. The number of uses available per floor increases with\npiety, and stoking the Black Torch's flames with a particularly remarkable soul\nby killing a unique named enemy will also provide an additional use.","english_source_name":"hurl torchlight ability","identity":"ability_description:hurl torchlight ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。活物恶魔神圣不可抗伤、亡灵暂增益/同教无害、祈神增伤、点炬才可、每层有限随虔诚增加、击杀独特灵魂添一次齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:310；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:790","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"使你的先祖复现自己心目中完美的愿景。\n他们的创伤被忘却，无瑕的光芒注入他们，使其力量、施法能力和护甲短暂而急剧地增强。\n祈神技能可以提高治愈效果和理想化持续时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Restores your ancestor to an idyllic vision of their best self. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"选择施法者的一个破坏性法术赋予其未来创造的法术火花仆从，\n替换之前赋予它们的任何法术。施法者必须能够以不超过20%的失败率\n自己施放此法术。\n\n注意：以这种方式赋予法术将花费数回合，并且如果仆从处于活动状态，\n也会将其解散。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Chooses one of the caster's destructive spells to grant to Spellspark Servitors\nthey create in the future, replacing any spell granted to them previously. The\ncaster must be capable of casting this spell themselves with a failure rate of\nno more than 20%.\n\nNote: imbuing a spell in this manner will take several turns and also dismiss\nyour servitor if it is active.","english_source_name":"imbue servitor ability","identity":"ability_description:imbue servitor ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。自有破坏法术、未来仆从覆盖旧选择、自能施放且失败率<=20%、多回合并解散现仆从齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:129；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:800","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"分析你物品栏中一件神器近战武器的结构组成，并将其烙印到你的\n白金典范法术中，使你今后创造的白金典范都能使用该武器的功能性复制品。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Analyzes the structural composition of an artefact melee weapon in your\ninventory and imprints it upon your Platinum Paragon spell, allowing it to wield\na functional replica of it whenever you create one.","english_source_name":"imprint weapon ability"},"fact_sha256":"915be7ab7ef73f7764deb0d29be0b689b12e20c7fdac0d1399978a1ba5cbd458","identity":"ability_description:imprint weapon ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"分析你物品栏中一件神器近战武器的结构组成，并将其烙印到你的\n白金典范法术中，使你今后创造的白金典范都能使用该武器的功能性复制品。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"imprint weapon ability","english_description":"Analyzes the structural composition of an artefact melee weapon in your\ninventory and imprints it upon your Platinum Paragon spell, allowing it to wield\na functional replica of it whenever you create one.","english_source_name":"imprint weapon ability","identity":"ability_description:imprint weapon ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。库存神器近战武器、分析结构、烙印白金典范法术、以后每次召来可持功能复制品齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:139；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:809","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"创造出临时性的白银墙壁，将一个怪物困在其中。\n监禁的持续时间随祈神技能的提升而增加。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Temporarily imprisons a monster in walls of silver. The duration of the prison\nis increased by Invocations skill.","english_source_name":"imprison ability","identity":"ability_description:imprison ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。暂时银墙囚怪、祈神延时齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:219；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:87","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"以自己的身体为媒介，向世界释放一支混沌军团。在短时间内，\n较小的恶魔将持续在使用者附近显现——前提是周围有值得战斗的东西。\n虽然这些恶魔个体可能存活时间不长，但混沌军团整体几乎是无穷无尽的。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Uses one's own body as a conduit to unleash an army of chaos upon the world.\nFor a short while, lesser demons will continuously manifest near the user -\nprovided there is something around for them to fight. While these demons may\nbe individually short-lived, the legions of chaos as a whole are virtually\ninexhaustible.","english_source_name":"infernal legion ability"},"fact_sha256":"7633caaf35d9f0b6aa51ebcef2240c419af7e678e1280561df874be4fed47f05","identity":"ability_description:infernal legion ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"以自己的身体为媒介，向世界释放一支混沌军团。在短时间内，\n较小的恶魔将持续在使用者附近显现——前提是周围有值得战斗的东西。\n虽然这些恶魔个体可能存活时间不长，但混沌军团整体几乎是无穷无尽的。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"infernal legion ability","english_description":"Uses one's own body as a conduit to unleash an army of chaos upon the world.\nFor a short while, lesser demons will continuously manifest near the user -\nprovided there is something around for them to fight. While these demons may\nbe individually short-lived, the legions of chaos as a whole are virtually\ninexhaustible.","english_source_name":"infernal legion ability","identity":"ability_description:infernal legion ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。以身体媒介、短时不断低级恶魔、需附近可战对象、个体短命而军团几乎无穷齐全；“较小”可建议“低阶”。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:419；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:814","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"从地狱的遥远角落召唤一个恶魔，并以你的血液将其绑定为仆从。\n在低祈神技能时，只能召唤较小的恶魔，但高祈神技能者甚至可能召唤出\n大恶魔和处刑人。\n\n注意：混沌军团容易内斗，有时一个敌对的恶魔可能与你的召唤仆从\n一同响应仪式。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Beckons a demon from the far reaches of Hell and binds it into service with your\nblood. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"瞬间跃过空中。虽然无法控制目的地，但移动如此突然和敏捷，\n以至于在你能够再次行动之前没有怪物能击中你，许多怪物甚至可能完全\n无法追踪你的位置。\n\n每次使用此能力后，你需要短暂恢复。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Leaps through the air in the blink of an eye. While it is impossible to control\nyour destination, the movement is so abrupt and agile that no monster will be\nable to land a blow on you until you can act again, and many may lose track of\nyour position entirely.\n\nYou must spend a short while recovering between each use of this ability.","english_source_name":"jump ability"},"fact_sha256":"e81dcaa7c5ce06857bcc1328e6936a011093af121fe68ddae8cc0d6957adb6a0","identity":"ability_description:jump ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"瞬间跃过空中。虽然无法控制目的地，但移动如此突然和敏捷，\n以至于在你能够再次行动之前没有怪物能击中你，许多怪物甚至可能完全\n无法追踪你的位置。\n\n每次使用此能力后，你需要短暂恢复。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"jump ability","english_description":"Leaps through the air in the blink of an eye. While it is impossible to control\nyour destination, the movement is so abrupt and agile that no monster will be\nable to land a blow on you until you can act again, and many may lose track of\nyour position entirely.\n\nYou must spend a short while recovering between each use of this ability.","english_source_name":"jump ability","identity":"ability_description:jump ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。空中瞬跃、目的地不可控、下次行动前不被击中、许多可失踪、每用间短恢复齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:1101；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:834","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"高举黑火炬并呼唤伊莱德莱姆努尔将其点燃，标志着你开始征服当前地牢楼层。\n伊莱德莱姆努尔只会为火炬点燃时进行的击杀提供虔诚值。\n\n那些已经赢得伊莱德莱姆努尔一些好感的人将被赐予临时的亡灵仆从来帮助\n开始他们的征服，经验丰富且特别虔诚的人将获得更强大的仆从。\n\n伊莱德莱姆努尔不提供第二次机会——当你离开当前楼层时火炬将熄灭，\n且每层只能点燃一次，永不再来。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Raises the Black Torch aloft and calls upon Yredelemnul to light it aflame,\nmarking the beginning of your attempt to conquer the current level of the\ndungeon. Yredelemnul only grants piety for kills made while the torch is lit.\n\nThose who have earned some of Yredelemnul's favour will be gifted temporary\nundead servants to help begin their conquest, with stronger servants being\nprovided to the experienced and especially pious.\n\nYredelemnul does not offer second chances - the torch will be extinguished when\nyou leave the current floor, and it may only be lit once per floor, ever.","english_source_name":"light the black torch ability"},"fact_sha256":"219321e10b2e318dc242faee1a6a848e1e6c978af6cc1c97311fad66ded6b851","identity":"ability_description:light the black torch ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"高举黑火炬并呼唤伊莱德莱姆努尔将其点燃，标志着你开始征服当前地牢楼层。\n伊莱德莱姆努尔只会为火炬点燃时进行的击杀提供虔诚值。\n\n那些已经赢得伊莱德莱姆努尔一些好感的人将被赐予临时的亡灵仆从来帮助\n开始他们的征服，经验丰富且特别虔诚的人将获得更强大的仆从。\n\n伊莱德莱姆努尔不提供第二次机会——当你离开当前楼层时火炬将熄灭，\n且每层只能点燃一次，永不再来。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"light the black torch ability","english_description":"Raises the Black Torch aloft and calls upon Yredelemnul to light it aflame,\nmarking the beginning of your attempt to conquer the current level of the\ndungeon. Yredelemnul only grants piety for kills made while the torch is lit.\n\nThose who have earned some of Yredelemnul's favour will be gifted temporary\nundead servants to help begin their conquest, with stronger servants being\nprovided to the experienced and especially pious.\n\nYredelemnul does not offer second chances - the torch will be extinguished when\nyou leave the current floor, and it may only be lit once per floor, ever.","english_source_name":"light the black torch ability","identity":"ability_description:light the black torch ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。点炬开征服、只点燃时杀敌获虔诚、已获好感才有临时亡灵、经验虔诚影响强度、离层熄灭/每层永仅一次齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:297；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:842","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"以超人的速度穿过连续的生物线，最终到一个新的位置。\n穿过的任何生物都会被短暂地混乱，混乱持续时间随着祈神技能的提升而增加。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Passes through a contiguous line of creatures at superhuman speed, ending up\nin a new location. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"喷出一大团泥球，击退被击中的一切，并用泥泞覆盖周围区域，\n阻碍敌人移动并导致它们有时攻击失手。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Spits an enormous ball of mud that knocks back whatever it hits and drenches the\nsurrounding area in a mud slick which impedes enemy movement and causes them to\nsometimes fumble their attacks.","english_source_name":"mud breath ability"},"fact_sha256":"cbbe1efeadf864cfa7774fbbd3d58e3f82516e474fa2993352cc2b583afbdbad","identity":"ability_description:mud breath ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"喷出一大团泥球，击退被击中的一切，并用泥泞覆盖周围区域，\n阻碍敌人移动并导致它们有时攻击失手。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"mud breath ability","english_description":"Spits an enormous ball of mud that knocks back whatever it hits and drenches the\nsurrounding area in a mud slick which impedes enemy movement and causes them to\nsometimes fumble their attacks.","english_source_name":"mud breath ability","identity":"ability_description:mud breath ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。大泥球、命中击退、周边泥地阻敌移动并偶尔攻击失手齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:36；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:853","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"从你周围的地牢墙壁中召唤出酸性软泥，对敌人造成伤害，\n伤害取决于与其相邻的黏性墙壁的数量。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Calls forth acidic ooze from the walls of the dungeon around you, damaging foes\ndepending on the number of slimy walls they remain adjacent to.","english_source_name":"oozemancy ability"},"fact_sha256":"27dd0518bf5ca9160fb503ca222339d70dd7870ac8928fd04619b027f03a17ed","identity":"ability_description:oozemancy ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"从你周围的地牢墙壁中召唤出酸性软泥，对敌人造成伤害，\n伤害取决于与其相邻的黏性墙壁的数量。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"oozemancy ability","english_description":"Calls forth acidic ooze from the walls of the dungeon around you, damaging foes\ndepending on the number of slimy walls they remain adjacent to.","english_source_name":"oozemancy ability","identity":"ability_description:oozemancy ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。周围墙体酸泥、敌人依相邻黏墙数持续受伤齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:717；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:357","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"永久破坏一个墙类结构，在其位置生出一个短期存活的友方植物。\n即使是一棵树也要献出生命来支持费德哈的意志，\n只有真正无法破坏的墙壁才能抵抗这种力量。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Permanently destroys a wall-like structure, growing a short-lived plant ally in\nits place. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"尝试安抚一个敌对生物，说服其放弃暴力。如果成功，该生物会变为中立，\n并尝试尽快离开当前楼层。你会获得它的全部经验值。\n\n对神圣生物和活物最容易成功，亡灵和恶魔则依次更难安抚，尤其是有智慧的个体。\n\n没有心智的生物和非生物都无法被安抚，任何怪物在睡眠中也无法被安抚。\n\n祈神技能可提高成功率，并使你能够安抚更强大的生物。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Attempts to soothe a hostile creature and convince them to give up their violent\nways. If successful, the creature will turn neutral and attempt to leave the\nfloor as quickly as possible. You will be granted its full experience value.\n\nThis works best on holy and living creatures, with the undead and demons being\nprogressively harder to pacify - particularly if they are intelligent.\n\nNeither mindless nor nonliving creatures can be pacified and no monster can be\npacified while it is asleep.\n\nInvocations skill increases your chance of success and allows you to pacify more\npowerful creatures.","english_source_name":"pacify ability"},"fact_sha256":"f201f4f7770f18bdcffc051bfb34e1f81a1741b05e64be96907bf2297a799920","identity":"ability_description:pacify ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"尝试安抚一个敌对生物，说服其放弃暴力。如果成功，该生物会变为中立，\n并尝试尽快离开当前楼层。你会获得它的全部经验值。\n\n对神圣生物和活物最容易成功，亡灵和恶魔则依次更难安抚，尤其是有智慧的个体。\n\n没有心智的生物和非生物都无法被安抚，任何怪物在睡眠中也无法被安抚。\n\n祈神技能可提高成功率，并使你能够安抚更强大的生物。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"pacify ability","english_description":"Attempts to soothe a hostile creature and convince them to give up their violent\nways. If successful, the creature will turn neutral and attempt to leave the\nfloor as quickly as possible. You will be granted its full experience value.\n\nThis works best on holy and living creatures, with the undead and demons being\nprogressively harder to pacify - particularly if they are intelligent.\n\nNeither mindless nor nonliving creatures can be pacified and no monster can be\npacified while it is asleep.\n\nInvocations skill increases your chance of success and allows you to pacify more\npowerful creatures.","english_source_name":"pacify ability","identity":"ability_description:pacify ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。尝试安抚敌对、中立尽快离层、全经验、神圣活物最易/亡灵恶魔依次难且智慧更难、无心智非生物/睡眠不可、祈神成功率及强目标齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:524；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:231","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"唤起星辰第一次在天空中燃烧之前的夜晚，用无法穿透的黑暗吞没你的周围。\n使用者的视野半径将被减至零，阻止敌人追踪或瞄准你使用能力，\n并在效果持续期间缓慢恢复至正常。你的潜行能力也会增加。\n\n直到其效果完全结束前无法再次使用，\n因为即使是创世之初的第一个夜晚最终也必须让位于白昼。\n\n祈神技能增加效果的持续时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Invokes a night from before the stars first burned in the sky, engulfing your\nsurroundings in impenetrable darkness. The user's sight radius will be reduced\nto nothing, preventing enemies from tracking or aiming abilities at you, and\nslowly expand back to normal over the duration of the effect. Your stealth will\nalso be increased.\n\nIt cannot be invoked again until its effect has fully ended, as even the very\nfirst night of creation must eventually give way to day.\n\nInvocations skill increases the duration of the effect.","english_source_name":"primordial nightfall ability"},"fact_sha256":"bd545776fb8da86ff119e44fae9aa8a485c36af8eabd62b4df94c04090979dbc","identity":"ability_description:primordial nightfall ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"唤起星辰第一次在天空中燃烧之前的夜晚，用无法穿透的黑暗吞没你的周围。\n使用者的视野半径将被减至零，阻止敌人追踪或瞄准你使用能力，\n并在效果持续期间缓慢恢复至正常。你的潜行能力也会增加。\n\n直到其效果完全结束前无法再次使用，\n因为即使是创世之初的第一个夜晚最终也必须让位于白昼。\n\n祈神技能增加效果的持续时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"primordial nightfall ability","english_description":"Invokes a night from before the stars first burned in the sky, engulfing your\nsurroundings in impenetrable darkness. The user's sight radius will be reduced\nto nothing, preventing enemies from tracking or aiming abilities at you, and\nslowly expand back to normal over the duration of the effect. Your stealth will\nalso be increased.\n\nIt cannot be invoked again until its effect has fully ended, as even the very\nfirst night of creation must eventually give way to day.\n\nInvocations skill increases the duration of the effect.","english_source_name":"primordial nightfall ability","identity":"ability_description:primordial nightfall ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。星前之夜意象、零视野阻追踪/瞄能力、逐渐恢复视野/潜行提高、必须结束才重用、祈神延时齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:762；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:868","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将你的先祖从地牢的任何地方召回到你的跟前。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Recalls your ancestor from anywhere in the dungeon to your immediate\nsurroundings.","english_source_name":"recall ancestor ability"},"fact_sha256":"e17da40d3a443f0884327bed9628e87f1f96e05526be23522e4b5231802a2e86","identity":"ability_description:recall ancestor ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"将你的先祖从地牢的任何地方召回到你的跟前。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"recall ancestor ability","english_description":"Recalls your ancestor from anywhere in the dungeon to your immediate\nsurroundings.","english_source_name":"recall ancestor ability","identity":"ability_description:recall ancestor ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。地牢任何地方先祖召至近旁齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:980；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:552","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"从地牢各处将你的使徒召唤到你的紧邻周围。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Recalls your apostles from anywhere in the dungeon to your immediate\nsurroundings.","english_source_name":"recall apostles ability"},"fact_sha256":"ffeb2b4cf83c36e930f32d6a94157542d2892929004ffdb57a20f433caed71d1","identity":"ability_description:recall apostles ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"从地牢各处将你的使徒召唤到你的紧邻周围。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"recall apostles ability","english_description":"Recalls your apostles from anywhere in the dungeon to your immediate\nsurroundings.","english_source_name":"recall apostles ability","identity":"ability_description:recall apostles ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。地牢任何地方使徒召至近旁齐全；“召唤”在召回语境不承诺创造新使徒。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:622；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:879","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"在短暂的期间内，向附近的怪物传道辛的律令。\n吟诵结束后，不能在短期内再次使用它。\n\n根据目标的不同，吟诵会产生不同的影响：\n混沌和不洁的怪物会受到强大、破坏性效果，亡灵和恶魔会受到较弱的斥责；\n其他有智慧的生物会陷入混乱，而异教徒以及信奉辛以外神祇的祭司会受到更重的惩罚。\n吟诵的效果能通过祈神技能和虔诚值的提升而提高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Preaches to nearby monsters about Zin's laws for a short duration. After\nfinishing a recitation, it cannot be repeated for a short time.\n\nThe recitation will have different effects depending on the target: the chaotic\nand unclean will be affected by powerful and damaging effects, undead and\ndemons will be affected by weaker rebukes, and any other intelligent creatures\nwill have confusion sown amongst them, with heretics and priests of gods other\nthan Zin being punished much more strongly. The effectiveness of the recitation\nis increased by Invocations skill and piety.","english_source_name":"recite ability"},"fact_sha256":"45a51755f4c9e736a47745d8b4972bbb5651292d196e611892c6915f9175cf51","identity":"ability_description:recite ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"在短暂的期间内，向附近的怪物传道辛的律令。\n吟诵结束后，不能在短期内再次使用它。\n\n根据目标的不同，吟诵会产生不同的影响：\n混沌和不洁的怪物会受到强大、破坏性效果，亡灵和恶魔会受到较弱的斥责；\n其他有智慧的生物会陷入混乱，而异教徒以及信奉辛以外神祇的祭司会受到更重的惩罚。\n吟诵的效果能通过祈神技能和虔诚值的提升而提高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"recite ability","english_description":"Preaches to nearby monsters about Zin's laws for a short duration. After\nfinishing a recitation, it cannot be repeated for a short time.\n\nThe recitation will have different effects depending on the target: the chaotic\nand unclean will be affected by powerful and damaging effects, undead and\ndemons will be affected by weaker rebukes, and any other intelligent creatures\nwill have confusion sown amongst them, with heretics and priests of gods other\nthan Zin being punished much more strongly. The effectiveness of the recitation\nis increased by Invocations skill and piety.","english_source_name":"recite ability","identity":"ability_description:recite ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。短暂传律/结束短冷、混沌不洁强效/亡灵恶魔弱斥/其他智慧混乱、异教及他神祭司更重、祈神虔诚增效；中文把其他智慧目标改为其中。 采用的逐键修复：Recite ability：短暂传律/结束短冷、混沌不洁强效/亡灵恶魔弱斥/其他智慧混乱、异教及他神祭司更重、祈神虔诚增效；中文把其他智慧目标改为其中。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:200；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:72；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:zin_check_recite_to_single_monster","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"为一个被击败的使徒施洗，欢迎他们成为永久的追随者。他们将跟随你\n穿梭于各楼层，进入任何险境，甘愿为事业和同胞献出生命。\n\n如果他们牺牲了，比欧弗最终会在你获得足够虔诚值后复活他们——\n这个过程可以通过满足比欧弗，杀死所有可能参与使徒死亡的敌人\n来大大加速。\n\n你最多可以同时有3位追随者陪伴，不过你可以自由解散旧者以邀请新者。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Anoints a defeated apostle, and welcomes them as a permanent follower. They will\nfollow you between floors and into any peril, willingly giving their life for\nthe cause and their kin.\n\nIf they die, Beogh will eventually revive them once you gain sufficient piety -\nthis process can be greatly accelerated by satisfying Beogh with the slaying of\nall foes who may have contributed to their apostle's death.\n\nYou can have at most 3 followers accompanying you at a time, though you may\nfreely dismiss old ones to invite new ones.","english_source_name":"recruit apostle ability"},"fact_sha256":"597a12597b557dfa9a62e03998e8d6c7f7a9b4ff9c8c13de138157185ebe4a6b","identity":"ability_description:recruit apostle ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"为一个被击败的使徒施洗，欢迎他们成为永久的追随者。他们将跟随你\n穿梭于各楼层，进入任何险境，甘愿为事业和同胞献出生命。\n\n如果他们牺牲了，比欧弗最终会在你获得足够虔诚值后复活他们——\n这个过程可以通过满足比欧弗，杀死所有可能参与使徒死亡的敌人\n来大大加速。\n\n你最多可以同时有3位追随者陪伴，不过你可以自由解散旧者以邀请新者。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"recruit apostle ability","english_description":"Anoints a defeated apostle, and welcomes them as a permanent follower. They will\nfollow you between floors and into any peril, willingly giving their life for\nthe cause and their kin.\n\nIf they die, Beogh will eventually revive them once you gain sufficient piety -\nthis process can be greatly accelerated by satisfying Beogh with the slaying of\nall foes who may have contributed to their apostle's death.\n\nYou can have at most 3 followers accompanying you at a time, though you may\nfreely dismiss old ones to invite new ones.","english_source_name":"recruit apostle ability","identity":"ability_description:recruit apostle ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。败使徒入永久追随、跨层/险境/牺牲、攒虔诚复活、杀尽参与死亡敌人加速、最多3名/可换新齐全；施洗可作修辞，非阻断。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:632；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:883","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"舍弃一只手，使你不能使用盾牌{{\n    if you.race() ~= \"Formicid\" then\n        return \"和双手武器\"\n    end\n}}且可佩戴戒指数减一。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Sacrifices a hand, causing you to lose the ability to use shields{{\n    if you.race() ~= \"Formicid\" then\n        return \" and two-handed weapons\"\n    end\n}}, and to be able to wear one fewer ring.","english_source_name":"sacrifice a hand ability"},"fact_sha256":"9d9b16595d27ee45b0f0a97e3ca06c5cd426c55b71d73b7f830075d6b6d5e5f4","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice a hand ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃一只手，使你不能使用盾牌{{\n    if you.race() ~= \"Formicid\" then\n        return \"和双手武器\"\n    end\n}}且可佩戴戒指数减一。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice a hand ability","english_description":"Sacrifices a hand, causing you to lose the ability to use shields{{\n    if you.race() ~= \"Formicid\" then\n        return \" and two-handed weapons\"\n    end\n}}, and to be able to wear one fewer ring.","english_source_name":"sacrifice a hand ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice a hand ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。少一手/无盾、非Formicid才额外无双手武器、少一戒指齐全；Lua条件与返回分支逐一同义。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:903；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:484","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"舍弃一只眼，使你更难命中目标。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Sacrifices an eye, causing you to have a much harder time hitting targets.","english_source_name":"sacrifice an eye ability"},"fact_sha256":"96e8688350d5cc4a4180204a4376c4f5615e9b43d74a3b7d6ee3772b182ab4d9","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice an eye ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃一只眼，使你更难命中目标。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice an eye ability","english_description":"Sacrifices an eye, causing you to have a much harder time hitting targets.","english_source_name":"sacrifice an eye ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice an eye ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。失一眼/更难命中相符；可选强调“难得多”以贴much。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:921；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:500","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"舍弃奥术，使你失去使用某些类型魔法的能力，并让你的这些技能无法达到任何等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Sacrifices arcana, causing you to lose the ability to use certain schools of\nmagic and preventing you from having any ranks in those skills.","english_source_name":"sacrifice arcana ability"},"fact_sha256":"78963246e32afee685d1af09679d056cda9fd82bcd50dcc7b83c32c6955b5bc5","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice arcana ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃奥术，使你失去使用某些类型魔法的能力，并让你的这些技能无法达到任何等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice arcana ability","english_description":"Sacrifices arcana, causing you to lose the ability to use certain schools of\nmagic and preventing you from having any ranks in those skills.","english_source_name":"sacrifice arcana ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice arcana ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。失某些魔法学派及相关技能不能有等级齐全；“类型”在技能语境可接受。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:888；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:470","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"舍弃激活魔法物品的能力，并让你的魔力释放技能无法达到任何等级。\n\n这包括魔杖和其他需要用到魔力释放技能的物品——\n但这*不会*影响可延伸攻击的武器、护符和通天塔雕像。\n这也使得法杖在近战时的效果大大降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Sacrifices the ability to evoke any magical items, and prevents you from having\nany ranks in the Evocations skill.\n\nThis includes wands and other items which use Evocations skill - that is, it does\n*not* affect reaching weapons, talismans, and ziggurat figurines. This also renders\nmagical staves much less effective in melee.","english_source_name":"sacrifice artifice ability"},"fact_sha256":"22edb9b3fb3d9418d5bea91ec163351c968d3e7cb08b4d787b60bc7e3a34f25d","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice artifice ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃激活魔法物品的能力，并让你的魔力释放技能无法达到任何等级。\n\n这包括魔杖和其他需要用到魔力释放技能的物品——\n但这*不会*影响可延伸攻击的武器、护符和通天塔雕像。\n这也使得法杖在近战时的效果大大降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice artifice ability","english_description":"Sacrifices the ability to evoke any magical items, and prevents you from having\nany ranks in the Evocations skill.\n\nThis includes wands and other items which use Evocations skill - that is, it does\n*not* affect reaching weapons, talismans, and ziggurat figurines. This also renders\nmagical staves much less effective in melee.","english_source_name":"sacrifice artifice ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice artifice ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。魔法物品无法激活/魔力释放零、魔杖等范围、延伸武器/护符/通天塔雕像例外、法杖近战大弱齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:866；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:452","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"舍弃勇气，会让你恐惧危险的怪物。\n这些怪物会让你充满恐惧，这会削弱你的法术威力以及战斗中打击和伤害怪物的能力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Sacrifices courage, causing you to become terrified of dangerous monsters. Such\nmonsters fill you with horror, which reduces the power of your spells and your\nability to hit and damage monsters in combat.","english_source_name":"sacrifice courage ability"},"fact_sha256":"b6d547981c6a503efe264d79146337faf237f2b2c0d417a9ff88d069f8713a9d","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice courage ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃勇气，会让你恐惧危险的怪物。\n这些怪物会让你充满恐惧，这会削弱你的法术威力以及战斗中打击和伤害怪物的能力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice courage ability","english_description":"Sacrifices courage, causing you to become terrified of dangerous monsters. Such\nmonsters fill you with horror, which reduces the power of your spells and your\nability to hit and damage monsters in combat.","english_source_name":"sacrifice courage ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice courage ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。危险怪物引恐惧、法术威力/战斗命中伤害降低齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:882；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:465","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"舍弃在战斗中饮用药水的能力，除非身受重伤。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Sacrifices the ability to drink potions in combat unless badly injured.","english_source_name":"sacrifice drink ability"},"fact_sha256":"06098dcd2d10762649d626e430390508fcdd4ac1ede997a290e3aead9b4735ef","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice drink ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃在战斗中饮用药水的能力，除非身受重伤。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice drink ability","english_description":"Sacrifices the ability to drink potions in combat unless badly injured.","english_source_name":"sacrifice drink ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice drink ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。战斗中禁饮药/严重受伤例外齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:844；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:432","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"舍弃魔法精华，引发一次变异。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Sacrifices magical essence, causing a single mutation.","english_source_name":"sacrifice essence ability"},"fact_sha256":"00ae4d458105b5b065d8c11813482da65ec879a1878acd49f3873f02c73e7342","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice essence ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃魔法精华，引发一次变异。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice essence ability","english_description":"Sacrifices magical essence, causing a single mutation.","english_source_name":"sacrifice essence ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice essence ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。魔法精华导致单一变异齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:848；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:436","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"舍弃一些你的过去的经验，使你立刻降低一个等级，你可达到的等级上限也会降一级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Sacrifices some of your past experiences, causing you to lose one level\nimmediately and also to have the maximum level you can attain lowered by one.","english_source_name":"sacrifice experience ability"},"fact_sha256":"70712f639153c1315dfcc4f246f517f016a7896193701c0218a0ccfabfc8f3e2","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice experience ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃一些你的过去的经验，使你立刻降低一个等级，你可达到的等级上限也会降一级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice experience ability","english_description":"Sacrifices some of your past experiences, causing you to lose one level\nimmediately and also to have the maximum level you can attain lowered by one.","english_source_name":"sacrifice experience ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice experience ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。丢过去经验、立即一级/上限也降一级；中文即时两级是明确数值错误。 采用的逐键修复：Sacrifice Experience ability：丢过去经验、立即一级/上限也降一级；中文即时两级是明确数值错误。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:911；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:492；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.h:31；crawl-ref/source/player-act.cc:152；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:4049；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:5206","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"舍弃形态，你无法自行改变形态，也无法在变形术技能上达到任何等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Sacrifices forms, preventing you from voluntarily changing your form and from\nhaving any ranks in the Shapeshifting skill.","english_source_name":"sacrifice forms ability"},"fact_sha256":"a54488feae72dbb132fe78b168b88d53da4ecf0c203d77a274e78e0edc2b9e26","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice forms ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃形态，你无法自行改变形态，也无法在变形术技能上达到任何等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice forms ability","english_description":"Sacrifices forms, preventing you from voluntarily changing your form and from\nhaving any ranks in the Shapeshifting skill.","english_source_name":"sacrifice forms ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice forms ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。不能主动改形态与变形术不能有等级齐全；技能称为变身不合现行术语。 采用的逐键修复：Sacrifice Forms ability：不能主动改形态与变形术不能有等级齐全；技能称为变身不合现行术语。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:861；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:448；docs/glossary.md:784；crawl-ref/source/sacrifice-data.h","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"舍弃身体健康，引发一次变异。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Sacrifices physical health, causing a single mutation.","english_source_name":"sacrifice health ability"},"fact_sha256":"adeac78caa00b4e81ed0d44ab6e931ef671877d7f9ecd739623ff9a10c7d8acc","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice health ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"舍弃身体健康，引发一次变异。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"sacrifice health ability","english_description":"Sacrifices physical health, causing a single mutation.","english_source_name":"sacrifice health ability","identity":"ability_description:sacrifice health ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。身体健康导致单一变异齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:852；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:440","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"立即与你的影子互换位置（只要它处于活动状态），\n并误导视野中的所有敌人关于两者中的哪一个是哪个。\n之前专注于你的敌人将在数回合内完全将注意力转移到你的影子上，\n直到它们意识到错误——但如果它们成功摧毁了你的影子，幻觉将提前结束。\n\n效果的持续时间随祈神技能提升，使用后影子的耐久度也会提升。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Instantly swaps places with your shadow (so long as it is active) and misleads\nall enemies in sight about which of the two is which. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"在你的武器或拳头上裹上黏液，\n下一个击中的活物或有形的亡灵生物会变成一个中立的黏液。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Coats a wielded weapon or your fists with slime, turning the next living or\ncorporeal undead monster hit into a neutral slime.","english_source_name":"slimify ability"},"fact_sha256":"5de507696e2416af5c95030d6e1b74fcd1ee68077760b7caf4da34dad108dd9a","identity":"ability_description:slimify ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"在你的武器或拳头上裹上黏液，\n下一个击中的活物或有形的亡灵生物会变成一个中立的黏液。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"slimify ability","english_description":"Coats a wielded weapon or your fists with slime, turning the next living or\ncorporeal undead monster hit into a neutral slime.","english_source_name":"slimify ability","identity":"ability_description:slimify ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。持武器或拳、下一击活物或有形亡灵、中立软泥齐全；无扩成无形亡灵。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:712；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:352","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"[[Smiting spell]] 惩击的威力随祈神技能的提升而增强。\n\n比欧弗不会允许你在神圣审判中直接对另一位使徒使用此能力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"[[Smiting spell]] The strength of the smiting is increased by Invocations skill.\n\nBeogh will not allow you to use this directly against another apostle during a\ndivine trial.","english_source_name":"smiting ability"},"fact_sha256":"9814905f4ab8729295f138b9cd00ad8e2c7099d984723d29215e4ba9b7b3fed1","identity":"ability_description:smiting ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"[[Smiting spell]] 惩击的威力随祈神技能的提升而增强。\n\n比欧弗不会允许你在神圣审判中直接对另一位使徒使用此能力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"smiting ability","english_description":"[[Smiting spell]] The strength of the smiting is increased by Invocations skill.\n\nBeogh will not allow you to use this directly against another apostle during a\ndivine trial.","english_source_name":"smiting ability","identity":"ability_description:smiting ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。完整Smiting引用、祈神增强、神圣审判禁止直接打其他使徒齐全；本行把惩击误称惩戒。 采用的逐键修复：Smiting ability：完整Smiting引用、祈神增强、神圣审判禁止直接打其他使徒齐全；本行把惩击误称惩戒。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:615；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:299；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/spells.txt:1162；docs/glossary.md:2013","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"扭曲时间流，导致周围的怪物相对于你跳跃到未来的时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Warps the flow of time, causing monsters to skip forwards in time relative to\nyou.","english_source_name":"temporal distortion ability"},"fact_sha256":"23669118a7f74e28ea417cdfc992047922b5a72f303f4803e2a838c43701c7f7","identity":"ability_description:temporal distortion ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"扭曲时间流，导致周围的怪物相对于你跳跃到未来的时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"temporal distortion ability","english_description":"Warps the flow of time, causing monsters to skip forwards in time relative to\nyou.","english_source_name":"temporal distortion ability","identity":"ability_description:temporal distortion ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。相对自己使怪物向未来跳时齐全；实现让周遭怪物经历数回合。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:691；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:336","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"迫使一个目标生物穿过记忆领域，与你的先祖交换位置。\n\n虔诚值较高时，目标附近的生物还会受到衰竭，程度取决于祈神技能。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Forces a targeted creature to pass through the realms of memory and exchange\nplaces with your ancestor.\n\nWith great piety, those near the target will be drained to a degree depending\non Invocations skill.","english_source_name":"transference ability"},"fact_sha256":"0abdaa11c99222e611d4557c0fa4398773124f2139e40e3acf04b053a9c93a97","identity":"ability_description:transference ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"迫使一个目标生物穿过记忆领域，与你的先祖交换位置。\n\n虔诚值较高时，目标附近的生物还会受到衰竭，程度取决于祈神技能。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"transference ability","english_description":"Forces a targeted creature to pass through the realms of memory and exchange\nplaces with your ancestor.\n\nWith great piety, those near the target will be drained to a degree depending\non Invocations skill.","english_source_name":"transference ability","identity":"ability_description:transference ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。目标穿记忆界交换先祖、高虔诚邻目标者受衰竭且祈神定程度齐全；“有着大量虔诚值”句法及先祖标签宜修。 采用的逐键修复：Transference ability：目标穿记忆界交换先祖、高虔诚邻目标者受衰竭且祈神定程度齐全；“有着大量虔诚值”句法及先祖标签宜修。 最终独立复核修正：明确为ENCH_DRAINED衰竭，不是吸血或直接生命损伤。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:993；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:562；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:6275","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"从任意一副牌组中抽三张牌，选择一张进行游戏，然后弃掉另外两张。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Draws three cards from any deck, and allows you to choose one to play,\ndiscarding the other two.","english_source_name":"triple draw ability"},"fact_sha256":"8c1988cb1f9749715cbd6dfe21eee120aa82de17e0adb31568bc49bbf7d338e9","identity":"ability_description:triple draw ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"从任意一副牌组中抽三张牌，选择一张进行游戏，然后弃掉另外两张。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"triple draw ability","english_description":"Draws three cards from any deck, and allows you to choose one to play,\ndiscarding the other two.","english_source_name":"triple draw ability","identity":"ability_description:triple draw ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。任意牌组三选一打出/弃另二齐全；“进行游戏”语义可懂但建议“打出”。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:598；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:284","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"唤起强大的恢复能力，并能与其他来源的恢复效果叠加，\n即使对那些无法自行恢复的物种也生效。\n它还会强化使用者的意志力，从而能抵御许多魔法效果。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Invokes a powerful regeneration ability which stacks with all other sources and\nis effective even on those who would not otherwise be able to regenerate.
