{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"向目标生物引导一股地狱{{\n    if you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Gehenna destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"穿透性火焰、熔岩（来自欣嫩谷的影响）、闪电或负能量\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Cocytus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"穿透性冰霜（来自悲叹河的影响）、寒冷、闪电或负能量\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Tartarus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"穿透性火焰、寒冷、毁灭（来自塔尔塔罗斯的影响）或负能量\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Dis destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"穿透性火焰、寒冷、闪电、酸液或金属碎片（后两者来自迪斯的影响）\"\n    else\n        return \"火焰、寒冷、闪电或负能量\"\n    end\n}}的爆发。伤害和命中率随祈神技能提升。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Channels a blast of hellish {{\n    if you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Gehenna destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"piercing fire, lava (from Gehenna's influence), lightning, or negative energy\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Cocytus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"piercing ice (from Cocytus' influence), cold, lightning, or negative energy\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Tartarus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"piercing fire, cold, devastation (from Tartarus' influence), or negative energy\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Dis destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"piercing fire, cold, lightning, acid, or metal splinters (the last two from Dis' influence)\"\n    else\n        return \"fire, cold, lightning, or negative energy\"\n    end\n}} at a targeted creature. Damage and accuracy are increased by Invocations\nskill.","english_source_name":"unleash destruction ability"},"fact_sha256":"172580f4e47fe510c6c8557a4bebe8d5f15914c11f7369317db507ab90afb670","identity":"ability_description:unleash destruction ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"向目标生物引导一股地狱{{\n    if you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Gehenna destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"穿透性火焰、熔岩（来自欣嫩谷的影响）、闪电或负能量\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Cocytus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"穿透性冰霜（来自悲叹河的影响）、寒冷、闪电或负能量\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Tartarus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"穿透性火焰、寒冷、毁灭（来自塔尔塔罗斯的影响）或负能量\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Dis destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"穿透性火焰、寒冷、闪电、酸液或金属碎片（后两者来自迪斯的影响）\"\n    else\n        return \"火焰、寒冷、闪电或负能量\"\n    end\n}}的爆发。伤害和命中率随祈神技能提升。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"unleash destruction ability","english_description":"Channels a blast of hellish {{\n    if you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Gehenna destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"piercing fire, lava (from Gehenna's influence), lightning, or negative energy\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Cocytus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"piercing ice (from Cocytus' influence), cold, lightning, or negative energy\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Tartarus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"piercing fire, cold, devastation (from Tartarus' influence), or negative energy\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Dis destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"piercing fire, cold, lightning, acid, or metal splinters (the last two from Dis' influence)\"\n    else\n        return \"fire, cold, lightning, or negative energy\"\n    end\n}} at a targeted creature. Damage and accuracy are increased by Invocations\nskill.","english_source_name":"unleash destruction ability","identity":"ability_description:unleash destruction ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。Gehenna/Cocytus/Tartarus/Dis/无变异五Lua分支、每分支元素/来源括注/穿透性质逐一对应；伤害命中依祈神齐全，地狱专名有术语依赖。 保留当前值见本卡current_chinese；延期：Four Hell branch proper names differ across ability prose, effective catalog (火焚谷/冰封湖/深渊牢狱/铁之城), and branch-qualified glossary names (欣嫩谷/悲叹河/塔尔塔罗斯/铁城). No unapproved alias is chosen. All 5 Lua variants and effect clauses were read independently.；负责：assigned sole zh-translator, with world-name dependency owner；重入：World-name group resolves and synchronizes the four branch names; recheck every returned Lua string and refresh glossary SHA. 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:383；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:911；docs/glossary.md:1176；docs/glossary.md:1577；crawl-ref/source/dat/i18n/zh/source.txt:12202 D-C-103完整Hell依赖组续审：以同一领域的稳定词根统一名称，不把旧主题意译各自判为错误；保留毁灭效果、神祇归属、数值及条件。实际逐键更新：Unleash Destruction ability。证据：docs/decisions.md:D-C-103；完整Hell冻结审查与独立复核；对应英中正文和display source key。","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"呼唤自然力量，用岩浆、冰、风或碎石轰击一小片区域。\n这次轰击绝不会伤害你或你所显现的任何元素生物。\n提升祈神技能会增加伤害和受影响的范围。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Calls on the forces of nature to blast a small area with magma, ice, wind,\nor rubble. This blast will never harm you or any elementals manifested by you.\nInvocations skill increases both damage and area affected.","english_source_name":"upheaval ability","identity":"ability_description:upheaval ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。小区域岩浆冰风碎石、自身/自己元素豁免、祈神增伤范围齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:799；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:392","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"与毁灭者签订血之契约，暂时赋予你巨大的力量，但代价危险。\n\n在契约封存的那一刻，一场巨大的天谴爆炸将包围你，你将变身为恶魔化身，\n获得恶魔抗性、不可动摇的意志、击杀时双倍治疗效果，并将所有受到的\n伤害减少1/3。你还会根据使用此能力时的受伤程度获得额外的输出伤害加成。\n\n当你的变身结束时，你将被拖入血肉熔炉，被迫与一波波恶魔战斗，\n直到马科列布认为你的债务已偿清。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Invokes a blood pact with the Destroyer, temporarily granting you enormous power\nat a dangerous price.\n\nAt the moment the pact is sealed, a massive explosion of damnation will surround\nyou, and you will transform into a demonic avatar, granting you demonic\nresistances, invulnerable will, doubled healing from kills, and reducing all\ndamage you take by 1/3. You will additionally gain a bonus to all outgoing\ndamage proportional to how injured you were when you used this ability.\n\nWhen your transformation expires, you will be dragged down into the Crucible of\nFlesh, and made to fight through waves of demons until Makhleb considers your\ndebt paid.","english_source_name":"vessel of slaughter ability"},"fact_sha256":"703966350a82c21fac1d529a71ca909db50b100603f315913536406f2f540be1","identity":"ability_description:vessel of slaughter ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"与毁灭者签订血之契约，暂时赋予你巨大的力量，但代价危险。\n\n在契约封存的那一刻，一场巨大的天谴爆炸将包围你，你将变身为恶魔化身，\n获得恶魔抗性、不可动摇的意志、击杀时双倍治疗效果，并将所有受到的\n伤害减少1/3。你还会根据使用此能力时的受伤程度获得额外的输出伤害加成。\n\n当你的变身结束时，你将被拖入血肉熔炉，被迫与一波波恶魔战斗，\n直到马科列布认为你的债务已偿清。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"vessel of slaughter ability","english_description":"Invokes a blood pact with the Destroyer, temporarily granting you enormous power\nat a dangerous price.\n\nAt the moment the pact is sealed, a massive explosion of damnation will surround\nyou, and you will transform into a demonic avatar, granting you demonic\nresistances, invulnerable will, doubled healing from kills, and reducing all\ndamage you take by 1/3. You will additionally gain a bonus to all outgoing\ndamage proportional to how injured you were when you used this ability.\n\nWhen your transformation expires, you will be dragged down into the Crucible of\nFlesh, and made to fight through waves of demons until Makhleb considers your\ndebt paid.","english_source_name":"vessel of slaughter ability","identity":"ability_description:vessel of slaughter ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。血契危险短时力量、起始天谴爆炸、魔化抗性/意志/击杀双疗/减伤三分之一、按起始伤势增输出、到血肉熔炉抗波还债齐全；damnation误作诅咒。 采用的逐键修复：Vessel of Slaughter ability：血契危险短时力量、起始天谴爆炸、魔化抗性/意志/击杀双疗/减伤三分之一、按起始伤势增输出、到血肉熔炉抗波还债齐全；damnation误作诅咒。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:462；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:927；crawl-ref/source/god-abil.cc:7251","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"从相邻的墙壁跳起冲向敌人，对所有与着陆点相邻的敌人造成冲击，\n这需要花两个回合完成动作。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Vaults off an adjacent wall towards enemies, striking all enemies adjacent to\nthe landing spot and taking two turns to complete the motion.","english_source_name":"wall jump ability"},"fact_sha256":"b9562aa367440a647c4f846dad308b0e2ab6e30cf732d2f8f815f999a100f30a","identity":"ability_description:wall jump ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"从相邻的墙壁跳起冲向敌人，对所有与着陆点相邻的敌人造成冲击，\n这需要花两个回合完成动作。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"wall jump ability","english_description":"Vaults off an adjacent wall towards enemies, striking all enemies adjacent to\nthe landing spot and taking two turns to complete the motion.","english_source_name":"wall jump ability","identity":"ability_description:wall jump ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。相邻墙蹬向敌/落点全邻敌受击/两个回合完成齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:1023；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:587","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将你附近的所有水域变为汹涌的潮汐，试图淹死站在其中或上方的每个敌人。\n需要呼吸空气的敌人也会陷入淹没状态，数回合内无法施放受沉默影响的法术，\n并造成少量窒息伤害。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Turns all of the water near you into a surging tide that attempts to drown every\nenemy standing in or above it. Those who need air to breathe will also become\nFlooded, preventing them from casting spells affected by Silence for several\nturns and dealing minor asphyxiation damage.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.","english_source_name":"watery grave ability"},"fact_sha256":"da827fc471207ba38b3b2cb078afc3226e19dc4445dc40a747439ed9d9766551","identity":"ability_description:watery grave ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"将你附近的所有水域变为汹涌的潮汐，试图淹死站在其中或上方的每个敌人。\n需要呼吸空气的敌人也会陷入淹没状态，数回合内无法施放受沉默影响的法术，\n并造成少量窒息伤害。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"watery grave ability","english_description":"Turns all of the water near you into a surging tide that attempts to drown every\nenemy standing in or above it. Those who need air to breathe will also become\nFlooded, preventing them from casting spells affected by Silence for several\nturns and dealing minor asphyxiation damage.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.","english_source_name":"watery grave ability","identity":"ability_description:watery grave ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。周围所有水域/其中或上方每个敌人/需空气者淹没/数回合禁受沉默法术/少窒息/经验充能齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:1110；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:938","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"念出混沌之语，迫使附近的敌人闪烁远离使用者。\n此外，受影响的敌人还可能因此被减速、束缚或恐惧。念出混沌之语绝非易事，\n会略微降低使用者的生命上限，并使此能力在短时间内无法再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Speaks a word of chaos, forcing enemies nearby to blink away from the user.\nAdditionally, those affected may be slowed, ensnared, or terrified by the\nexperience. Invoking a word of chaos is no easy feat and will drain the user's\nmaximum health somewhat, and the ability then cannot be used again for a short\ntime.","english_source_name":"word of chaos ability"},"fact_sha256":"c60a53e8ab52f3d4700f8f81e571f7822345979cfcf7575d234c99f2ec2d4118","identity":"ability_description:word of chaos ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"念出混沌之语，迫使附近的敌人闪烁远离使用者。\n此外，受影响的敌人还可能因此被减速、束缚或恐惧。念出混沌之语绝非易事，\n会略微降低使用者的生命上限，并使此能力在短时间内无法再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"word of chaos ability","english_description":"Speaks a word of chaos, forcing enemies nearby to blink away from the user.\nAdditionally, those affected may be slowed, ensnared, or terrified by the\nexperience. Invoking a word of chaos is no easy feat and will drain the user's\nmaximum health somewhat, and the ability then cannot be used again for a short\ntime.","english_source_name":"word of chaos ability","identity":"ability_description:word of chaos ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。附近敌人远闪、可能减速/束缚/恐惧、少许HP上限汲取/短禁再用齐全。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt:74；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt:24","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"这个生物每回合受到无视AC的寒冷伤害，有时会爆发出寒冰冲击，伤害附近的盟友。\n当它死亡时，可能会将霜疫传播给其他附近的盟友。\n\n自然、恶魔或神圣生物在生命值降到低点时会被立即杀死，并被冰霜之柱取代。","current_chinese_name":"afflicted by rimeblight monstatus"},"current_english":{"english_description":"This creature suffers AC-ignoring cold damage every turn, and may sometimes\nexplode in a burst of ice that damages nearby allies. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"这个生物受到神圣护盾保护。护盾会准确无误地挡下接下来数次可以格挡的攻击，\n然后消散。\n\n所有被格挡的投射物都会被反射，近战攻击者则可能被光芒致盲。","current_chinese_name":"divinely shielded monstatus"},"current_english":{"english_description":"This creature is protected by a divine shield which will unerringly block the\nnext several blockable assaults before dissipating.\n\nAll blocked projectiles will be reflected and melee attackers may be blinded by\nlight.","english_source_name":"divinely shielded monstatus"},"fact_sha256":"6175a0bfa41af38877d847f73597323145438b5e399dafc6a52325484905be90","identity":"monster_status:divinely shielded monstatus","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物受到神圣护盾保护。护盾会准确无误地挡下接下来数次可以格挡的攻击，\n然后消散。\n\n所有被格挡的投射物都会被反射，近战攻击者则可能被光芒致盲。","current_chinese_name":"divinely shielded monstatus","description_key":"divinely shielded monstatus","english_description":"This creature is protected by a divine shield which will unerringly block the\nnext several blockable assaults before dissipating.\n\nAll blocked projectiles will be reflected and melee attackers may be blinded by\nlight.","english_source_name":"divinely shielded monstatus","identity":"monster_status:divinely shielded monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。接下来数次可格挡攻击必中挡、反射所有被挡投射物、近战攻击者可能失明完整。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:188；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:662；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:169；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:60；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:680；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:1688","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"这个生物被一圈不自然的沉默力场环绕，力场内消除所有噪音，\n阻止许多生物（包括你）阅读卷轴、施法或祈求神助所需的发声。\n\n如果此效果是由法术引起的，力场范围会随时间缩小。","current_chinese_name":"radiating silence monstatus"},"current_english":{"english_description":"This creature is surrounded by a field of unnatural silence which eliminates\nall noise made within it as well as preventing the vocalisations required for\nmany creatures (including you) to read scrolls, cast spells, or invoke divine\naid.\n\nIf this effect was caused by a spell, the radius of the field will shrink over\ntime.","english_source_name":"radiating silence monstatus"},"fact_sha256":"f9c34c9e0548b356b9bd62964f4d7b5c3733a0704359760e9a094a15ea2ecc89","identity":"monster_status:radiating silence monstatus","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物被一圈不自然的沉默力场环绕，力场内消除所有噪音，\n阻止许多生物（包括你）阅读卷轴、施法或祈求神助所需的发声。\n\n如果此效果是由法术引起的，力场范围会随时间缩小。","current_chinese_name":"radiating silence monstatus","description_key":"radiating silence monstatus","english_description":"This creature is surrounded by a field of unnatural silence which eliminates\nall noise made within it as well as preventing the vocalisations required for\nmany creatures (including you) to read scrolls, cast spells, or invoke divine\naid.\n\nIf this effect was caused by a spell, the radius of the field will shrink over\ntime.","english_source_name":"radiating silence monstatus","identity":"monster_status:radiating silence monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。力场消噪及包括玩家的读卷/施法/神助发声限制，法术来源半径随时缩小完整。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:467；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:394；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:50；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:60；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:680；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:1688","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"这个生物的碎裂武器已完全充能，其下一次攻击将更加精准、造成大幅增加的伤害、\n并且劈砍范围扩大。如果它移动了，此效果将消失。","current_chinese_name":"ready to sunder monstatus"},"current_english":{"english_description":"This creature's Sundering weapon is fully charged and its next attack will be\nmore accurate, inflict greatly increased damage, and cleave with increased range.\nThis effect will be lost if it moves.","english_source_name":"ready to sunder monstatus"},"fact_sha256":"333a0a27bf0ffdfa59ff1f08621a88c6db9a20d8ae10d94bc0c6a2a5c68f7eff","identity":"monster_status:ready to sunder monstatus","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物的碎裂武器已完全充能，其下一次攻击将更加精准、造成大幅增加的伤害、\n并且劈砍范围扩大。如果它移动了，此效果将消失。","current_chinese_name":"ready to sunder monstatus","description_key":"ready to sunder monstatus","english_description":"This creature's Sundering weapon is fully charged and its next attack will be\nmore accurate, inflict greatly increased damage, and cleave with increased range.\nThis effect will be lost if it moves.","english_source_name":"ready to sunder monstatus","identity":"monster_status:ready to sunder monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。满充能、下一击更准/增伤/范围更大、移动失效完整；同一铭印名称需统一。 采用的逐键修复：ready to sunder monstatus：满充能、下一击更准/增伤/范围更大、移动失效完整；同一铭印名称需统一。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:491；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:414；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:164；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:60；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:680；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:1688 原发现：MS-L07","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当这个生物受到伤害时，它会将伤害量的三分之二反射回造成伤害的来源。","current_chinese_name":"reflecting injuries monstatus"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever this creature suffers damage, it inflicts 2/3rds as much damage back upon\nwhatever damaged it.","english_source_name":"reflecting injuries monstatus"},"fact_sha256":"735762f1249fad0e40943617a58767db022a9e65ab73ff0f0e69fe867d86319e","identity":"monster_status:reflecting injuries monstatus","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"每当这个生物受到伤害时，它会将伤害量的三分之二反射回造成伤害的来源。","current_chinese_name":"reflecting injuries monstatus","description_key":"reflecting injuries monstatus","english_description":"Whenever this creature suffers damage, it inflicts 2/3rds as much damage back upon\nwhatever damaged it.","english_source_name":"reflecting injuries monstatus","identity":"monster_status:reflecting injuries monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。受伤后将2/3伤害返回来源，比例与主客体正确；复数HUD译文漏项另修。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:501；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:423；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:38；crawl-ref/source/monster.cc:4398；crawl-ref/source/fineff.cc:1082 原发现：MS-L11","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"这个生物以与其最大生命值成比例的大幅提高的速度恢复生命值。","current_chinese_name":"regenerating monstatus"},"current_english":{"english_description":"This creature regenerates health at a greatly increased rate, proportion to their\nmaximum health.","english_source_name":"regenerating monstatus"},"fact_sha256":"2ee87380eb4b4be15de7cecf2be9fa309e86781536d50e0d88e71ca15023b8cd","identity":"monster_status:regenerating monstatus","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物以与其最大生命值成比例的大幅提高的速度恢复生命值。","current_chinese_name":"regenerating monstatus","description_key":"regenerating monstatus","english_description":"This creature regenerates health at a greatly increased rate, proportion to their\nmaximum health.","english_source_name":"regenerating monstatus","identity":"monster_status:regenerating monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。恢复速度大幅提高且与最大生命成比例，中文略拗口但命题完整。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:506；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:427；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:63；crawl-ref/source/mon-act.cc:167","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"这个生物被命令向指定方向撤退，在获得新指示或行进足够距离之前，\n它不会攻击或回到你身边。","current_chinese_name":"retreating monstatus"},"current_english":{"english_description":"This creature has been ordered to flee in a given direction, and will not attack\nor return to your side until they are given new instructions or have travelled a\nsufficient distance","english_source_name":"retreating monstatus"},"fact_sha256":"2746203f0dad4c9c58cc09092e217f1a0c5da973e2f68998b8d26848d74bba47","identity":"monster_status:retreating monstatus","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物被命令向指定方向撤退，在获得新指示或行进足够距离之前，\n它不会攻击或回到你身边。","current_chinese_name":"retreating monstatus","description_key":"retreating monstatus","english_description":"This creature has been ordered to flee in a given direction, and will not attack\nor return to your side until they are given new instructions or have travelled a\nsufficient distance","english_source_name":"retreating monstatus","identity":"monster_status:retreating monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。沿指定方向撤离，新指示或足够距离之前不攻击/不归队，双重终止条件在。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt:511；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monstatus.txt:431；crawl-ref/source/mon-info-flag-name.h:143；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:60；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:680；crawl-ref/source/mon-info.cc:1688","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你的生命值降至上限的50%或以下时，你进行一次地狱仪式，\n向附近的敌人释放一阵血箭齐射。你将为每个有效目标至少射出一支箭，\n但如果目标较少可能射出额外的箭。祈神技能提高这些箭的伤害，\n马科列布总会为被此效果击杀的敌人赐予你治疗。\n\n完成一次鲜血仪式后，必须等生命值完全恢复才能再次发动。","current_chinese_name":"颂礼者印记","display_strings[0].chinese":"颂礼者印记","display_strings[1].chinese":"你携带着颂礼者印记。","display_strings[2].chinese":"你的苦难将以鲜血偿还。"},"current_english":{"display_strings[0].english":"Mark of the Celebrant","display_strings[1].english":"You bear the Mark of the Celebrant.","display_strings[2].english":"Your suffering will be repaid in blood.","english_description":"Whenever you fall to 50% of your maximum HP or less, you perform an infernal rite,\nunleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"一个谋杀之恶魔化身潜伏在你的灵魂中。每当你用近战击杀一个敌人时，\n有很小概率它会醒来并显现为包围你的镰刀刀锋漩涡。这些刀锋会在你\n攻击时一起攻击，并在你成功闪避敌人攻击时反击。\n\n附身期间，你可以快速冲锋接近敌人；但若有超过短暂片刻未进行攻击，\n恶魔存在就会再次在你体内沉睡。","current_chinese_name":"处决印记","display_strings[0].chinese":"处决印记","display_strings[1].chinese":"你携带着处决印记。","display_strings[2].chinese":"杀戮在你灵魂中扎下了根。"},"current_english":{"display_strings[0].english":"Mark of Execution","display_strings[1].english":"You bear the Mark of Execution.","display_strings[2].english":"Murder takes root in your soul.","english_description":"A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. armour、ZH所有护甲；player_armour_shield_spell_penalty只将body_armour_penalty除4以实现身体护甲ER减半，盾牌惩罚在其后另加，不减半。；Your spellcasting is no longer less encumbered by armour.：M07：失去减轻护甲施法阻碍的效果，不是变成护甲完全不阻碍；护甲对你施法的阻碍不再减轻。；Your spellcasting no longer less encumbered by armour.：M07：源码已替换为补is后的完整英文键；旧键无当前源代码caller，退役。 {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你发生传送时，都有概率将另一只怪物一同拉到你的新位置。\n短距离传送只会拉走你原位置视野内的怪物，长距离传送则可能拉来本层任何地方的怪物。\n\n这种经历会使怪物略感迷乱，被拉来后无法立即行动。","current_chinese_name":"空间纠缠","display_strings[0].chinese":"空间纠缠","display_strings[1].chinese":"当你位移时，有时会将一个怪物一起拉过去。","display_strings[2].chinese":"你感到周围的空间开始纠结在一起。","display_strings[3].chinese":"你感到空间从你身上解开了纠缠。"},"current_english":{"display_strings[0].english":"spatial entanglement","display_strings[1].english":"When you translocate, a monster is sometimes pulled along with you.","display_strings[2].english":"You feel space start to knot itself around you.","display_strings[3].english":"You feel space untangle itself from you.","english_description":"Whenever you translocate, there is a chance that another monster is pulled\nalong to your new location. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的胶状身体有八个触手，可以帮助你在浅水或深水中移动，并能在近战时束缚敌人。\n每只触手都可以戴上戒指，但你需要四只触手用来移动，根据武器的大小，\n两只或四只触手可以拿一把武器，两只触手可以拿一面盾牌。\n\n当你近战时，你的触手会尝试束缚敌人。（你无法束缚比你大的怪物。）\n顺便一提，每当你近战攻击时，你有三分之二的机会发动破坏性的“挤压”攻击。","current_chinese_name":"触手","display_strings[0].chinese":"触手","display_strings[1].chinese":"你的手臂是触手，可以缠绕敌人。","display_strings[2].chinese":"你的手臂感到如触手般。","display_strings[3].chinese":"你的手臂不再感到如触手般了。"},"current_english":{"display_strings[0].english":"tentacles","display_strings[1].english":"You have tentacles for arms and can constrict enemies.","display_strings[2].english":"Your arms feel tentacular.","display_strings[3].english":"Your arms no longer feel tentacular.","english_description":"Your gelatinous body has eight tentacles that help you move around in shallow\nor deep water and can be used to constrict enemies while attacking them in\nmelee. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你散播不幸时，与生者领域的联系会变强。\n\n每当你或盟友对附近敌人施加新的负面状态（中毒除外）时，你的护甲等级会暂时提高。\n受影响的不同敌人越多，加成越高；若不继续施加新的不幸，加成会随时间衰减。\n\n以你当前的经验等级，此方式最多可获得\n{{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} 点护甲等级。","current_chinese_name":"戏法者","display_strings[0].chinese":"戏法者","display_strings[1].chinese":"当你对附近的敌人施加魔法灾厄时，你获得防御。"},"current_english":{"display_strings[0].english":"trickster","display_strings[1].english":"You gain AC when you inflict magical misfortune on nearby enemies.","english_description":"Your connection to the realm of the living grows stronger as you spread\nmisfortune.\n\nWhenever you or your allies inflict new negative status effects upon nearby\nenemies (other than poison), your AC temporarily increases. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你可以对随机生成的神器使用武器附魔卷轴和护甲附魔卷轴。\n\n附魔等级不能超过同类普通物品通常可达到的上限，特别奇异的神器则完全无法附魔。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You can use scrolls of enchant weapon and armour upon random artefacts.\n\nThis cannot raise their enchantment above what would normally be possible on a\nmundane item of the same type, and cannot affect especially unusual artefacts\nat all.","english_source_name":"artefact enchanting mutation"},"fact_sha256":"b949e11e5c85cd47f015387bfdcf76bf959805880abdcf3fab5ac587cbf9c37e","identity":"mutation_description:artefact enchanting mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你可以对随机生成的神器使用武器附魔卷轴和护甲附魔卷轴。\n\n附魔等级不能超过同类普通物品通常可达到的上限，特别奇异的神器则完全无法附魔。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"artefact enchanting mutation","english_description":"You can use scrolls of enchant weapon and armour upon random artefacts.\n\nThis cannot raise their enchantment above what would normally be possible on a\nmundane item of the same type, and cannot affect especially unusual artefacts\nat all.","english_source_name":"artefact enchanting mutation","identity":"mutation_description:artefact enchanting mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:921；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:907","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你发动近战攻击时，你会短暂获得等同于杀戮加成的盾牌强度，\n并获得一项基于变形术技能的固定额外加成。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You briefly gain SH equal to your slaying whenever you perform a melee attack\n(with an additional flat bonus based on your Shapeshifting skill).","english_source_name":"blade parry mutation"},"fact_sha256":"9b9fcefbeca8fb05ecda5e596150580df20865dcbff16ae70cec3b8a5b6abe65","identity":"mutation_description:blade parry mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你发动近战攻击时，你会短暂获得等同于杀戮加成的盾牌强度，\n并获得一项基于变形术技能的固定额外加成。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"blade parry mutation","english_description":"You briefly gain SH equal to your slaying whenever you perform a melee attack\n(with an additional flat bonus based on your Shapeshifting skill).","english_source_name":"blade parry mutation","identity":"mutation_description:blade parry mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。每次近战短暂获得基于杀戮值的SH并加技能固定值，和player_parrying一致；盾牌强度虽非此处首选短标签，未改变数值含义。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1240；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:913","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你用偷袭杀死自然生物类、植物类或恶魔类怪物时，它可能会复生并作为吸血鬼仆从为你效力。\n仆从保留生前的全部能力，但属于亡灵，并会获得吸血鬼啃咬攻击，\n且对沉睡敌人造成更高近战伤害。会施法的仆从还会学会吸血鬼汲取法术。\n\n你只能在没有仆从时创造一个；它会在短时间后不可避免地化为尘土。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When you kill a natural, plant, or demonic monster with a stab attack, they may\nrise again to serve you as a vampiric thrall. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你施放法术时，相邻的怪物可能会麻痹。在施放更高等级的法术时，\n效果会更为强大，但具有更强意志力的怪物能够抵御它。这个变异每升一级，\n就能影响更远的怪物。这个变异达到第三级，你在挥动魔杖时也能麻痹怪物。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When you cast spells, there's a chance that adjacent monsters will be\nparalysed. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的手散发着邪恶的能量，只要你的副手没有装备东西，\n在近战时就能造成无法抵御的伤害。你的触碰攻击会造成无视护甲的伤害，\n并且这个变异每升一级会增加更多攻击力。这个变异达到第三级，\n能削弱受到你触碰攻击的敌人的意志力，但你将无法戴手套。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your hands glow with unholy energy, allowing you to inflict irresistible damage\nwhen launching melee attacks as long as your off-hand is free. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你在近战中杀死可食用的敌人时（即敌对、非召唤的活物或植物怪物），\n巨口便会将其吞食，在短时间内大幅提升你的生命恢复速度。\n敌人越强大，此效果的持续时间就越长。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When you kill an edible enemy in melee (any hostile, non-summoned, living or\nplant monster), your maw devours it, greatly increasing your regeneration for a\nshort while. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你的生命值降至上限的 40% 时，电鳗会猛烈放电，以其正常电击伤害的两倍\n打击你周围 2 格内所有相连的目标——无论敌友。\n\n此效果在你完全恢复前无法再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When your health drops to 40% of your max HP, your eels violently discharge\nelectricity, striking all connected targets within 2 tiles of yourself - be they\nfriend or foe - for twice the damage their electricity normally does.\n\nThis effect cannot activate again until you fully heal.","english_source_name":"eeljolt mutation"},"fact_sha256":"a3bc0c12d9d324159cfba6e8b15b760d3ebee8a04d07d3ea197fd788ba48780d","identity":"mutation_description:eeljolt mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你的生命值降至上限的 40% 时，电鳗会猛烈放电，以其正常电击伤害的两倍\n打击你周围 2 格内所有相连的目标——无论敌友。\n\n此效果在你完全恢复前无法再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"eeljolt mutation","english_description":"When your health drops to 40% of your max HP, your eels violently discharge\nelectricity, striking all connected targets within 2 tiles of yourself - be they\nfriend or foe - for twice the damage their electricity normally does.\n\nThis effect cannot activate again until you fully heal.","english_source_name":"eeljolt mutation","identity":"mutation_description:eeljolt mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。低血40%触发、两格内相连敌友皆受双倍伤害、满血前不能重复均保留；ouch.cc与player-reacts重置对应。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1232；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:959","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"四枚元素晶体漂浮在你身旁，分别对应土、火、气、冰魔法。\n施放其中一个学派的法术时，只要对应晶体的作用范围内有敌人，它就会迸发力量，\n伤害三格内的至多三个敌人，并为自身充能。\n\n所有晶体充能完毕后，你会暂时获得元素伤害抗性，并随时间恢复少量生命值。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Four elemental crystals float alongside you - one corresponding to each of\nEarth, Fire, Air, and Ice magic. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你没有实体，而是通过附身物品与世界互动。因此，你可以用任意组合“装备”最多 6 件\n靴子、手套、斗篷或头盔，但身体护甲太大，无法以这种方式有效操纵。\n\n更高等级时，你甚至能让所附身的护甲短暂地独立出击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have no physical body and instead interact with the world through haunting\nobjects. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的呼吸散发出刺骨寒意，在战斗时将附近墙壁冻实。\n\n每当你攻击时，目标或你自己相邻的一面随机墙壁会变得严寒。\n严寒墙壁每回合会伤害与其相邻的敌人；敌人周围的严寒墙壁达到最大数量时，\n伤害最高可翻倍。此伤害随变形术技能提高。\n\n如果你停止攻击，墙壁会迅速融化。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your breath radiates an intense chill which freezes nearby walls solid as you\nfight.\n\nWhenever you attack, you turn a random wall adjacent to your target or yourself\nfrigid. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你异常强健的双腿让你可以用 <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 在眨眼间跳过短距离，\n但步行速度低于平均水平。\n\n此变异的第二级能让你跳得更远。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your uniquely muscular legs allow you to hop short distances in the blink of an\neye with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>, though your walking speed is\nbelow average.\n\nThe second level of this mutation allows you to hop farther.","english_source_name":"frog-like legs mutation"},"fact_sha256":"21d242990b0e2cf439be493b6df85555d40cb762a54a14df4a04d41e0035b16a","identity":"mutation_description:frog-like legs mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你异常强健的双腿让你可以用 <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 在眨眼间跳过短距离，\n但步行速度低于平均水平。\n\n此变异的第二级能让你跳得更远。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"frog-like legs mutation","english_description":"Your uniquely muscular legs allow you to hop short distances in the blink of an\neye with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>, though your walking speed is\nbelow average.\n\nThe second level of this mutation allows you to hop farther.","english_source_name":"frog-like legs mutation","identity":"mutation_description:frog-like legs mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:722；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1019","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"探索时，你会逐渐将地牢中的空气凝结成雾药水，喝下后能使你变得无形。\n\n你同时最多只能携带五瓶雾药水；如果你永久离开此形态，它们就会被销毁。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"As you explore, you will gradually condense the dungeon air into potions of mist,\nwhich allow you to become intangible.\n\nYou can carry no more than five of these at a time and they will be destroyed if\nyou ever permanently leave this form.","english_source_name":"gather mist mutation"},"fact_sha256":"e22bb43cb399f630e76168c3068cfe76e4c1126a5cbaaf3df7c3869a500fcf38","identity":"mutation_description:gather mist mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"探索时，你会逐渐将地牢中的空气凝结成雾药水，喝下后能使你变得无形。\n\n你同时最多只能携带五瓶雾药水；如果你永久离开此形态，它们就会被销毁。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"gather mist mutation","english_description":"As you explore, you will gradually condense the dungeon air into potions of mist,\nwhich allow you to become intangible.\n\nYou can carry no more than five of these at a time and they will be destroyed if\nyou ever permanently leave this form.","english_source_name":"gather mist mutation","identity":"mutation_description:gather mist mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。探索凝制雾药水、无实体效果、最多五瓶和永久离开才销毁完整；无形此处指intangible，未改成隐形机制。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1294；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1408","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当受伤使你的生命值降至上限的50%或更低时，愤怒的蜜蜂就会从你体内蜂拥而出，保护你。\n\n在你的生命值完全恢复之前，此效果不会再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever an injury reduces your health to 50% or less, angry bees will swarm\nout of your body to defend you.\n\nThis effect cannot happen again until your health is fully recovered.","english_source_name":"hive swarm mutation"},"fact_sha256":"12564d5b9d5f1af6f7ee5c6aaa58dd837d04ea46ac42c8e66776b4786c750cb3","identity":"mutation_description:hive swarm mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当受伤使你的生命值降至上限的50%或更低时，愤怒的蜜蜂就会从你体内蜂拥而出，保护你。\n\n在你的生命值完全恢复之前，此效果不会再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"hive swarm mutation","english_description":"Whenever an injury reduces your health to 50% or less, angry bees will swarm\nout of your body to defend you.\n\nThis effect cannot happen again until your health is fully recovered.","english_source_name":"hive swarm mutation","identity":"mutation_description:hive swarm mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。上批文本已改变，独立复核当前EN/ZH全部段落；原问题的触发、阈值、概率或目标范围已经保留，仍与本卡机制证据对照。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1124；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1041","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

Foes beware!","english_source_name":"hurl damnation mutation","identity":"mutation_description:hurl damnation mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。hurl damnation的have仍为诅咒之火、正文天遣为错字；禁止Translocations短句使用位移魔法而当前学派名为传送系；暴君正文Might是ENCH_MIGHT状态，却沿用了法术标题强壮。ER正文出现负重评级/妨碍等级，健壮体格短句又说移动阻碍，易误为移动速度。 采用的逐键修复：hurl damnation mutation：hurl damnation的have仍为诅咒之火、正文天遣为错字；禁止Translocations短句使用位移魔法而当前学派名为传送系；暴君正文Might是ENCH_MIGHT状态，却沿用了法术标题强壮。ER正文出现负重评级/妨碍等级，健壮体格短句又说移动阻碍，易误为移动速度。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:660；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:463；docs/glossary.md:261；docs/glossary.md:294；crawl-ref/source/god-passive.cc:2256；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6556；crawl-ref/source/skills.cc:2696；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1341；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:881；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:609；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:418；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:929；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1192；crawl-ref/source/mutation-data.h:694；crawl-ref/source/mutation-data.h:1994；crawl-ref/source/mutation-data.h:1561 原发现：M14","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"一个谋杀之恶魔化身潜伏在你的灵魂中。每当你用近战击杀一个敌人时，\n有很小概率它会醒来并显现为包围你的镰刀刀锋漩涡。这些刀锋会在你\n攻击时一起攻击，并在你成功闪避敌人攻击时反击。\n\n附身期间，你可以快速冲锋接近敌人；但若有超过短暂片刻未进行攻击，\n恶魔存在就会再次在你体内沉睡。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. Whenever you kill\nan enemy in melee, there is a small chance for it to awaken and manifest as a\nmaelstrom of scythe-like blades enveloping you. These blades will attack\nwhenever you do and also retaliate whenever you successfully dodge an enemy\nattack.\n\nYou have the ability to rampage swiftly towards enemies while possessed, but if\nyou spend more than a short while doing anything other than attacking, the\ndemonic presence will go dormant inside you once again.","english_source_name":"mark of execution mutation"},"fact_sha256":"91a6a5e88f629b1b54027fb3d97c5d018503c84b5cc1c68a43f652502e9c98c8","identity":"mutation_description:mark of execution mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"一个谋杀之恶魔化身潜伏在你的灵魂中。每当你用近战击杀一个敌人时，\n有很小概率它会醒来并显现为包围你的镰刀刀锋漩涡。这些刀锋会在你\n攻击时一起攻击，并在你成功闪避敌人攻击时反击。\n\n附身期间，你可以快速冲锋接近敌人；但若有超过短暂片刻未进行攻击，\n恶魔存在就会再次在你体内沉睡。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of execution mutation","english_description":"A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你击杀敌人时，它们有很小概率爆炸为一阵猛烈的血雨，对相邻的敌人造成\n与受害者最大生命值成比例的伤害。\n\n死于这种爆炸的敌人自身也总是会爆炸。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When you kill enemies, they have a small chance to explode in a violent rain of\ngore, which damages adjacent foes proportional to the victim's maximum health.\n\nEnemies who die to this explosion will always explode themselves.","english_source_name":"mark of haemoclasm mutation"},"fact_sha256":"91825f6d2fceb1c1907a69768c22aba6c0b7bde730d30148c8560d9727dee3c8","identity":"mutation_description:mark of haemoclasm mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你击杀敌人时，它们有很小概率爆炸为一阵猛烈的血雨，对相邻的敌人造成\n与受害者最大生命值成比例的伤害。\n\n死于这种爆炸的敌人自身也总是会爆炸。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of haemoclasm mutation","english_description":"When you kill enemies, they have a small chance to explode in a violent rain of\ngore, which damages adjacent foes proportional to the victim's maximum health.\n\nEnemies who die to this explosion will always explode themselves.","english_source_name":"mark of haemoclasm mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of haemoclasm mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1396；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:852","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你的生命值降至上限的50%或以下时，你进行一次地狱仪式，\n向附近的敌人释放一阵血箭齐射。你将为每个有效目标至少射出一支箭，\n但如果目标较少可能射出额外的箭。祈神技能提高这些箭的伤害，\n马科列布总会为被此效果击杀的敌人赐予你治疗。\n\n完成一次鲜血仪式后，必须等生命值完全恢复才能再次发动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever you fall to 50% of your maximum HP or less, you perform an infernal rite,\nunleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"赋予你杀戮化身能力，允许你在短时间内变身为一个强大的恶魔化身，\n大幅提升攻击和防御，代价是之后被拖入血肉熔炉并被迫为自由而战。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Grants you the Vessel of Slaughter ability, allowing you to transform into a\npowerful demonic avatar with greatly boosted offence and defence for a short\nperiod of time, in exchange for being dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh\nafterward and made to fight for your freedom.","english_source_name":"mark of the fanatic mutation"},"fact_sha256":"e7cc727bf3cbcdf4d04245a3f59567a28170bec6a2dded3b283671e46337fddd","identity":"mutation_description:mark of the fanatic mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"赋予你杀戮化身能力，允许你在短时间内变身为一个强大的恶魔化身，\n大幅提升攻击和防御，代价是之后被拖入血肉熔炉并被迫为自由而战。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of the fanatic mutation","english_description":"Grants you the Vessel of Slaughter ability, allowing you to transform into a\npowerful demonic avatar with greatly boosted offence and defence for a short\nperiod of time, in exchange for being dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh\nafterward and made to fight for your freedom.","english_source_name":"mark of the fanatic mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of the fanatic mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1433；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:868","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的地狱仆从能力被替换为地狱军团，允许你随时间召唤一小支恶魔军队。\n虽然个体存活短暂，但只要状态持续，它们的数量无穷无尽，\n并且永远不会对你敌对。\n\n你也可以通过你召唤的盟友释放马科列布的毁灭而不伤害它们。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your Infernal Servant ability is replaced with Infernal Legion, allowing you to\ncall in a small army of demons over time. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你身受重伤且孤身一人时，收割者可能会来索命。它们免疫非相邻来源的一切伤害；\n若你的经验等级低于 14，它们还会行动缓慢。经验等级更高时，可能同时出现多个收割者。\n\n此灾祸解除时，以这种方式召唤的所有收割者都会立即消失。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When you are badly injured and alone, a reaper may come to claim you. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的脚变成一条长长的蛇状尾巴，使你能在水中保持稳定，\n但移动速度会比大多数物种慢得多。这个变异达到第二级，\n你在近战时可以用尾巴束缚敌人。你的尾巴一次只能束缚一个敌人，\n在这个变异等级，每次攻击都会尝试开始或再次进行束缚。\n成功率主要取决于敏捷、格斗技能和任何杀戮加成。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have a long, snake-like tail in place of feet. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你在休息时无法恢复健康，也无法获得提升恢复速度的魔法效果。\n至于提升生命力的手段，像药水和虔诚的祈祷仍能治疗你，\n某些神圣祈祷能力可以短暂赋予你自愈的能力。\n作为补偿，你可以通过<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 键治疗自己，\n但代价是要永久地失去一些法力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You do not regenerate health while resting, and are unable to receive the\neffects of magic that hastens the speed of regeneration. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"只要没有持握双手武器，也没有装备盾牌或魔法球，你就可以在副手持握一件单手武器。\n主手攻击后会追加一次副手攻击，攻击延迟由两件武器的平均值决定。\n远程武器只能追击远程武器的攻击，近战武器也同样只能追击近战攻击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You can wield a one-handed weapon in your off-hand, if not wielding a\ntwo-handed weapon or wearing a shield or orb. Ranged weapons can only follow attacks by ranged\nweapons, and likewise melee weapons.","english_source_name":"off-hand wielding mutation"},"fact_sha256":"e252a572ff289ee30508d0405c7dfa5abd043c0ec135ec264a6de55a0cd15851","identity":"mutation_description:off-hand wielding mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"只要没有持握双手武器，也没有装备盾牌或魔法球，你就可以在副手持握一件单手武器。\n主手攻击后会追加一次副手攻击，攻击延迟由两件武器的平均值决定。\n远程武器只能追击远程武器的攻击，近战武器也同样只能追击近战攻击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"off-hand wielding mutation","english_description":"You can wield a one-handed weapon in your off-hand, if not wielding a\ntwo-handed weapon or wearing a shield or orb. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"一小群跃动的火星和明亮的余烬追随着你的动作。\n每当你对没有 rFire∞ 的敌人造成火焰伤害，或对没有 rElec∞ 的敌人造成电击伤害时，\n都有机会以柔和的微光勾勒出它的轮廓，使其更容易被击中；若其处于隐形状态，还会使其显形。\n此变异每升一级，触发概率就会提高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"A subtle flock of eager sparks and bright cinders chases after your movements.\nWhenever you deal fire damage to a foe without rFire∞ or electric damage to a\nfoe without rElec∞, you have a chance to outline it with a soft glow of light,\nwhich makes it easier to hit and reveals it if invisible. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你发生传送时，都有概率将另一只怪物一同拉到你的新位置。\n短距离传送只会拉走你原位置视野内的怪物，长距离传送则可能拉来本层任何地方的怪物。\n\n这种经历会使怪物略感迷乱，被拉来后无法立即行动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever you translocate, there is a chance that another monster is pulled\nalong to your new location. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的胶状身体有八个触手，可以帮助你在浅水或深水中移动，并能在近战时束缚敌人。\n每只触手都可以戴上戒指，但你需要四只触手用来移动，根据武器的大小，\n两只或四只触手可以拿一把武器，两只触手可以拿一面盾牌。\n\n当你近战时，你的触手会尝试束缚敌人。（你无法束缚比你大的怪物。）\n顺便一提，每当你近战攻击时，你有三分之二的机会发动破坏性的“挤压”攻击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your gelatinous body has eight tentacles that help you move around in shallow\nor deep water and can be used to constrict enemies while attacking them in\nmelee. Each tentacle can wear a ring, but you need four of them to move around,\nand either two or four tentacles to hold a weapon depending on its size, and\ntwo tentacles to hold a shield.\n\nYour tentacles will try to constrict foes which you attack in melee. (You cannot\nconstrict monsters larger than you.) Independently, you have a two-thirds chance\nof launching a damaging 'squeeze' attack whenever you attack in melee.","english_source_name":"tentacles mutation"},"fact_sha256":"34ded596eb8b0f81fe1afa5331c0db90cd02239d09a4662ef73cd076f6935e8d","identity":"mutation_description:tentacles mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的胶状身体有八个触手，可以帮助你在浅水或深水中移动，并能在近战时束缚敌人。\n每只触手都可以戴上戒指，但你需要四只触手用来移动，根据武器的大小，\n两只或四只触手可以拿一把武器，两只触手可以拿一面盾牌。\n\n当你近战时，你的触手会尝试束缚敌人。（你无法束缚比你大的怪物。）\n顺便一提，每当你近战攻击时，你有三分之二的机会发动破坏性的“挤压”攻击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"tentacles mutation","english_description":"Your gelatinous body has eight tentacles that help you move around in shallow\nor deep water and can be used to constrict enemies while attacking them in\nmelee. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的血液已经与时间流动失去同步。每当你的生命值降至上限的三分之二或以下，\n流出的血液就会奇异地涌过周围，使视野内最强的盟友加速；每级此变异会影响两个盟友。\n触发后，在你的生命值完全恢复前，血液无法再次扭曲时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your blood has desynchronised itself from the flow of time. After doing so, your blood will be unable to\nfurther dilate time until your HP has fully recovered.","english_source_name":"time-warped blood mutation"},"fact_sha256":"14232d42637098a0d9a8cb1c2cb36553582e351a756469b1c4fa871b25e4ed8d","identity":"mutation_description:time-warped blood mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的血液已经与时间流动失去同步。每当你的生命值降至上限的三分之二或以下，\n流出的血液就会奇异地涌过周围，使视野内最强的盟友加速；每级此变异会影响两个盟友。\n触发后，在你的生命值完全恢复前，血液无法再次扭曲时间。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"time-warped blood mutation","english_description":"Your blood has desynchronised itself from the flow of time. After doing so, your blood will be unable to\nfurther dilate time until your HP has fully recovered.","english_source_name":"time-warped blood mutation","identity":"mutation_description:time-warped blood mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。颂礼者只在hp*2>hp_max时拒绝，所以100上限50HP可以触发，EN below50%与ZH50%以下排除此点。时间之血只在hp>hp_max*2/3时拒绝，即HP≤floor(2*maxHP/3)可触发；100上限66HP也触发，而EN/ZH below66%排除该点。这是实际边界差异，不是要求统一百分比写法。 采用的逐键修复：time-warped blood mutation：颂礼者只在hp*2>hp_max时拒绝，所以100上限50HP可以触发，EN below50%与ZH50%以下排除此点。时间之血只在hp>hp_max*2/3时拒绝，即HP≤floor(2*maxHP/3)可触发；100上限66HP也触发，而EN/ZH below66%排除该点。这是实际边界差异，不是要求统一百分比写法。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:141；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1264；crawl-ref/source/god-passive.cc:2302；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:720；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1403；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:859 原发现：M17","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你散播不幸时，与生者领域的联系会变强。\n\n每当你或盟友对附近敌人施加新的负面状态（中毒除外）时，你的护甲等级会暂时提高。\n受影响的不同敌人越多，加成越高；若不继续施加新的不幸，加成会随时间衰减。\n\n以你当前的经验等级，此方式最多可获得\n{{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} 点护甲等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your connection to the realm of the living grows stronger as you spread\nmisfortune.\n\nWhenever you or your allies inflict new negative status effects upon nearby\nenemies (other than poison), your AC temporarily increases. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你是完全的亡灵，因此免疫毒素、瘴气、恐惧、睡眠、负能量、折磨、溺水和孢子攻击的效果。\n\n你的形态无法再通过魔法改变，因此免受变形术影响，但也无法佩戴护符。\n如果某个效果会使你发生变异，便会改为暂时降低你的生命上限。\n\n你容易受到神怒武器和某些魔法的伤害，而且无法狂暴。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are fully undead, granting you immunity to poison, miasma, fear, sleep,\nnegative energy, torment, drowning, and the effects of spore attacks.\n\nYour form cannot be further changed by magical means, protecting you from\npolymorph, but also preventing you from wearing talismans. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的身体由能灵活变形的元素水构成，可以从数格外发动近战攻击，\n包括各种辅助攻击。\n\n偷袭所需的精确动作仍只能在与目标相邻时完成；无论从哪里攻击，\n斧头也只能顺劈到与你相邻的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your body is formed of elemental water that changes shape flexibly, allowing you\nto reach and perform melee attacks from several tiles away - {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你长出一条细长的橙色尾巴，在近战时能够扫打敌人。\n这个变异每升一级会增强你的尾巴的力量，并使其变成尖锐的螫刺。\n这个变异达到第三级，那些不幸被螫刺击中的怪物会被短暂虚弱，\n但你将无法穿戴披风或围巾。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have a thin, orange tail, allowing you to attack foes when launching melee\nattacks. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你用近战攻击杀死敌人时，会获得随变形术技能提高的临时杀戮加成。\n\n此加成最多叠加至 +12；只要你继续发动近战攻击，就不会消失。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever you kill an enemy with a melee attack, you gain a temporary slaying\nbonus that increases with your Shapeshifting skill.\n\nThis bonus stacks up to +12 and will not expire so long as you continue to\nperform melee attacks.","english_source_name":"werefury mutation"},"fact_sha256":"2f986443b236e1358f6d5c36fa682352066bf3ab3f0a4d376527a6ec81d6af2f","identity":"mutation_description:werefury mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你用近战攻击杀死敌人时，会获得随变形术技能提高的临时杀戮加成。\n\n此加成最多叠加至 +12；只要你继续发动近战攻击，就不会消失。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"werefury mutation","english_description":"Whenever you kill an enemy with a melee attack, you gain a temporary slaying\nbonus that increases with your Shapeshifting skill.\n\nThis bonus stacks up to +12 and will not expire so long as you continue to\nperform melee attacks.","english_source_name":"werefury mutation","identity":"mutation_description:werefury mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。近战击杀、临时随技能增长的杀戮、最多+12、持续近战维持全部保留。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1172；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1314","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你在近战中杀死敌人时，若狼人狂怒加成至少为 5，你可能会发出恐怖嚎叫；\n若能克服附近敌人的意志力，就会尝试以恐惧将它们全部定在原地。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When you kill an enemy in melee, if your werefury bonus is at least 5, you may\nunleash a terrifying howl that attempts to freeze all nearby enemies in place\nwith fear if it overcomes their willpower.","english_source_name":"werehowl mutation"},"fact_sha256":"76b2677229ea6131ed4547a06fcf2a5ef13561884b5ea193c71917b3367aa75a","identity":"mutation_description:werehowl mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你在近战中杀死敌人时，若狼人狂怒加成至少为 5，你可能会发出恐怖嚎叫；\n若能克服附近敌人的意志力，就会尝试以恐惧将它们全部定在原地。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"werehowl mutation","english_description":"When you kill an enemy in melee, if your werefury bonus is at least 5, you may\nunleash a terrifying howl that attempts to freeze all nearby enemies in place\nwith fear if it overcomes their willpower.","english_source_name":"werehowl mutation","identity":"mutation_description:werehowl mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。近战击杀且狼人狂怒≥5、概率嚎叫、克服意志使附近敌人因恐惧定身完整。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1180；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1320","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你持握远程武器向敌人冲锋时，还会射出一发伤害更高的穿透射击，\n并强化你的下一次普通攻击，使其能够同时射击多个敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever you rampage towards foes while wielding a ranged weapon, you also fire\na penetrating shot that does increased damage and your next normal attack\nbecomes empowered to fire at multiple foes at once.","english_source_name":"west wind's embodiment mutation"},"fact_sha256":"0f1b24e27d71abd45f0fc462e6aac37a60d7a3d60fa735b1310febf6ccd0868c","identity":"mutation_description:west wind's embodiment mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你持握远程武器向敌人冲锋时，还会射出一发伤害更高的穿透射击，\n并强化你的下一次普通攻击，使其能够同时射击多个敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"west wind's embodiment mutation","english_description":"Whenever you rampage towards foes while wielding a ranged weapon, you also fire\na penetrating shot that does increased damage and your next normal attack\nbecomes empowered to fire at multiple foes at once.","english_source_name":"west wind's embodiment mutation","identity":"mutation_description:west wind's embodiment mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"全量能力／变异／怪物状态复审；冻结语义输入24a2d37e3fe4baa349a33736cbfad5e860abebb5（c759仅后续括号格式修正）。已完整逐段对照本卡所列EN/ZH命题：动作、条件、数量、例外、持续/重置与结果均已审读；有确定差异的身份列入finding_ids。 证据：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt:1043；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt:1349","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"锻造系魔法是一种将魔法塑造成实体物品的艺术。锻造系法术可以构建各种机械生物，\n与施法者并肩作战，也可以制造陷阱和路障，甚至将护甲的物理韧性转化为武器。\n\n精通锻造系可以提高该学派法术的成功率和法术威力。许多法术属于多个学派，\n在这种情况下，施法成功率和威力将取决于这些学派的平均技能水平。","conditional_titles[0].chinese":"硫磺击打者","conditional_titles[1].chinese":"巨神施法者","conditional_titles[2].chinese":"蛙匠","current_chinese_name":"锻造系","titles[0].chinese":"修补匠","titles[1].chinese":"制造者","titles[2].chinese":"机械师","titles[3].chinese":"攻城匠师","titles[4].chinese":"纪元建筑师"},"current_english":{"conditional_titles[0].english":"Brimstone Smiter","conditional_titles[1].english":"Titancaster","conditional_titles[2].english":"Frogwright","english_description":"Forgecraft is the art of shaping tangible objects out of magic. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的石化毒素最近已触发，在生命值完全恢复前不会再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your lithotoxin has recently activated and will not do so again until you fully\nheal.","english_source_name":"-lithotox status"},"fact_sha256":"da541e745848f0bef768fbe00285f8abf4731b6c804989ee0a182c6591591dbf","identity":"status_description:-lithotox status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的石化毒素最近已触发，在生命值完全恢复前不会再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-lithotox status","english_description":"Your lithotoxin has recently activated and will not do so again until you fully\nheal.","english_source_name":"-lithotox status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-lithotox status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_MEDUSA_COOLDOWN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对了 lithotoxin 已经触发、必须恢复满生命值才能再次触发两个命题；激活和恢复条件均译对。机制证据确认该毒素能令中毒敌人石化，但术语不必逐字解释全部机制。“石毒素”可作为 lithotoxin 的简缩造词；本次未发现它造成确定错误含义或与其他机制混淆的证据，不能仅因词表使用“石化毒素”或后者更直观就判为错误。建议改为“石化毒素”并把“完全治愈”明确为生命值恢复，以改善可读性；这是非必改措辞建议。 本批采用：采纳清晰度建议，用当前石化毒素词根及生命值完全恢复的再次触发条件。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1193；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:798；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:725；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:191；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:966；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1102","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你无法行走、飞行、爬行等。\n但你仍能采取其他行动，也仍可通过位移效果或被推、被拉等方式移动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You cannot walk, fly around, slither, etc. You can still take other actions,\nand can still be moved via translocations or by being pushed, pulled, and so on.","english_source_name":"-move status"},"fact_sha256":"ac21623152e731a2021f20a63b3c4960d11a93e2b0f70899f77dbcbce6de5d44","identity":"status_description:-move status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你无法行走、飞行、爬行等。\n但你仍能采取其他行动，也仍可通过位移效果或被推、被拉等方式移动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-move status","english_description":"You cannot walk, fly around, slither, etc. You can still take other actions,\nand can still be moved via translocations or by being pushed, pulled, and so on.","english_source_name":"-move status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-move status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_NO_MOMENTUM"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。slither 是蛇行/爬行，译为“滑翔”改变了移动方式；同时应把 translocations 保持为位移效果总称，而非只让读者想到瞬间移动这一术语。 本批采用：slither 译为爬行，translocations 保留为位移效果总称，并保留可采取其他行动。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:191；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:147；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:492；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:8874","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你刚吟诵完辛的律令，短时间内无法再吟诵了。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have recently finished reciting Zin's laws, and cannot recite again for a\nshort duration.","english_source_name":"-recite status"},"fact_sha256":"1d381bda3357266e36fdbcade1b567fcdbd5f5b7b1e119c4feae8f204b56c9e8","identity":"status_description:-recite status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你刚吟诵完辛的律令，短时间内无法再吟诵了。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-recite status","english_description":"You have recently finished reciting Zin's laws, and cannot recite again for a\nshort duration.","english_source_name":"-recite status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-recite status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_RECITE_COOLDOWN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。辛的律令、吟诵刚结束、短时不能重用三点对应；专名“辛”不以字面善恶作为译名真伪依据。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:396；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:314；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:517","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你察觉到附近有构成威胁的敌人，因此常规生命值再生已停止。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your normal health regeneration has stopped because you are aware of nearby\nthreatening enemies.","english_source_name":"-regen status"},"fact_sha256":"79315bb95013296756b48009e9c6930843fe522f01d46f4f5db10229311effb2","identity":"status_description:-regen status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你察觉到附近有构成威胁的敌人，因此常规生命值再生已停止。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-regen status","english_description":"Your normal health regeneration has stopped because you are aware of nearby\nthreatening enemies.","english_source_name":"-regen status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-regen status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["status:STATUS_REGENERATION"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。health regeneration 被泛化成“恢复健康”，未保留生命再生这一特定机制范围，容易被理解为包括药水治疗在内的一切恢复。player_regen 抑制自然再生，药水的直接加血路径独立；特洛格/吉瓦还存在再生例外，应另列源文限定债，不自行加写。 本批采用：按 coder 后续 EN 限定为常规生命值再生受阻，并明确察觉到附近有威胁敌人的原因，不扩大为禁止治疗。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:50；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:40；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1344；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1496；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1526；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc:123","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你因刚刚念出混沌之语而感到疲惫，短时间内无法再次念诵。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are fatigued from recently speaking a word of chaos, and are unable to do so\nagain for a short time.","english_source_name":"-word status"},"fact_sha256":"e31313ea5b43597f4429c55ededb9c109550485236583e2f4d741e0e8abb65dd","identity":"status_description:-word status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你因刚刚念出混沌之语而感到疲惫，短时间内无法再次念诵。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"-word status","english_description":"You are fatigued from recently speaking a word of chaos, and are unable to do so\nagain for a short time.","english_source_name":"-word status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:-word status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_WORD_OF_CHAOS_COOLDOWN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。短时禁用已保留，但“混乱之语”与 Chaos/Confusion 的区分不够鲜明，且 fatigued 的疲惫原因不显式。作为清晰度建议补出，非仅凭词表强判语义错误。 本批采用：采纳建议，恢复混沌词根并补足念出此语所致疲惫。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:878；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:761；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:659","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你聪明异常，法术的威力增强，同时其消耗的法力减半（四舍五入）。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are unnaturally smart, and gain a bonus to the power of your spells as well\nas halving their magic cost (rounding up).","english_source_name":"brill status"},"fact_sha256":"0980946de31e8b04265ac9c052592c74e56e00564b662b708c56b556093bd888","identity":"status_description:brill status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你聪明异常，法术的威力增强，同时其消耗的法力减半（四舍五入）。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"brill status","english_description":"You are unnaturally smart, and gain a bonus to the power of your spells as well\nas halving their magic cost (rounding up).","english_source_name":"brill status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:brill status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_BRILLIANCE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。原文 rounding up 更宜译“向上取整”；但当前法力消耗为整数再减半，只出现整数或半整数，四舍五入与向上取整在这个输入域给出相同结果。因此记为表达精确性建议，不声称实际消耗计算被译错。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:36；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:28；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/spl-util.cc:1048","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你正驱使所有护甲喧闹地攻击。你附身的每件护甲都会自主行动；\n它们受到的任何伤害都不会影响你，你也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人晕眩、汲取其生命力，或使其陷入混乱。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are noisily attacking with all of your armour. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你周身发光，潜行被大幅削弱，你更容易被击中。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are surrounded by light, greatly reducing your stealth and making you\neasier to hit.","english_source_name":"corona status"},"fact_sha256":"a206ec99b5c4cc06a660a1c53137672e1bae1e754e907d64dafe2783e86ce5d1","identity":"status_description:corona status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你周身发光，潜行被大幅削弱，你更容易被击中。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"corona status","english_description":"You are surrounded by light, greatly reducing your stealth and making you\neasier to hit.","english_source_name":"corona status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:corona status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_CORONA"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。保留大幅潜行下降及更易被击中，没有与单纯外观发光混同。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:216；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:170；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你被腐蚀了，你的物理攻击力和防护被削弱，削弱程度取决于腐蚀的严重程度。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are corroded, reducing your damage in physical combat and your armour by an\namount depending on the severity of the corrosion.","english_source_name":"corr status"},"fact_sha256":"4a4f5bb3988d10dd6a5ebff0f09fdbce154f972151ff456520c53d8b16080488","identity":"status_description:corr status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你被腐蚀了，你的物理攻击力和防护被削弱，削弱程度取决于腐蚀的严重程度。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"corr status","english_description":"You are corroded, reducing your damage in physical combat and your armour by an\namount depending on the severity of the corrosion.","english_source_name":"corr status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:corr status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_CORROSION","status:STATUS_CORROSION"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。保留物理战斗伤害与防护两项下降，并与腐蚀程度挂钩；没有误译为仅武器附魔下降。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:236；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:187；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你变成了不死之物，其存在本身就是对生命的亵渎。\n\n被你的双手或近战武器击中的敌人会变得虚弱、迟缓，并被汲取生命力，\n你还可以通过折磨附近的活物敌人来治疗自己。\n此外，你能抵抗寒冷，意志力得到增强，并免疫毒、瘴气、负能量和折磨。\n不幸的是，你易受神圣伤害和驱散亡灵的伤害，且无法饮用药水。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have been transformed into an undying offence against life itself.\n\nFoes struck by your hands or melee weapons are weakened, slowed, and drained,\nand you can heal yourself by tormenting living foes nearby. Unfortunately, you are vulnerable to holy damage and\nDispel Undead, and cannot consume potions.","english_source_name":"death status"},"fact_sha256":"7635fce649e0e57f4f6faf821f27cf38cf4f5a56ed91271c1b99b82c22b5540e","identity":"status_description:death status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你变成了不死之物，其存在本身就是对生命的亵渎。\n\n被你的双手或近战武器击中的敌人会变得虚弱、迟缓，并被汲取生命力，\n你还可以通过折磨附近的活物敌人来治疗自己。\n此外，你能抵抗寒冷，意志力得到增强，并免疫毒、瘴气、负能量和折磨。\n不幸的是，你易受神圣伤害和驱散亡灵的伤害，且无法饮用药水。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"death status","english_description":"You have been transformed into an undying offence against life itself.\n\nFoes struck by your hands or melee weapons are weakened, slowed, and drained,\nand you can heal yourself by tormenting living foes nearby. Unfortunately, you are vulnerable to holy damage and\nDispel Undead, and cannot consume potions.","english_source_name":"death status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:death status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对了 undying offence against life itself 的不死/生命亵渎比喻，近战虚弱/减速/衰竭、折磨附近活敌回血、寒抗/意志提升/四项免疫、神圣与驱散亡灵弱点及禁药水。所有机制命题在中文中均保留，draining 也没有误作吸血。英文自己把变形结果比作 undying offence，中文以“你”为主语的“永恒冒犯”仍能传达这一比喻，不能据此断定把实体误译成了其他东西。“被虚弱”较生硬，但在被施加状态的游戏语境中，与并列的被减速/被衰竭一样可理解，未造成确定的效果误述。建议显化不死之物并改成自然状态谓语，属于表达优化，不是事实纠错。 本批采用：采纳表达建议，显化不死实体；自然表达虚弱、迟缓和生命力汲取，保留所有抗性、弱点、治疗与禁药条件。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:559；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:480；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/death.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:833；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:1173；crawl-ref/source/ability.cc:2961；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1851；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:7423","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

分支，及公共近战/生命/闪避尾句。明确 ZH 错误：Red/White 把“高火/寒抗而普通毒抗”合成“对火/寒和毒有很强的抗性”，非龙人分支也混淆两档抗性；末尾另有 EN 无的装备段。然而当前 FormDragon 非龙人对应 golden dragon、只按 golden 返回火/寒各1，species::dragon_form 还列灰龙人的 iron dragon 和泥吐息，与 EN 所描述的旧火龙/寒弱点等不一致。故不可仅照旧 EN 修成可落地中文。公共伤害高、健壮、闪避降低和 physical 融合仍有支持。 本批采用：按 coder 最终 EN 同步 Lua：全部毒抗；非龙人/基础 Draconian 另获火寒抗；非龙人金龙吐息；有色（含 Grey）龙人先天吐息增强；删除旧色彩抗性/弱点/装备段，保留公共伤害/健壮/闪避尾句。 原实现延期已由源码追踪及中英成对修正闭环；参见 transform.cc、status.cc、player.cc、melee-attack.cc 和本批实际正文/查库测试。
