{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的生命值和/或法力正在快速恢复，盟友的生命值也在快速恢复。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your health and/or magic are being rapidly restored, as well as the health of\nyour allies.","english_source_name":"elixir status"},"fact_sha256":"6b656418277334c254ecd4eb7495380e3b96b3439e7c9c97b45e1d55627ab917","identity":"status_description:elixir status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的生命值和/或法力正在快速恢复，盟友的生命值也在快速恢复。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"elixir status","english_description":"Your health and/or magic are being rapidly restored, as well as the health of\nyour allies.","english_source_name":"elixir status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:elixir status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_ELIXIR"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。恢复玩家生命／法力及盟友生命的三项范围保留，但“健康／魔法”用词不像数值资源，建议改成生命值／法力；不将可理解的旧表达强判完全误义。 本批采用：采纳资源名建议：玩家生命值和/或法力，以及盟友生命值快速恢复。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:725；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:622；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:655；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:656","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你身上附着黏性火焰，会在一段适中的时间内持续受到伤害。\n移动能大幅加快火焰熄灭，进入水中则会立即将其扑灭。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are covered with sticky fire, which causes damage over a moderate duration.\nMoving will quell the fire much more rapidly, and entering water will extinguish\nit immediately.","english_source_name":"fire status"},"fact_sha256":"1a0580def49e83e46f74505c788877243a2d082364f70c6dd2fecfd67b3d37a2","identity":"status_description:fire status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你身上附着黏性火焰，会在一段适中的时间内持续受到伤害。\n移动能大幅加快火焰熄灭，进入水中则会立即将其扑灭。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"fire status","english_description":"You are covered with sticky fire, which causes damage over a moderate duration.\nMoving will quell the fire much more rapidly, and entering water will extinguish\nit immediately.","english_source_name":"fire status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:fire status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_STICKY_FLAME"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。“over a moderate duration”和“much more rapidly”的时长与程度均被弱化为一段时间/更快，按完整性要求应保留；进入水中立即熄灭已正确。 本批采用：保留适中持续时间、移动大幅加快灭火、水中立即灭火三项。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:202；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:157；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:5194；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:5229","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的身体从根本上就不稳定。每次触碰敌人，都会给它们带来危险程度的魔法污染。\n污染积累到足够程度时，便会在极小范围内引发熔毁，造成巨额伤害。\n\n然而，这种不稳定也使你无法使用武器、盾牌或躯干护甲。你还会发光，\n降低潜行能力并使你无法隐形。由于肢体有时会在挥击途中失稳，\n你的近战伤害也会降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are unstable at a fundamental level. You inflict dangerous levels of\nmagical contamination on foes with each touch. Sufficient contamination\ncauses a highly localised meltdown, dealing enormous damage.\n\nHowever, this instability makes you unable to use weapons, shields, or\nbody armour. You also glow, reducing stealth and preventing invisibility,\nand you do less damage in melee, as your limbs sometimes destabilise mid-swing.","english_source_name":"flux status"},"fact_sha256":"92554e55bc519ce25e60a10bddf45d3c57c4c7d82a4ab25daaea1beadc0b3c09","identity":"status_description:flux status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的身体从根本上就不稳定。每次触碰敌人，都会给它们带来危险程度的魔法污染。\n污染积累到足够程度时，便会在极小范围内引发熔毁，造成巨额伤害。\n\n然而，这种不稳定也使你无法使用武器、盾牌或躯干护甲。你还会发光，\n降低潜行能力并使你无法隐形。由于肢体有时会在挥击途中失稳，\n你的近战伤害也会降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"flux status","english_description":"You are unstable at a fundamental level. You inflict dangerous levels of\nmagical contamination on foes with each touch. Sufficient contamination\ncauses a highly localised meltdown, dealing enormous damage.\n\nHowever, this instability makes you unable to use weapons, shields, or\nbody armour. You also glow, reducing stealth and preventing invisibility,\nand you do less damage in melee, as your limbs sometimes destabilise mid-swing.","english_source_name":"flux status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:flux status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对根本层面的不稳定、每次触碰污染、累计污染引起局部 meltdown 巨额伤害、不能用武器/盾/躯干甲、发光降低潜行且禁隐形、挥击途中肢体失稳导致近战减伤。ZH 的“基面上”误读 fundamental level 为几何基面；“局部高度熔融”把 highly localised 误作熔融程度高；“摇摆不定”只表达摇晃而丢失形体失稳。污染触发伤害/恶性变异及半伤代码支持魔法失稳，不支持几何/温度说明。应重译两段，保留全部限制，不把固有装备 gloves 融合差异冒充中文遗漏。 本批采用：修复 fundamental level、highly localised 和肢体失稳误读；完整保留污染、伤害及三类装备、潜行、隐形、近战限制。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:488；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:401；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/flux.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:611；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:716；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:1014；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:2949","terminal_conclusion":"retranslate"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的身体像玻璃一样易碎而脆弱，你受到的任何来源的伤害都会增加。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your body is as fragile and brittle as glass, increasing the damage you take from\nall sources.","english_source_name":"fragile status"},"fact_sha256":"4a8a6cf3daa435d4357f6951d4150d74ed4561c38215bcf4b3a9963a4e577c4e","identity":"status_description:fragile status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的身体像玻璃一样易碎而脆弱，你受到的任何来源的伤害都会增加。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"fragile status","english_description":"Your body is as fragile and brittle as glass, increasing the damage you take from\nall sources.","english_source_name":"fragile status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:fragile status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_VITRIFIED"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。英语是任何来源的伤害，中文改成任何来源的“攻击”，遗漏非攻击伤害；伤害结算处统一的易碎增伤支持保留 damage 范围。 本批采用：范围明确为所有来源的伤害，不局限为攻击。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:854；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:740；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:337；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1366","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你变成了有意识的真菌。你的闪避能力很高，近战攻击时能释放孢子，\n使需要呼吸的生物陷入混乱，但附近有构成威胁的敌人时，你可能会吓得无法移动。\n\n装备的武器和护甲都会被融合，且无法施展法术。\n在这种形态下，你的近战攻击效果取决于经验等级，而非徒手格斗技能。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have been transformed into a sentient fungus. You are highly evasive and\ncan release spores to confuse breathing creatures when attacking in melee,\nbut can become too terrified to move when threatening enemies are nearby.\n\nAny equipped weapons and armour are melded, and you are unable to cast spells.\nThe effectiveness of your melee attacks while in this form is based on\nexperience level instead of on Unarmed Combat skill.","english_source_name":"fungus status"},"fact_sha256":"3e7c2c87f1c8fc9ee4fa0ed8e2428ee967dfa105c375b98a6e02af8d83d7d12a","identity":"status_description:fungus status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你变成了有意识的真菌。你的闪避能力很高，近战攻击时能释放孢子，\n使需要呼吸的生物陷入混乱，但附近有构成威胁的敌人时，你可能会吓得无法移动。\n\n装备的武器和护甲都会被融合，且无法施展法术。\n在这种形态下，你的近战攻击效果取决于经验等级，而非徒手格斗技能。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"fungus status","english_description":"You have been transformed into a sentient fungus. You are highly evasive and\ncan release spores to confuse breathing creatures when attacking in melee,\nbut can become too terrified to move when threatening enemies are nearby.\n\nAny equipped weapons and armour are melded, and you are unable to cast spells.\nThe effectiveness of your melee attacks while in this form is based on\nexperience level instead of on Unarmed Combat skill.","english_source_name":"fungus status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:fungus status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。逐段核对有意识真菌、高闪避、近战孢子混乱、敌在场时不能动、毒抗/负能免疫、武器护甲融合、禁施法、经验等级而非徒手技能。中文准确传达当前 EN；但 current YAML/生成 formdata 均为 MR_NO_FLAGS 且 MH_PLANT。Form::res_pois/res_neg 直接读该标记，player_res_poison 不把植物视作抗毒，player_prot_life 也不因植物直接给负能免疫；因此 EN/ZH 两者的抗性承诺无现行支持。行动条件实际还排除睡眠、混乱、无助等不构成威胁的敌人，不能把泛化描述当作精确条件。其他融合、施法、XL 和孢子效果已核对。 本批采用：按 coder 最终 EN 同步：混乱目标限需呼吸生物；有威胁敌人附近时可能因恐惧无法移动；删除无现行实现的毒抗/负能免疫，保留装备融合、禁法与 XL/徒手技能区别。 原实现延期已由源码追踪及中英成对修正闭环；参见 transform.cc、status.cc、player.cc、melee-attack.cc 和本批实际正文/查库测试。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:618；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:530；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/fungus.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h:358；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:447；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:463；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1851；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:2056；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:8880；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:1355","terminal_conclusion":"retranslate"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你是一只迷魂壁虎，善于潜行，严重受伤时能够脱落尾巴作为诱饵。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are a hypnogecko, a stealthy lizard who can shed their own tail as a decoy\nwhen badly injured.","english_source_name":"gecko status"},"fact_sha256":"d36f24100c8df85a5da8c78e4c7e7c4c5f73e2025232001afb2e75035196a68c","identity":"status_description:gecko status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你是一只迷魂壁虎，善于潜行，严重受伤时能够脱落尾巴作为诱饵。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"gecko status","english_description":"You are a hypnogecko, a stealthy lizard who can shed their own tail as a decoy\nwhen badly injured.","english_source_name":"gecko status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:gecko status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对 hypnogecko 身份、壁虎/蜥蜴类形体、善潜行、严重受伤断尾诱敌。中文“迷魂壁虎”保留催眠意象和具体壁虎身份，断尾用途与条件齐全；“脱落尾巴”虽不如“断尾”顺畅，但不会把动作或作用读反，不作必改。配置和低血触发、尾巴精效支持命题。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1348；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1219；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/hypnogecko.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1010；crawl-ref/source/fineff.cc:2080；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1483","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"佐特的力量不再追猎你，但这个分支的宝石仍然完好无损。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"The power of Zot no longer hunts you, but this branch's gem still remains\nintact.","english_source_name":"gem (*) status"},"fact_sha256":"cae9b35d59236236b387c5a8323bd2d3321b6a809b78c6c408e24188eb2da282","identity":"status_description:gem (*) status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"佐特的力量不再追猎你，但这个分支的宝石仍然完好无损。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"gem (*) status","english_description":"The power of Zot no longer hunts you, but this branch's gem still remains\nintact.","english_source_name":"gem (*) status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:gem (*) status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。orb取得后佐特不再追猎而宝石尚完整的命题对应；当前HUD的Gem(*)显示仍以Gem为db_key，独立星号正文可从帮助查询，勿将正确正文误当已在该HUD分支使用。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:776；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:948；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1232","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你被天云风暴环绕。风暴持续时，你的闪避、攻击命中率和伤害都会大幅提高，\n用武术攻击敌人还会继续增加这些加成。\n风暴会随时间减弱，加成降至零时便会消散。\n天云会使隐形失效，并遮蔽风暴外观察者的视线。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are surrounded by a storm of heavenly clouds. While the storm rages, your\nevasion and combat accuracy and damage are substantially increased, and\nstriking enemies with martial attacks increases this bonus. The heavenly clouds\nprevent invisibility, and obscure the vision of those outside the storm.","english_source_name":"heavenly status"},"fact_sha256":"01d618e2fb0a07c7359c60703200be3f339cd4caa6b1e06417a7126a2d7491d8","identity":"status_description:heavenly status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你被天云风暴环绕。风暴持续时，你的闪避、攻击命中率和伤害都会大幅提高，\n用武术攻击敌人还会继续增加这些加成。\n风暴会随时间减弱，加成降至零时便会消散。\n天云会使隐形失效，并遮蔽风暴外观察者的视线。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"heavenly status","english_description":"You are surrounded by a storm of heavenly clouds. While the storm rages, your\nevasion and combat accuracy and damage are substantially increased, and\nstriking enemies with martial attacks increases this bonus. The storm weakens\nover time and fades away once the bonus reaches zero. The heavenly clouds\nprevent invisibility, and obscure the vision of those outside the storm.","english_source_name":"heavenly status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:heavenly status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。风暴增强闪避命中伤害、随时间减退、云阻隐形及外部视野均保留；“武术攻击还会有加成”可更明确为继续增加现有加成，只作为清晰度建议。 本批采用：明确武术命中继续增加已有加成，保留时间衰减、归零消散、禁隐与遮蔽外部视野。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:677；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:576；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/god-passive.cc:1832；crawl-ref/source/god-passive.cc:1926；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:2373","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你是一个活着的蜂巢，充满了忙碌的昆虫嗡鸣。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are a living beehive, abuzz with busy insects.","english_source_name":"hive status"},"fact_sha256":"608a6d72ab4f65a16cca85bb9a625335fd2539ec4a961a257c7de71df3f043a7","identity":"status_description:hive status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你是一个活着的蜂巢，充满了忙碌的昆虫嗡鸣。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"hive status","english_description":"You are a living beehive, abuzz with busy insects.","english_source_name":"hive status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:hive status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对活蜂巢形体、忙碌的昆虫和嗡鸣声三项。中文均传达；“充满了忙碌的昆虫嗡鸣”允许理解为昆虫在巢内嗡鸣，不把 hive 错当蜂群变形。“活着的”与 hive 仍保持自身活动和回血能力一致。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1150；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:952；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/hive.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1120；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:933","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你害怕附近的怪物，你战斗中的攻击力、命中率和法术威力均被削弱。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are terrified of nearby monsters, reducing your damage and accuracy in\ncombat as well as the power of your spells.","english_source_name":"horr status"},"fact_sha256":"060fb5aa677104c8be9b17f1c06675956697a92615be652bf63cfa3b3f160928","identity":"status_description:horr status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你害怕附近的怪物，你战斗中的攻击力、命中率和法术威力均被削弱。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"horr status","english_description":"You are terrified of nearby monsters, reducing your damage and accuracy in\ncombat as well as the power of your spells.","english_source_name":"horr status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:horr status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_HORROR"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。附近怪物引起恐惧并降低攻击伤害命中及法术威力，三项削弱均保留；不是普通 Fear 的移动限制说明。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:446；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:359；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:786；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:592","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的身体已变为虚体，免疫束缚、石化、倒刺、黏着火焰、蛛网、网和流星索的缠缚。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your body is insubstantial, granting you immunity to constriction, petrification,\nbarbs, sticky flame, webs, nets, and being caught by bolas.","english_source_name":"insubst status"},"fact_sha256":"6cf7c1bda218f2bc401de5537fd703c89b9b3281c1664e38087d97489622bba5","identity":"status_description:insubst status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的身体已变为虚体，免疫束缚、石化、倒刺、黏着火焰、蛛网、网和流星索的缠缚。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"insubst status","english_description":"Your body is insubstantial, granting you immunity to constriction, petrification,\nbarbs, sticky flame, webs, nets, and being caught by bolas.","english_source_name":"insubst status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:insubst status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_INSUBSTANTIAL"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对虚体，以及 constriction、petrification、barbs、sticky flame、webs、nets、bolas 七项免疫，中文七项齐全且分别保留。“束缚”在此对应 constriction 而非一切束缚的无限泛化，因为后文另列网具。已确认 is_insubstantial 涵盖 wisp/storm/持续效果，石化、缠绕、黏火、网具的相关判定使用它。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1358；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1227；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:821；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:7351；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:7471；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1907；crawl-ref/source/player-act.cc:777；crawl-ref/source/traps.cc:1077","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你隐形了。大多数敌人看不到你，命中率会降低，不过它们可能猜到你的大致位置。\n如果状态显示为灰色，表示它仍在持续，但因某种原因无法发挥效果\n（例如你因魔法污染而发光，或正站在浅水中）。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are invisible. Most enemies will be unable to see you and will suffer\npenalties to hit, though they may be able to guess at your general location.\nIf the status is greyed out, it is active but ineffective for some reason (for\nexample if you are glowing with magical contamination or standing in shallow\nwater).","english_source_name":"invis status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:invis status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["status:STATUS_INVISIBLE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。中文额外声称隐形随时间造成魔法污染，且把灰色状态解释为仍在产生污染；英文没有这些命题。当前隐形药水只设置时长，污染周期逻辑亦不由隐形持续产污。保留隐形被发光或浅水等暴露的原文例子。 本批采用：删除现行 EN 没有的持续产污断言；保留看不见、命中惩罚、推测位置及灰色状态的两个例子。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:6；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:6；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:1609；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc:454；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc:498；crawl-ref/source/timed-effects.cc:70；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1467","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"大片元素晶体覆盖着你的上身，提高你对元素魔法的掌握，并让你能以强烈的爆发释放它们的力量。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"A mass of elemental crystal shrouds your upper body, granting you increased\nskill with elemental magic and the ability to unleash it in a powerful burst.","english_source_name":"jade status"},"fact_sha256":"287a8928234674dcc7b0fa647920005a4c39a548764f2ffe975bc467366cf367","identity":"status_description:jade status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"大片元素晶体覆盖着你的上身，提高你对元素魔法的掌握，并让你能以强烈的爆发释放它们的力量。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"jade status","english_description":"A mass of elemental crystal shrouds your upper body, granting you increased\nskill with elemental magic and the ability to unleash it in a powerful burst.","english_source_name":"jade status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:jade status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对元素晶体覆盖上半身、提升元素魔法技能、能以强劲爆发释放元素力量。中文三项齐全；“提高掌握”与 actual elemental skill bonus 相符，不是泛指施法速度。强劲爆发有晶体 surge 充能时伤害路径；源文没有写主动随时释放，中文也未擅自加此限制或权限。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1339；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1211；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/jademantle.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1430；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1475；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:3055","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的腹部变成了一张不断咬合、随时准备吞噬敌人的巨口。\n这张巨口可能吞食被杀死的生物，暂时提高你的生命值再生速度。\n你的变形术技能会提高这项再生加成，以及巨口造成的伤害。\n吞食的生物越强大，再生加成的持续时间就越长。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your midsection has transformed into a giant mouth, gnashing and ready to devour\nfoes. The mouth may devour slain creatures, temporarily increasing your health\nregeneration. Your Shapeshifting skill increases this regeneration bonus and\nthe damage done by the maw. More powerful creatures provide a longer-lasting\nregeneration bonus.","english_source_name":"maw status"},"fact_sha256":"75939b75fcafbb95677d29b48c37b080dfd3056bf71ddade70de1b403391df34","identity":"status_description:maw status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你的腹部变成了一张不断咬合、随时准备吞噬敌人的巨口。\n这张巨口可能吞食被杀死的生物，暂时提高你的生命值再生速度。\n你的变形术技能会提高这项再生加成，以及巨口造成的伤害。\n吞食的生物越强大，再生加成的持续时间就越长。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"maw status","english_description":"Your midsection has transformed into a giant mouth, gnashing and ready to devour\nfoes. The mouth may devour slain creatures, temporarily increasing your health\nregeneration. Your Shapeshifting skill increases this regeneration bonus and\nthe damage done by the maw. More powerful creatures provide a longer-lasting\nregeneration bonus.","english_source_name":"maw status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:maw status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对腹部巨口、咬合并准备吞敌、吞噬杀死的生物回血、技能及被吃生物力量影响治疗、技能提高巨口伤害。确定 ZH 错误：“maw”伤害写成“胃部”伤害；额外“装备的护甲都会被融合”与当前 maw.yaml 无 melds、保留躯干甲但 -75% AC 的设计相反。另 EN 的治疗说法已落后：_devour 给与受猎物等级影响的 ENGORGED 持续时间，player_regen 读取它提高再生，FormMaw 按变形技能决定再生加值。不能把它直接当旧版即时治疗量翻译落地。 本批采用：按 coder 最终 EN 同步：吞食可能触发暂时生命再生加成；技能提高再生加成和巨口伤害，猎物强度延长再生时长；删除旧直接治疗及装备融合段。 原实现延期已由源码追踪及中英成对修正闭环；参见 transform.cc、status.cc、player.cc、melee-attack.cc 和本批实际正文/查库测试。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:503；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:420；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/maw.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1021；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:1222；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:1366；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:1469","terminal_conclusion":"retranslate"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你长着一头由带毒的触须构成的鬃发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have a mane of venomous tendrils for hair.","english_source_name":"medusa status"},"fact_sha256":"b31955ce396208349cf26ade97cc26328cccbc31bb6a34cf8dca5f7132901440","identity":"status_description:medusa status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你长着一头由带毒的触须构成的鬃发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"medusa status","english_description":"You have a mane of venomous tendrils for hair.","english_source_name":"medusa status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:medusa status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对 hair 被一簇 venomous tendrils 替代，中文保留鬃发、触须和毒性。当前“毒液触须”可以理解为带毒触须，不能据此断定其声称全由液体构成；但表达不自然，建议改成“带毒的触须”以直接传达 venomous。Medusa 的 stinger hair 确认是能使近敌中毒的触须，而不是蛇发，故不擅改成传统美杜莎的蛇。 本批采用：采纳自然度建议：带毒的触须构成鬃发，不擅改成蛇发。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1189；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:968；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/medusa.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1270；crawl-ref/source/fight.cc:407","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"这表示如果你现在使用“点燃”能力，可以用已积累的记忆施放多少个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"This indicates how many spells you could cast from accumulated memories if you\nEnkindled now.","english_source_name":"memories status"},"fact_sha256":"5cefc95059a9cb0febef30a7249458e78b7867ec4a1d1c0d5cd6e4e82cc98c84","identity":"status_description:memories status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"这表示如果你现在使用“点燃”能力，可以用已积累的记忆施放多少个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"memories status","english_description":"This indicates how many spells you could cast from accumulated memories if you\nEnkindled now.","english_source_name":"memories status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:memories status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["status:STATUS_MNEMOPHAGE"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。计数是已有记忆在使用 Enkindle 后可施放的法术数，原译的记忆资源概念正确。当前能力菜单显示“点燃”，而“现在燃魂”难以直接找到该操作；建议明确操作名。这只是辨识建议，不宣称“燃魂”作为意象本身必错。 本批采用：操作名称对齐现行菜单“点燃”，保留积累记忆可施放法术数量。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1105；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:972；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1040；crawl-ref/source/dat/i18n/zh/source.txt:33386；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1042","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你被刻上了毁灭之印。每次对你造成伤害的近战攻击，都会重度汲取你的生命力，\n并随机使你减速、虚弱或失明。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are marked with the sign of ruin, causing any melee attacks which damage you\nto heavily drain and randomly slow, weaken, or blind you.","english_source_name":"ruin status"},"fact_sha256":"948a16981bb47da23fcec0022fce3c5b0db3f3b1109c6e87356afb5a2e9a643d","identity":"status_description:ruin status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你被刻上了毁灭之印。每次对你造成伤害的近战攻击，都会重度汲取你的生命力，\n并随机使你减速、虚弱或失明。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"ruin status","english_description":"You are marked with the sign of ruin, causing any melee attacks which damage you\nto heavily drain and randomly slow, weaken, or blind you.","english_source_name":"ruin status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:ruin status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":["duration:DUR_SIGN_OF_RUIN"],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。heavy drain 被译成普通“严重削弱”，与后面的 Weak 混在一起；实际每次伤害近战先 drain，再随机 slow/weak/blind，需明确生命力汲取。 本批采用：重度汲取生命力与随机减速/虚弱/失明分开，保留造成伤害的近战攻击条件。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:964；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1049；crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:527；crawl-ref/source/status.cc:1186；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:752；crawl-ref/source/duration-data.h:753；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:519","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你是一卷会行走的卷轴，羊皮纸挺括，充满魔力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are a walking scroll, parchment crisp and full of magic.","english_source_name":"scroll status"},"fact_sha256":"daa50d4164763e6cd13c95d2045236de97fbe0fef51197f38d9629f24482af3e","identity":"status_description:scroll status","lifecycle":"current-help","production_facts":{"category":"status_description","chinese_description":"你是一卷会行走的卷轴，羊皮纸挺括，充满魔力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt","consumers":["crawl-ref/source/lookup-help.cc:_status_filter/_describe_key","crawl-ref/source/status.cc:status_light_description"],"description_key":"scroll status","english_description":"You are a walking scroll, parchment crisp and full of magic.","english_source_name":"scroll status","help_visible":true,"identity":"status_description:scroll status","lifecycle":"current-help","producer_candidates":[],"producer_coverage":"literal keys and duration defaults only","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"完整正文复审，基线 b297c8720472fbc64cebdfd7fdde9d110c895703。核对会行走的卷轴、羊皮纸 crisp 的质地、充满魔力三项。中文“本”通常量书籍，不适合卷轴；“羊皮纸清脆”把形容纸张脆挺的 crisp 误当声音清脆。当前英文与配置都明确 walking scroll/parchment，不能借 equivalent_mons 的 walking_tome 改回一本书。 本批采用：量词改为卷、纸张质地改为挺括，保留会行走与充满魔力。 基线证据位置：crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/status.txt:1177；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt:1058；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/walking-scroll.yaml:1；crawl-ref/source/dat/forms/walking-scroll.yaml:24；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc:1217","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你变成了旋涡状的暗影团。你将持续隐形，且免疫毒、衰竭和折磨的影响。\n所有受到的伤害会减半，受到任何攻击时都会流出烟雾，而且意志力无限。\n但是，你的近战和远程攻击伤害都会减半，法术威力也会大幅降低，\n受到伤害时，最大生命值还会因衰竭而进一步降低。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have been transformed into a swirling mass of dark shadows. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你是一个吸血鬼——一种跨越生命与亡灵界限的生物。你可以吸取活物的\n生命之血来治愈自己，甚至可以将那些潜行击杀的生物变成吸血仆从，\n但察觉到附近有构成威胁的敌人时，常规生命值再生就会停止。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/status.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are a vampire - a creature that straddles the border between life and\nundeath.
